lto/ e ma ṇi pad+me ṇ+ḍaṃ hrī/ je btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i spral nga/ a/ rangan |dhe/ zur zur rwadzesalags/ karma dbang 'a na gya rnam thar thar nga/'a lcags/ kyu zhas bya ba/mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su/ mchi'o/ /gang sku'i 'od kyis gdul bya'i mun pa sel/ /gang gsung dbyangs kyis/ gdul bya'i yid rab 'phrog /gang thugs mkhyen pas gdul bya'i skyon dag pa'i//bla ma spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras mchog thugs rje can/ /skye 'chi med pa rdo rje sku brnyes zhing / /phrin la/sa rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /a rgyan rin po che la/ phyag 'tshal lo//mi shigs 'ja' 'od thig le pho brang du/ /rab 'byams rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' klas shing / /bde chen ha ha bzhad pa'i dkyil 'khor lha// zhi khro ༷ra yang snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'ja' lus sku mchog zag med bde ba'i dpal/ /skal ldan bu la dngos grub ster ba'i ma/ /skyabs/ na blo thub re na mi bslu ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo/ rdo rje phag mor 'dud// dug gsu/ma rtsad gcod khams gsum zil gyis gnon/ /nā da'i rang sgra 'jigs/ pa'i bgad mo bzhin/ /sri/na po'i gzugs/ can gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'joms/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag sogs/ 'grerdzo drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnamanu// /las ngan sdig sgri/ba thams cad byang ba dang / /mtho ris thar pa'i lam/ la/ rab gnas shing / / dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du 'grub nga/ra 4 /dzod/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i nyes/ dmigs phan yon dang / /rang rang ḍis kyi rnam par smin pa yi// /sdug

bsngal myong lugs mthong ba'i me long 'di/ /'gro ba kun la phan phyir bstan par bya/ /khyad par dug lngas gzir ba'i 'gro ba la// chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung gsung gi 'phrin/ /ma/ sbas sgro skur spangs te legs ste3 pas//ma yengs dbang po gtod la spang blang mdzod/ /chos drung karma dbang 'dzin de nyid sku 'khrungs te 'jig rten mi chos mdzad pa'i ngang nas dam pa'i chos dang mjal zhing yi dam lha yi zhal gzigatra〈 pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa/ 'byung bzhi'i lus la rkyen mang zhing rtag mi thub pas/ bstung gzhi drag pos gzir nas 'u/sa/ sems bral nas/ bar do dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs pa dang / khyad par gzhin rje chos kyi rgyal pos dmyal khams kyi sdug bsngal dang / dge sdig gi rtsis grangs zhib par yod tshul 'phrin du gsungs gnang ba rnams/ bar mi'i yul na yod pa'i ser sna can sbyin pa la bskul ba dang /'dod chags can tshul khrims la ba//la ba/ zhe sdang dang phrag dog khong khro can bzod pa dang byams pa'i sems la 'jug pa/ le lo can chos la bskul ba/ gti mug can gyi rgyud la bsam gtan dang shes rab bskyed pa/ sdig pa can 'gyod sems drag po skyes nas bshags pa la 'bungs pa/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mched dang snyece ma dral rnams dang rang gi lus sems skyed pa'i pha ma la sogs te drin che ba rnam/sa la dad gus drag po dang dam tshig srung ba'i phyir dang / se mas can thamu /sa cad la gnod sems skad cig kyang mi bgyid par byams nga/'i sems dang lda na par bya ba'i phyir du bshad par bya'o/ /shā

de ya/nga lho brag lu/nga gsum gyi dbus/ dge bcu lung pa'i phu/kun dga' gling zhes bya ba'i dgon pa na/ yab bla 'i / mtsho skyes rdo rje dang /yum/ dpon sa tshe+o ring chos 'dzoms gnyis la// sras lca ma sring lnga yo/da pas/'bring ma lha dbang bu khrid ces bya ba/ dang ngo/ yu/ma gyi lhu ma/sa/ su zhugs dus dang sku blta mas pa'i skabs su bkra shis pa'i rtags ma/nga du byung zhing gces par skyed sring / sku na phra mo/ nas thugs/ shes/ rab dang / snying rje che bas chos la mos tswa)nga bag chags bzang ngo'i mdzad pa khyad par du 'phags pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba la zhen pa spu tsam yang med kyang / khra nas sde pa 'og 'gro'i gnas mor dgos lu/gas kyi gsung 'phrin nan che ba dang /yab yum gnyis khu/nga mi/ chos la mnyes pa'i brtenas tshurmes 'og 'gror sku bag la byon dgos pa byung / 'og 'gro'i thugs khur bzhes nas kyang / skya ser drag zhan/ phyi nang bar gsu/'i / gyi 'tsho skyong legs/ par ma dzad cing / khyad par du yar ma/chod pa dang / mar sbyin gyi dbe ba 'jig rten chos/ dang ma thun par mdzad do/ /de yang sngo/na gyi la/sa 'brel/ bzang po yod pa'i 'i /thus/ bla ma sgom/ chen ri khrod nga/ dang ma/jal zhing dbang ྅ nga khrid ngang bcanu/ nga/ zhus/ gzhan yang bla 'i / dge ba'i kogs gasnye'e/ na ri/nga po ne /jal zhing dbang khrid gda'i /sa ngag mang du zhus/ dus nam zhig si tshe dben 'i/'i gnas/ 'i dka khra phu'i ri khrod du sku mtsham sa/ gnas/ 'brel/ la/ byon par chas/ nga/sa༈/ yu/la mi grong pa/ kun gyis

ri khrod da kho zho /'i cha rben ma/nga da phal zhing / ṭ+wāṃ la 'thung byas khra phur phebs ༄ chisko ༄ ༄༄ rngo༅ bhepa dang / dkon ma/chog la/ dad nga/ lhag par skyas/ gdung shugs drag nge/sa ma/chi ma mang ngo/ shar/ da lta gnyen 'khor 'dzoms shing 'u/sa la rgyan du ma/sa/ brgyan kyang / tshe 'di'i snang ba yud tsam yin pa 'dug /dal 'byor gyi rten 'di tsam thob nas/ se/mas ngo 'phrod pa'i gdeng ma byung yang / 'chi khar mi 'jigs pa tsam zhig ma byung na ci 'dra rang byed/ rang gi se/mas la go ba btab na ci yong a tsa ma bsam nga/'i 'dun pa skyes/ der grub chen nor bu bkra shis las dbang khrid gdams ngag rnams yongs su rdzogs par zhus/de nas zla ba gsum gyi bar sgrub pa la bzhugs dus/ sprel zla'i tshes bzhi'i nyi ma gung yol gyi tshe rang gi nyams snang la mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' sprin 'thibs pa'i dbus su/ pad sdong gi 'dab ma rgod kyi gshog pa tsam yod pa'i dbus na 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i dkyil du mig gis lta bar mi bzod pa'i 'od zer gyi dbus su/ gu ru rin po che'i sku mtshon gang tsam pa lta bas chog mi shes pa phyag na bdud rtsis gang ba'i kā pa la'i steng na tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/de'i zhal nas ma dzo rigs bco brgyad sel ba'i gdams pa dang / se/mas can sdug bsngal can gyi sdug bsngal/ sel thabs la sogs/ pa/ sngags lung rjes gnang rgyas/ nga/ra gnang / de'i mtha' bskor du rje btsun sgrol dkar gyi sku byis pa lo brgyad lon pas mchod pa 'bul zhing 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa lta/ bur mthong / de rnam sa ma/thong ma thag tu dad pa drag pos ba spu g.yo zhing /tshe 'di'i 'jig rten gyi snang ba tham sa rjod nub/ tshe sngon gyi las dang bya ba

byas pa rna mas lhang tsam re dran nga/sa/ sems can kun la snying rje drag po skyes te/bla ma la/ mos/ gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba ma/nga du btab bo//de nas lo gcig tsam song ba dang / 'brug lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin nad drag po gcig phog ste/ zas la zhen pa log cing langs na nyal snying 'dod/ nyal na langs snying 'dod/ rang gi pha ma gnyen tshan nye grogs rnams yid la/ dran pa byung / de nas tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin g.yog chung phrug gu bsod nams tshe ring zer ba des nga'i gdong la bltas nas mchi ma 'don pa dang / spyan gyi 'od rdib pa dang / shangs yang 'khyoms 'dug pas/ nga yis yul du phyin nas sde pa la byon zhus pa mi drag gam zer/ nga rang gi bsam pa la nang en tsam gyi rkyen ma theg na chos pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mi yong bsam nas/ mdo nub sdod dang de nas bltar rung byed byas/ de nas nyi ma phyed yol gyi dus nas/ lus/ la grang shum dang skom tshad chen po skyes/ kha skom pa'i stabs kyis chu btungs pa rnams gre bar mi 'gro bar sna las/ lud/ 'byung bzhi thim rim la sleb/ de'i rtags su sha sa la thim pas lu/sa yar 'greng byas kyang / mar 'gyel 'gro ba 'byung / khrag chu la thim/ pas skomu / 'dod che zhing kha sna bskams chu 'thung mi shes pa byung / drod me la/ thim pas gos mang du g.yogs kyang lu/sa 'dar bsil du byung / dbugs rlung la/ thim pas dbugs brtsegs shing mnan kyang mi non pa byung / mi ga gi 'od kor nyams/ pas rang gi zla grogs/ ngos ma 5

zin/ rna ba'i sgra nyams pas tshur la lab pa'i sgra ma thos/ phyi nang gi rtsa rnams 'gags pas phar smra ma thub/ tshe 'di'i snang ba nub/ phyi ma'i snang ba 'char tshabs su thug /rig pa/ chu nang las gsal bas a tsa ma nga rang gnyen nye 'khor grogs dga' mdza' thams cad yid la dran kyang mi phan par 'dug /da ni gcig pur 'gro ba'i dus shig byung / chos byas nas mtho ri sa su 'gro ba'i gdeng tshad ni nga la med/ sdig pa byas pa thams cad rang si ge sa sari/ la lges/la ler dran pas/ 'gyod sems drag pos mchi ma mang po shor/ de dus 'ur sgra dang tsheg sgra shin tu che ba gcig byung ste/ dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'gags pas mar me rdza phug 'thums pa lta bu nag thom me ba dang /rnam rnga/ra shes pa snying gi dbus su dran med du brgyal bas de'i dus su shi snyam pa'i sdug bsngal dang / ma shi snyam dga' sdug gang la'ang 'dzin rgyu med par lus sa/ /der pha gi nas/ bud med gcig gi skad ltar lhang gi byung ste/blari mas btags pa'i ming de nges par dgos pa 'dug pas/ dbang 'dzin dbang 'dzin zer zhing bos nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol/ song ba khyod/ /mi rtag sgru ma zhig pa ma shes sam// /sgyu ma'i lus la/ chags zhen ma byed par/ /rang sem sa/ chos nyid ngang du yar shog dang //zer ba'i skad lhang nge ba zhig byung bas nga rang yang dran pa zhig zin nas// nga shi ba ni ma yin nam bas/ma pa'i ngang nas yar bltas pas// zangs kha phub dze

pa'i mthil nas yar bug pa yod pa lta bu skya thal le yod pa zhig mthong ba tsam gyis// 'gro 'dug gi snang ba med kyang skad cig tsam la/ de'i sto/nga na bslebs 'dug /rang gi mgo yin pa ni ma shes/ brag phug gi ma tha' thams cad shing tshab 'tshub skyes nga// de'i steng na khru gang tsam na 'od dkar po phyi thams cad rma bya'i mdongs ltar khra chil le ba yod pa/ de'i phyogs bcur 'od zer kha mdog ma/nga po 'phro zhing 'dug /de mthong bas sems/ zhum me ba dang / snang ba dgu 'gyur du gsal bas/ sems la lus kyi rten med pas/ bya sgro rlung gis khyer ba lta bu sem sa skyo phyong nge ba zhig byung /yangari nga'i bsam pa la da lan gcig bud med kyi skad de dang bstun na nga shi ba ni min nam bsam nas rang gi zla bo rnams btsal bas ni gcig kyang mi 'dug /yang shi ba ni ma shes sems skyo ba shes nas/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur nas/ chos byas nga ni med/ nga 'di 'dra'i sems skyo ba byas 'dod pa las yul du log 'gro dgos bsam pa'i snang ba shar ba tsam lcugs/'og 'gro ru bslebs 'dug /ngu 'bod kyi skad chen po gcig byung / sde pa'i drung skyes rgyal ba tham/sa cad ni khra phu la byon nas mi 'dug /g.yog mo rnams nga yi/ ming bos nas ngu 'bod byed kyin 'dug /nga'i bas/ma/ pa la nga ni ma shi/ snge/ nga/'i drung be bka' bkyon byung ba e yi/na byas/ dpung nga/ nas bzung ste yar bsla/ngas/ kyang / la/na me+e / 'arngo snye prer ma/ 'i /thong ba lta/ra byed kyin 'dug / nga /nga phyi pha rgi na ngu 'bod kyi ske nga lha nga nge ba gcig byung / phyir bltas/ pas/ mi rna'i /sa/ ni nga shi ba ye/na 'dug zer/ der la/ la na re/ thugs 7

chung la gnang skyong bzing ba yod pas phangs pa la zer/ la la na re/ ru ngar la phrag dog yod zer zhing lkog shub mang po byed kyin 'dug pas/ nga rang gi sems la phog sto mchi ma 'chor ba zhig byung yang mi 'chor ba lta ra byas nas nang du log pas/ nang na yod pa la la ni dpon mo grongs pa 'dra byed zer/ la la ni sras mo grongs pa snying rje zer/ la la ni sde pa snying rje zer zhing ngus pa la brten nas/ rnag khrag gi ser ba sgo nga tsam babs nas rus pa bcag song bsam pa dang pags pa brtol song bsam pa'i sdug bsngal ba dang 'ur sgra chen po yang byung / rang gi lus la bltas pas sngar gyi gos rnams ji bzhin bu+on 'dug /ser ba babs tsa na lus brdzi bar 'dug/sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa'i 'o dod chen po nig kyang shor/ gzugs med pa'i skad cig gis khyod khra phur shag dang zer byung / de ma thag 'gro dgos bsam pa'i snang ba shar tsa na/ khra phu na bslebs 'dug /sde pa dpon g.yog rnams khra phu na bslebs 'dug cing / chang zom gang sar/ thab la ja rgyab/ btsun pa gnyis kyi zhal thang rnams bkram/ mchod pa bshams pa'i grabs mdzad kyin 'dug /der rang gi bsam pa la tshes bdun gyi mchod pa yin nam bsam pa byung / yul nas mi gcig sleb gnyis sleb snge pa'i drung gi sku gzhogs su sleb ste/ de thams cad kyis sde pa'i drung la chang 'dren zhing / sems gso'i gtaspo mang du lab kyin 'dug /de nas gnyer pa bde chen grags/ pa bslebs nas/ spos shel dang bel le byu ru rgyan cha rnams/ ras la dril nas gtor khang gi nang du bzhag song / sde pa'i drung la 8

yang snga ma'i bag chags kyis sde pa'i drung gi bzhugs gdan gyi sna rtse non tsam byas nas bsdad pas/ sde pa la gsol ja zhus nas mi gzhan rnams la yang byin song / nga la ma byin par 'goms nas song bas ja yis ma langs pa yin mod bsam pa byung / de nas sde pa'i drung gi a drung tshe ring rab brtan la ja rgyab bskur song / khos ja de nas ja 'jog cig byas nas sog khug gi nang du bcug song / nga'i bsam pa la rdza chung la ja nyes pas las 'di 'dra byed pa bsams nas dpon g.yog gnyis ka la khrel byung / de nas yang gsol ba gcig zhus song ba la nga dang sde pa mnyam du bgyi yang mi zer/sde pas bskor tsha mnyam du zos kyang mi gsung bar 'dug /nga la logs su yang byin ma byung bas/ rang la za dbang ni mi 'dug bsam nas/ yi mug cing mchi ma mang du shar/ yang nga'i bsam pa la a tsa ma chos byed byas pas chos byed du ma bcug /rang pha ma dang mnyam du sdod ma bcug /khyod kyi skyid khag nga yis theg zer zhing / chos byed du mi 'drug par 'jig rten gyi bya bar bcug /da g.yag g.yog 'di tsho'i byed lugs dang / sde pa'i drung gi mdzad spyod kyang mthun pa 'dug /nga la za dbang dang 'thung dbang ni mi 'dug /nga rang chos la 'gro dgos snyam ste/ dgon pa'i sgo'i phyir 'thon pa dang / kha nang du log pa gcig byas la sde pa'i drung la/ dang po nga rang pha ma'i gces phrug chos byed pa'i dbang yod dus ni/ khyod kyis ya byed khu byed kyis lung pa khengs/ da ni za dbang dang 'thung dbang yang med/ mi rnams kyi kha la nyan nas za gral dang 'thung gral nas bton/ spyir gyi skyos pa 10

rnams la gzhung dang rkang mi 'dug /sgos sde pa g.yul rgyal phun tshogs la gzhung phyi thag mi 'dug ga /rang gi pha mas byin pa'i rgyan cha rnams bsdams/ dang por lha mor mthong / da ni khyi ltar 'khyams/ lab pa'i rjes ni chu la dbyug pa rgyab pa'i rjes tsam yang mi 'dug /bud med kyi skyid sdug de ske la thag pa ma skon tshun ngo mi shes zer ba de/ da lta nga'i thog tu byung ngo / /bu mo 'jig rten ma byas pa rnams chos bgyi zer lab rgyu'i bsam pa byung nga / /sde pa'i drung gis khyedacidapon g.yog tsho gson cig /sngar nga'i 'dod pa rbab yur 'tshengs su 'dug pas/ da khyod rnams nor dang 'dun mas 'tshengs par mdzod/ nga ni chos kyis 'tsheng bar byed do/ /sde pa'i drung thugs ma 'a༄/ོda pa mdzod cig byas nas/ chos la 'gro dgos bsam ste thol le phyin no/ /khong rnams ni 'khun thang nge sdod de/ nga la ma 'gro zer khan gcig kyang ma byung / der phu ya gi mi ma yin mang po skad shub shub byed kyin 'dug /de rnams kyi gtam la nyan pas/ ma gi yul dge bcu lung pa na/ ston mo yod pa yin 'dug /nged rang tsho 'gro bar bya yi zer gom pa ring thung med par song / ngas kyang khong rnams kyi rjes la phyin tsa na/ skad cig de ka la dge bcu kun dga' gling du bslebs/ gzim khang la 'gro dgos bsam nas sngar 'dris pa'i khyi thams cad rmugs shing 'dug pas 'jigs nas 'gro ma nus/ dbu mdzad kyi spyil por rtogs ldan cig gis 11

gtor ma gtong ba'i skad cig 'dug /der chu dang gtor ril mang po phyir bskyur byung bas/ rigs drug gi sems can mang po der 'dus nas/gtor chu dang gtor ril la/ sha rul dang sbang ma la sbrang ma rub pa lta bu 'dug /bos pa'i mgron rnams kyis thob/ de'i lhag ma bshal chu ma bos pa'i mgron rnams kyis khyer/ de 'og dbang chung ba'i mgron rnams kyis gang yang ma thob par bkres shing skom pa'i sdug bsngal gyis kha sa la sbub nas 'o dod 'bod do/ /la la ni gcig gis gcig la bzung nas ngu gin 'dug /nga rang drag pa'i khul gyis bag chags kyis ngo tsha nas der 'gro ma nus/ de rnams mthong ba'i snying rje drag po skyes kyang rang la ster rgyu ni med/long bas long ba khrid pa lta bu yin bsams nas ngu 'bod chen po shar/de dus gzugs med pa'i bud med kyi skad lhang nge ba cig gis/tre —sngon bsags dge ba'i 'bras bu med dang gcig /rang rang las kyi sdug bsngal myong dang gnyis/ /gang zag dmigs rgyu chung ba gsum 'dzoms la//sdug bsngal byas pas mi phan klod la zhog /ces zer gyi 'dug pas de ma thag tu nga rang gi pha ma gnyis snying la dran/ zag rum du 'gro dgos bsam pa'i snang ba byung ba dang / yud tsam zhig la zag rum du bslebs/ der a ma lags zag rum dgon pa'i mchod khang la zhabs bskor mdzad krin 'dug/nga yis a ma/ la skad gsang pos nga la ltos shig dang / skom zhig gnang dang byas pas/ a mas lan cang med par bskor ba la byon song / nga'i ltar

bsam pa la ngas 'og tu rta zhon/ mdun du 'khyos ma'i 'u lag 'das nas yong tsa na/ a ma lags kyis nga'i bu mo sleb byung gsung gis/ bsu chang dang bcas pas dgyes po rang mdzad pa las/ da lan a ma'i spyan gyis mi gzigs pa mdzad kyin 'dug /nga'i sngon du sde pa'i drung las yi ge zhig 'byor ba yin no/ /rang gi phru gu la mi bsam par/ mi'i bu la bsam rgyu yin pa 'dug bsam pa'i kho thag chad pa cig byung / slar yang bskor khang gi phyi la phyin te a ma'i na bza' la 'jus nas/ sngar 'jig rten la pha ma gnyis gros mthun du byas nas btang ba yin pas/ bskos tshad thod pa'i ri mo la bkod pa yin bsam/ sde pa'i drung gis shar mo khong rang gis brten nas gdug gtag tshur btang / bka' bapyo+on sogs mang du mdzad kyang /bu mo'i lus 'di dka' ba spyod dgos pa yin yong bsam nas pha ma la yang snyan gtser ma zhus/ da ni rang la bu tsha med pa'i gshis kyis za gral dang 'thung gral nas bton/ rkang dang phyi thag med pa'i bya ba mang du byas byung /da ni byed rgyu chos las med/ da lan gyi lab gzhi gleng gzhi 'di'i skor las/pha ma la nyes bka' ma/dzad mi 'jug pas/ de ring nga la lto zhig gnang dang /nga chos la 'gro ba yin byas kru/nga / phyoṭa mas ma thos ma mthong ba bzhin byas nas nang la theg song bas/ sems yi thang chad nas mchi ma mang du shor/yang bsam blo la/ rang gis blo gtad pa'i grogs dang g.yog 'khor rnams kyis mthong med pa'i rjes su/ pha ma gnyis la res kyang 'di 13

ka yin pa 'dug bsam pa byung / a mas shag ma zer kyang a ma'i rjes la nang du phyin pas/ khong rang dpon g.yog tsho gsol ba bzhes krin 'dug/nga la ni lto zos kyang mi zer/ mig kyang mi blta bar 'dug /ngas a ma'i rgyab tu sdod nas/ a mas lto zhig byin yewa bsam na yang byin ma byung /khong rang rnams lta za zhing yar bshad mar bshad mang po lab nas phyi la thon song / nga rang yang thams cad khros 'dug bsam nas phyi la 'thon phyin pas/sems mi dga' bar yi chad nas sa la 'gyel mchi ma mang du shor/ yang nga'i bsam pa la grub chen nor bu bkra shis kyi gsung la/ khaṃ ba'i dus na bar do'i snang tshul 'di 'dra dang 'di 'dra yong gsungs pa rnam/sa lam gyis dran byung / nga shi ba yin pa 'dra snyam pas lus la grib ma yod med bltas pas/ /lus la grib ma yang min 'dug /gom pa phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pas rdo skad dang sdig sga yang mi 'dug /a tsa ma nga shi ba los yin bsam nas yi mug cing mi yul du sdod yun ni bug pa nas bltas pas dkar khung lta bu skyem tsam zhig las ma byung / chos byas pa'i gdeng tshad ni med/rang dbang yod dus sbyin pa 'di btang zer rgyu ni med/ gshin rje rnams kyis da lta rang bzung yong bsam pa'i sdug bsngal gyis 'o dod chen po shar zhing 'gyel song / de'i tshe bud med ras dkar po'i gos gyon pa/ skra rgyab tu bcings pa/ lag na ḍā ma ru khyer ba cig gis nga'i dpung pa nas bzung ste yar bslangs nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /kye ma sdug bsngal ma byed yar longs dang / /nyon mongs byung dus gnyen po ma sleb na/ /chos yod zer ba 14

rdzun dang tshig lcub yin/ /skye zhing 'chi ba mi yi bsod nams yin/ /yang dang yang du yong bar thub pas gsungs/ /'chi ba 'di ni khyod nyid gcig pu min/ /thams cad 'gro ba'i lam po che 'di la/ /nga yis grogs byas bde mor 'gro yong ang / /zhes sems gso gnang du byung bas nga rang yang mo'i rjes la 'gro dgos snyam nas/ a ma la nga bsdad dus ni a mas bza' btung yang ma byin/ da nga 'gro dgos pa'i dus shig sh+tsang bas a ma yang ma 'gyod pa mdzod cig byas/ nga rang thag chod chod rang 'dra ba byas kyang / sems a ma dang 'bral ma phod pa'i stabs kyis nga la rjes bsnyeg cing sleb yong ngam bsam pa'i re ba byas nas zur mig lta zhing phyin pas/nga'i rjes la yong mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug /de nas rang gi yul ni ri chen po cig gis bsgribs song sems skyo chod nge ba'i ngang nas mchi ma 'don zhing phar phyin pa'i sa na/ lam kha phrag gsum 'dug pa'i bar ma de la zhugs nas phyin pas/ nyi ma lho nub kyi phyogs nas ri chen po rtse zing nge ba yod pa cig gi steng nas/ nga rang gi a khu lags yin zer ba dbu 'gro yom me ba/ phyag na phreng ba nag po ༄rtogs pa/phyag zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling nge ba mdzad cing nga'i ming nas 'bod pa dang / khyod kyi lam nor song gsung zhing 'di skad zer to/ /'khor ba rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang shed na/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal nya mo 'khyug 'dra yod/ /khyod rig 'dzin thar pa sgrub 'dod na/ /blo zhe sdang spongs la yar 15

shog dang / /nga ni 'jig rten 'gro ba kun gyi lha/ /mun pa sel ba'i sgron me nga yin pas/ /khyod rig 'dzin bde ba thob 'dod na/ /blo phrag dog spongs la yar shog dang / /zhes gsungs shing lam dang 'od zer ngo sprod mang du gnang byung bas/nga rang gi lag pa dpral bar bkab nas yar la 'gro dgos bsam pa dang / rlung dmar chen po zhig langs nas/ dbang med du nam mkha' la btegs nas yar khyer mar brdabs byas/ mig gis blta snang la mgo brnyan sna rigs mi gcig pa/ mig 'bur tshugs su lta ba/ mche ba 'phang thung tsam yar zing mar zing yod pa/ lus la stag gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi bu+on pa/ rus pa'i rgyan chas brgyan pa mi'i thod pa lag tu khyer nas klad pa bldag pa/ la la ni mi'i rgyu ma 'dom la 'jal ba/ la la ni mi'i rkang pa nas bzung ste/ phye mar gshags nas sha za ba dang / la la ni mtshon cha'i rigs sna tshogs nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/zhal nas hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dang rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra sgrog pa/ de rnams kyi dkyil du tshud nas rlung bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin yar brdabs mar brdabs mang du byung bas/ de'i dus su ni pha ma dang gnyen nye ba grogs dga' mdza' rnams yid la dran long yang ma byung / de'i mod la thang chen po zhig gi mtha' ru skyel byung / der bslebs pa dang rlung rnams kyang zhi nas mig gis mthong sa me da pa la/ rna ba'i thos snang la/ rgyob rgyob so/da sod kyi sgra 'brug 1dze

stong ldir ba tsam byung yang / en tsam gyi sdug bsngal/ chung ngu song bas/rang gi pha ma dang gnyen nye ba grogs dga' mdza' thams cad yid la dran kyang pha ma'i mtshan nas brjod 'o 0)da chen po rgyab/ 'gro bar bya yi zer gros phar ma byas/ pha mas kyang 'gro 'dod kyi gtam tshur ma bshad/ nga gcig phur gtong ba'i phod tshod shin tu che ba zer nas khrel log byed cing ngus pas/sngar gyi bud med ḍā ma ru khyer ba de bslebs byung /ngas de'i na bza' la 'jus te/ a lce lags thang 'di'i ming la ji skad zer/ pha gi'i grong khyer chen po de su'i yin ming la ci zer a lce khyed rang gi mtshan la ci zer/ nga la pha ma dang grogs dga' mdza' gnyen nye 'khor mang du yod kyang nga 'gro 'dod kyi gros kyang med par dbang med du 'dir bslebs byung / da nga'i rgyan cha 'di rnam sa a lce khyed rang gi phyag tu bzhes la/ da yul du log chog pa'i thabs dang lngardzos shig gnang bar zhu dang byas nas mang du ngus pas/ bud med de'i zhal nas/ khyod rang ma rig pa tshabs ches pas/ rang snang dgra ru langs pa yin/ nacha/ mkha'i kha spyod lta bu'i thang 'di ni/ spu gri bye thang yang zer/ sdig po che dmyal ba'i gnas la 'gro ba'i lam yang yin/ pha gi grong khyer chen po de ni glos/thang si grong khyer chen po yang zer/ dmar khams sgang gi yu/la yang zer/ gshin yul gyi grong khyer chen po zer ba de yin/ khyod kyis nga ngo shes na gas/nga mtshan ye shes rdo rje ma zhes zer te/ khyed rang dang nga gnyis grogs mo yin/17

nged rang gnyis lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas yod do/ /khyod rang gi lus sha khrag gi phung po gnyen 'khor nor rdzas dang bcas pa rnams dbang med shul du bzhag /sdig sgrib rnam smin khur du 'khur nas da lta bar do'i gnas 'dir sleb pa yin/ 'di nas rang yul du log par 'dod na mi lus thob pa'i dus su dam pa'i chos byas/ bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ ngan slong la sbyin pa btang / gnyan sa ri khrod 'grims/ 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs/ sems nyid la brtan pa thob par byed dgos zer byung bas/de ma thag tu bar snang nas spu gri char babs/ sa gzhi nas ral gri'i tshal yang skyes/ mi rnams mgo lus med par dum bur gtubs nas sa gzhi khengs pa 'dug pa mthong bas nga dran med du brgyal/ brgyal ba sangs pa dang / a tsa ma nga shi ba yin nam byas pas/ a lce des khyod rang gi lus ni mi yul dran pa sgang du bor/ gnyen nye 'khor rnams la la ni khyod rang gi phung po la lta/ la la ni ming nas 'bod cing ngu/ la la ni dge rtsa'i grabs gshom byed/ la la ni ma thos sangs rgyas su 'dug zer bas/nga shi ba yin pa 'dug bsam pa'i sdug bsngal dang / chos byed long yod dus chos ma byas pa'i 'a༄/ོda pa dang / sdig pa ci byas bsam pa'i bsam blo zhib mor btang bas/ sdig pa rang bsags pa gcig las min 'dug pas/da nga 'di nas yar la 'thon pa'i dus gcig mi yong ngam snyam ste smre sngags de ltar shor ro/ /kye ma kyi hud las ngan bsags pa yi/ /sdig can mi rnams 18

'grims pa'i bar do 'dir/ /sleb na gzhan gyis bya thabs mi 'dug pas//rang dbang yod dus dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /bsags pa'i nor la snying po mi 'dug pas/ /nor zas gang yod dkon mchog gsum la phul/ /byas pa'i las la snying po mi 'dug pas/ /bya ba 'jog la yi dam bsnyen sgrub mdzod/ /gnyen 'khor 'dzoms kyang snying po mi 'dus/ pas/ /gdung sems chod la gnyan sa ri khrod 'grims/ /mi lus thob dus lha chos ma byas na/ /bya ba gang la'ang snying po mi 'dug go /'dod chags zhe sdang phrag dog rnams spongs la/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa 'dag phyir du/phyag dang bskor ba mdzod la yig drug sgrongs/ /sems nyid ting nge 'dzin la gnas spro5 4 ༈dzod/ /de ltar ma byas na yul 'di bgrod pa'i thabs gzhan nas btsal kyang rnyed par mi 'dug go /ces zer zhing rang gi brang la lag pas re mos su brdung mchi ma mang du shor zhing / chos ma byas pa'i 'gyod pa bltas mi zin pa byung /yang a lce de la/ ngas chos ma byas kyang sdig pa mang po bsags bsam pa ni med/ nga rlung dmar chen pos btegs/ /rgyob rgyob sod sod zer ba'i sgra dang 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu de'i khrod du khrid/ 'od zer kha dog mang po'i dkyil du 'thums te/ dngangs skrag dang 'jigs snang dpag tu med pa byung ba de gang yin zhus pas/ bud med de'i zhal nas/ khyod rlung dmar chen pos btegs pa de ni gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis bsu ba yin/19

mgo brnyan sna chu+o+ogar+sā/ kyis rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra sgrog pa de ni/ rang lus rgyal/ ba'i dkyil/ 'khor gyi yi dam/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams yin/ lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs khyer ba de nyon mongs kyi rtsa ba bag chags gcod pa'i brda yin kyang / khyod kyi rang snang dgra ru langs te de mtshon char mthong ba yin/zhal/ nas chos sgrar gyur kyang khyod kyi snang ba log nas rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra ru go ba yi/na/ de rnams la skyabs su mchi snyam pa gyis/ 'od zer kha dog ma nga du 'phro ba de yi dam/ zhi khro'i tshogs rnams kyi 'od dang rgyal ba rigs lnga'i 'od/ lam/ yin/ de rnams la skyabs su mchi bsam pa'i mos pa gyis/sgra thams cad rang sgra/ 'od thams cad rang snang gi 'od/ zer thams cad rang zer/ sgra dang 'od zer thams cad rang la shar ba yin pas rang snang dgra ru ma langs/ khyod sdig pa che ba ma yin/ da dus snyigs ma'i sems can dug lnga rag pa tsho dmyal bar ltung gis dogs nas/ mi yul dran pa sgang du 'phrin pa byed rgyu yin/de nas sems brtan par gyis zhib par ltos/ ma/thong ba dang thos pa kun ma brjedapar yid la zung zhig /da nged rang gnyis pha gir 'gro zer nas phyin nga/sa// nga rang 'gro snying ma 'dod kyang a lce de so/nga bas de'i phyis bzhin phyin/ thang de'i nub phyogs nas// mi'i lus la sha ba'i mgo can lag na 'gas nga/ nag dro/ ༄1gas pa/ mig 'bur tshugs su nam mkha'i kham sa la blta ba/ lce dar yug tsam brkyang pa zhig gis rgan mo mgo la gzi mchong 20

btags pa gcig bdas nas byung ba/ nga rang gis zla grogs kyi bud med de la/ a tsa ma ya gi sha ba'i mgo can de su yin/ sngon la yong ba'i rgan mo dngangs skrag dang sdug bsngal myong ba de gang nas yin byas pas/ bud med de'i zhal nas/ khyod rang skrag mi dgos/ sha ba'i mgo can ni rang gi lcags mkhar thod pa'i gzhal yas nas/ yi dam thod pa'i lha tshogs yin /de yang shar nub lho byang thams cad du rang rang gi khams dang bstun pa'i kha dog so sor 'char ba yong / sngon la yong ba'i rgan mo sdug bsngal myong mkhan de ni/ khams ji snying zhes bya ba de nas yin/ grong tsho sum cu so bdun yod/ ar jag rkun gsum dang / bdag med kyi ri dwags bshor ba/ log pa'i lam la 'jug pa'i rgan dpon gyi chung ma yin te / sdug bsngal 'di rnams bar do'i snang tshul/ yin/ da rung 'di nas lam dkar nag gi shan 'byed byas nas sdug bsngal mnar med du 'gro ba yo/da do zer/yang phar phyin pas/ ri zur gsum/ btsan gyi bshas 'dra ba/mdog ni glo ba chu yis bshal ba lta bu 'dug /de'i byang phyogs na lcags kyi shal ma ri rtse gsum sa la zug pa/ rtse lnga gnam la gzings shing rtse lnga sa la gtan pa ri mo khra shig ge ba dang / ngar ngar tshig tshig yod pa/ de'i mdun na mi dar rgan du song ba mgo la rbad mgo yod pa mdun so chag pa zhig shin rje rnams kyis mdun nas lcags kyus bzung / rgyab nas mdung gis bdas/rdo sran chung gi rdo 'dra ba pang pos lon tshad gcig rgyab tu bkal nas 'dug 31

pas/ /de ma thag tu lcags kyi shal ma ri'i rtse nas/ lus thams cad gnyer mas gang zhing bzhin mi sdug pa lngas/ ngu 'bod byed cing nang pa pe spras pa lags khyed gar bzhugs yod pa/ nged ma bu rnams khyed dang 'bral ma phod par/ khyed gar yod kyi sar yong dgos pa byung ngo zer ba la mi de'i skad du byas nas/ nga 'di na yod de skyid po mi 'dug go /bu smad tsho 'dir yong ba'i gnas med do zer / der gshin rje rnams kyis khyod la chags pa'i bu smad dang bsags pa'i nor zas yod do zer zhing zhags pa nag pos bcings te/ lcags kyi shal ma ri'i logs la yar 'drud song bas/sha rnams shal ma ri la 'khon zhing rtse mor sleb pa dang / kho rang gi bu smad yin zer ba de rnams lcags kyi bya khra can du song nas/ mi de'i sha dang klad pa dang mig rnams bton nas zos pas na tsha dang sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa byung ngo / /yang rang gi las kyi sdug bsngal khor yug tu myong dgos pa'i stabs kyis/ rus pa la sems chags te lus sngar ltar gsos song bas/yang kho rang gi bu smad yin zer ba de rnams shal ma ri'i rtsa bar bslebs nas/sngar bzhin 'bod kyin 'dug /yang gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis sngar bzhin lab nas mar 'drud nas byung / lus kyi sha dang nang khrol thams cad shal ma ri la 'khon te/ rtsa bar sleb pa dang / kho rang gi bu smad yin zer ba de rnams zangs kyi khyi mo can du song nas sha dang rus pa thams cad sngar bzhin 23

zos rung / lus sngar ltar chags nas bcu log byed cing dngangs skrag chen po'i nang nas ngu 'bod dpag tu med pa byed kyin 'dug go/der nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med des 'di skad ces zer to/ /byang phyogs ga na rje'i rgyal po tshur gson dang / /sngon nas bsod nams bsags pas mi lus thob/ /dbang po tshang zhing rnam rig bkra ba la//'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal dngangs skrag myong dgos pa/ /mi yul sdod dus bya ba ci zhig byas/ /gshin rje rnams kyang ha cang phod tshod che/ /bdag gis len pa las ngan dag dus yod/ /bcing pa khrol la mi yul 'phrin bskur 'tshal/ /zhes zer ba dang / gshin rje rnams kyis 'di skad ces zer to//nged rnams phod tshod che ba ma yin te/ /snga ma gang byas phyi ma'i lam sna yin// mi yul dran pa sgang du sdod pa'i dus/ /bla ma dkon mchog dbu 'phang 'di yis smad/ /bstan rtsa dge 'dun sde ni 'di yis dkrugs//kun dang mi mthun bya ba mang du byas/ /dpon bzang phrag tu bkal nas 'phrog bcom byas/ /rang nor mi spyod gser las mdzangs pa bzhin/ /mi nor yod med mi lta bzhig rgyus bton/ /'u lag phar bkal rkang gla tshur la blangs/ /bdag yod bdag med bud med khrom sbyor byas/ /zhe sdang ser sna 'dod chags mkhan khyod la/ /da lta 'di na skyid po e 'dug ltos/ /da rung 'dis kyang 'thus pa mi 'dug pas/ /khyod kyi yul na dge rtsa btang 23

ba'i dus/ /chu bo chen po bgrod pa'i pho brang che/ /de nas gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ /dkar nag las kyi shan 'byed byas nas kyang / /sdig pa can gyi 'gro sa dmyal ba yin/ /khyod la mtho ris thob pa'i bskal ba me da/ /ces dang / 'on kyang bud med khyod kyis zhu ba byas pa la brten nas bcing pa khrol la bsdams pa klod/ khyod rang mi yul dran pa sgang la 'phrin pa bskur rgyu yod na skur cig zer ro/ /mi de ni gshin rje rnams kyi gsung dang / rang gi snang ba bdun 'gyur las gsal bas/ rang dbang yod dus dkon mchog gi zhabs tog sogs/ dge ba'i las ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yang dran rgyu med/ sdig pa'i las bsags pa ni bye ma'i grangs las mang ba dran/ a tsa ma bya ba ngan pa de rnams byas pa dran nas dbang med du ngu 'bod shar/ lag pa gnyis kyis rang gi brang brdung / lus 'di krong du ma chags par dran med du 'gyel song / de nas nged zla grogs kyi bud med des/ mi de'i dpung pa nas yar 'then nas 'di skad du/ rang dbang yod dus lha chos ma byas par/ /'di ru bslebs dus ngus pas ci la phan/ /sdig pa'i las la 'gyod sems drag po yis/ /ma mgal khar chug snying la rus pa skyed/ /dkon mchog zhabs tog spu tsam ma byas pas/ /sdig can 'di 'dra yong ba snying re rje/ /'on kyang sdig pa bshags pas dag thabs yod/ /dran pa sgang la/ phrin pa zhib par skur/ /zhes zer ba dang /34

mi de'i kha nas a tsa ma las ngan tsho+ogs ma bsags pa nga'i yul ni gtsang bde chen bsam steng zer ba de nas yin/ grong tsho bcu gnyis tsam gyi nang pa yin/ nga rang la bu gnyis dang bu mo gnyis skye dam/na dang bcas pa yod/ gzhan yang g.yog 'khor nye ba bla mchod dang bcas pa yod pas de rnams la 'phrin 'di ltar gyis dang zer zhing 'di skad du/ /bsags pa'i nor la snying po mi 'dug pas/ /gang yod dge ba'i phyogs la thongs/ shig gyis/ /mthun par 'grogs kyang snying po mi 'dug pas/ /mi lus thob dus dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /smra ba mkhas kyang snying po mi 'dug pas//ma yengs yi ge drug ma rgyun du sgrongs/ /'jig rten mkhas kyang snying po mi 'dug pas/ /ma yengs bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgoms shig gyis/ /bdag gis sdig pa byas pa'i bshags pa la/ //mchod rten brgya rtsa bzhengs la na bza' phul/ /gser las grub pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum dang //gsung rab rdor gcod sdig bshags 'bri klog gyis/ /sgrub sde mi gcig chos sde brgya rtsa la / /mang ja bsnyen bkur 'bul ba so sor phul/ /rgyal khams 'grims pa'i bla ma ma ṇi bar/ /bkur sti zhabs tog bsngo rten zong skur phul/ /gzhan yang ser snas bsags pa'i nor zas rnams/ /'jig rten khyim pa rnams la ma 'gyod thongs/ /bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pa spyan drongs/ la/ /dam chos na rag dong sprugs tshugs gyis dang / /de ltar bshags pa byas shing grub pa na/ /sdug bsngal 'di las thar dus yong las che/ /dran pa sgang gi 'jig rten mi rnams la/ /nga dang 'dra ba'i sdig las ma byed 25

gyis/ /zhes zer to/ /de nas gzhin rje rnams kyis zhags pa nag pos bcings te khrid song ngo / /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang ri de'i nub phyogs su phyin pas/ thal tshan gyi thang chen po dkyus lnga rgyang grags gnyis tsam yod pa/ de'i 'gram na skyes pa gzhon nu gzugs byad legs pa/ ske la phag pa'i mche ba btags pa/ gos dmar po dang al pags dkar po rgyu+on pa gcig /gshin rje rnams kyis lcags kyus mgrin pa nas bzung ste/ thal tshan gyi thang chen po de la 'drud nas song / me ma mur de'i dkyil du sleb pa dang / sprin khol ba lta bu lus tshig nas/ bal skud tsam/ phor pa tsam/ sgo nga tsam khol zhing rtsa dang rus pa ma 'bral ba tsam gyis bar nas khrag dang chu ser mang po 'thon yong gi 'dug /der yang nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med des/ nub phyogs kyi gshin rje rnams la 'di skad du/ gshin rje khyod rnams bdag la tshur gson dang / /gzugs legs dbang po bkra bar skyes pa la/ /'di 'dra'i dngangs skrag sdug bsngal myong dgos pa/ /mi yul sdod dus ci 'dra byas pa yin/ /zhes zer bas/gshin rje rnams kyi zhal nas/ /mi 'dis mi lus rin chen thob pa'i dus/ /nag po sdig pa'i las ka 'ba' zhig byas/ /chu la gnas pa'i srog chags mang po bsad/ /da lta 'di rnams bar do'i snang tshul yin/36

/da rung chu bo bgrod pa'i pha rol na/ /gshin rje sde dpon chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ /dkar nag las kyi brtsi grangs byas nas kyang / /dpyal ba'i sdug bsngal du ma myong dgos yod/ /'on kyang bud med khyod kyis zhus pa dang / /'di la shes bzhin sdig pa mi 'dug pas/ /mi yul dran pa sgang gi gnyen 'khor la/ /'phrin pa bskur rgyu yod na skur ba chog /ces zer ba dang /mi de'i kha nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /kye ma tshogs ma bsags pa'i sdig can nga / /skye sa gtsang gi lung dmar phyogs nas yin/ /lto gos dbang gis pha ma gnyis kyis khrid/ /sdod pa'i gnas ni lho stod lung par byas/ /nga yi ming la bkra shis don grub zer/ /dge sdig brtsi grangs yod pam shes pas/ /sems can kun la gnod pa mang po bskyal/ /khyad par nya dol btsugs nas grangs med bsad/ /rnam smin rang gi thog tu smin byung bos/ /pha ma gnyis la 'phrin pa 'di ltar mdzod/ /spyir gyi sems can kun la sgong rje sgoms/ /sgos su chu nang nya rnams ma gsod gyis/ /nga yi nya dwol gang yod gri yis gtubs/ /lcags kyu rnams ni rdo yis rdungs shig gyis/ /nga yi sdig pa byas pa dag phyir du/ /rgyal khams 'grim pa'i bla ma spuṇi ba/ /rang gi khyim du spyan drongs bsnyen bkur zhu/ /ma ṇi 'dren mi rnams la khri chang thongs / /nga yi lus chas tshang ma bla mar phul/ /bsngo ba moṇi'i skyel ma zhu gyis dang / /zhes dang / nga mi yul du sdod dus phyogs 27

nas bla ma ma ṇi ba gcig phebs byung bas/ nga rang la dbang med pa'i gzhis kyis 'bul ba zhabs tog zhu rgyu ni ma/ byung / nga rang gi me lcags khug ma dang bcas pa phul nas bdag thugs la 'dags par zhu zhus pas/ khang gis rgyal khams la ma ṇi bskul ba'i phan yon ni/ gshin rje rnams kyi zhal nas/ khyod mi yul du sdod pa'i dus su/ khyod kyis nya rnams gson por rjen bcos nas zos pa'i rnam par smin pani/ khyod rang gi lus kyi pags pa gson por bshus nas khrims stegs chen po'i steng du sta gris gtsabs/tho bas brdungs nas/ zhib rtsis nas dang sran ma tsam bcos dgos rgyu yin te/ khyod kyis bla ma ma ṇi ba la ma ṇi'i bskul ma gcig bskur 'dug pas/de nas rgyal khams la ma ṇi bskul ba'i phan yon gyis 'dir ma ṇi brgya rtsa gosum bslebs byung bas/ des 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal de las thar ra gsungs byung /da rung sdig pa gzhan dag dam chos rdo rje gcowa pa klog gyis/ ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i grub chen pho mo la gtor phye skyol nas bar do'i chab gtor thongs / gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi bya ba rdosprudod chags zhe sdang phrag dog nga rgyal rnams spongs la/ dam pa'i lha chos la 'bungs shig gyis dang /rtos ma byas na 'di ru sleb ste skyid po mi 'dug go zer zhing / da rung sdug bsngal ma sangs par gzhin rje rnams kyis khrid song ngo / /28

i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ /yang ri chen po de'i lho phyogs na/ 'di nas bltas na dud pa'i chu chen po/ phar phyogs nas bltas na srid pa'i chu chen zer ba/ chu de'i che chung ni 'dzam bu gling gi chu thams cad der 'dus pa tsam 'dug /chu de'i rlangs pa dgrar ka'i na bun lta bu 'ja' tshon gyi rigs su 'dug /de las lcags kyi zam pa chen po zheng la rta pa sum cu tsam rta spungs byas nas 'gro bas shong ba/ de'i gdong na zam pa ring po lcags las grub pa 'dug /de'i nyi ma shar phyogs na grong khyer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug/grong khyer de rnams kyi nang na skyid sdug mi snyoms par/ la la ni khyim legs po rab gsal mchong brtsegs brgyan pa'i nang du bu mo mang po rgyan chas brgyan pa/ btsun pa gos legs por ngu+on pa/ mi rgan po snum zhag che ba lag tu 'phreng ba bzung zhing ma ṇi bgrang pa/ la la ni glu len/ /la la ni gar rtse/la la ni ma ṇi pa dang dbyangs 'then/ la la ni skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs byed/ da rung sbyin pa phar yang ster/ tshur yang mang du blangs chog pa/ de rnams la ni shi snyam pa'i sdug bsngal dang gshin rje'i 'jigs skrag ni spu tsam yang med cing shing gi 'bras bu rnams kyang phyi nas nang du gug nas longs spyod chog pa 'dug /la la ni mgo khebs tsam gyi khyim yang med pa'i khar lus la gos kyang med za rgyu dang 'thung rgyu yang med par ltogs shing skom pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba 'dug /la/ la ni lag pa dpral ba la bkab nas blta grin 'dug /de'i nang nas mi la la ni gshin rje rnams kyis khyod yong ran zer nas zhags pas khrid nas 'gro gin 'dug /29

der nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med des gshin rje rnams la 'di skad du/gzhin rje'i tshogs rnams bdag la tshur gson dang / /grong khyer 'di na skyid sdug mi snyoms par/ /la la ni bza' btung longs spyod phun sum tshogs shing // /glu gar rgyan dang dga' bde'i dpal la spyod/ /la la khyim med gos dang bral bas spru/nga / /ma chog bkres skom sdug bsngal dpag med 'dug /'di ltar yongaba'i rgyu rkyen gang las grub/ /grong khyer 'di ru sdod pa ji ltar yin/ zhes zer bas/gzhin rje de rnams kyi zhal nas/ 'dir khyim legs po rab gsal dang bcas pa'i nang na yod pa'i mi rnams ni/ bar mi yul du sdod pa'i dus/rang gi khyim gang ltar legs par byas nas/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan drangs/ rtogs ldan pho mo gang nas byon kyang / gtsang sbra che bar byas te gnas tshang dang bkur sti zhabs tog gang drag phul bas/ 'dir skyid pa yin/ glu len cing gar rtse ba rnams ni/ mi'i yul dran pa sgang du sdod pa na/bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la mchod pa'i glu gar gyi gzigs mo phul ba'i phan yon yin/ ma ṇi pa dbyangs gdangs skyabs 'gro gsol 'debs byed pa po 'di rnams ni bla ma ma ṇi ba rnams spyan drangs nas ma ṇi'i gzhi bzung nas bskul ma dang / dam bcas blangs nas ma chag par bgrangs pa'i phan yon dang bag chags kyis/ nged gshin rje rnams kyis lta mi bzod pa yin/sbyin pa len rung dang gtong rung yod pa rnams ni/ mi yul dran pa sgang du ci 30

yod sbyin pa btang ba'i phan yon yin no/ /'dir sdod dgos pa ni/ la la dge rtsa'i grabs la 'gugs nas sdod/ la la ni zhag re zhag gnyis kyi tshe tshad dang zas grangs ma thebs par sdod pa yin/ yang khyim dang gos med par bkres skom sdug bsngal myong ba 'di rnams ni mi'i yul du sdod dus/bla ma dang rtogs ldan pho mo rnams la mal sa g.yar ba ma btang ba'i ba/ ra sku ra pa btab pa/ grwa rogs grogs mched rnams la kha smras byas pas/ ma byin par blangs/ tshogs ma bsags shing sbyin pa'i las 'brel nyung bas ltogs shing skom/ pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin/ lag par rang gi dpral ba la bkab nas lta ba 'di rnams ni rang gi grogs dang gnyen tshan rnams yid la dran/ re che bas nga'i rjes la za rgyu dang 'thung rgyu gyon rgyu zhig e yong na/nang na rgyas so bzang po med kyang phyi'i zhing dang nang gi cha phran bu yod pa rnams btsongs nas nga'i rjes la gtang yong ngam bsam nas mi yul la bya ra byed pa yin no/ /'di rnams dge rtsa nam byung ba dang / chu bo chen po bgrod pa'i pha rol na/ chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs te yod/ las dkar nag gi brtsi grangs byas nas/ la la ni mtho ris su 'gro/ la la ni ngan song du sdug bsngal myong du 'jug dgos pa yang yod do/ /zhes zer nas mi gcig khrid nas song ngo / /de nas mda' rgyang gang tsam phyin pa'i sa na yi dwags kyi gnas 'dug ste/ de rnams kyi cha lugs ni lus gcer bu yod pa/ lto ba ri'i ljongs tsam/ mgrin pa rta rnga tsam/ yan lag ljang ma tsam byas pas/skom pa'i sdug bsngal byu)sa kha la me 'bar ba/ ltogs pa'i sdug bsngal 31

bzod thabs med pa 'dug /der zang gis zla grogs bud med de la/ 'di lta bu'i gzugs brnyan dang sdug bsngal myong dgos pa ci yin byas pas/bud med de'i zhal nas/ kye ma 'di rnams mi lus lan re thob pa'i dus/yar gyi dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa ni/ nyin mo'i skar ma tsam yang 'bul ma myong / mar ngan slong la sbyin par btang med khar/ gzhan pa la yang kha bkag byas/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten nas bzhugs pa rnams la/ 'phrog bcom mang du byas pa'i rnam smin dang / ser sna'i dbang gis sdug bsngal 'di ltar myong dgos pa yin/ zhes dang / 'di rnams mi lus lan gcig thob pa'i dus su/ yar mchod mar sbyin dge ba gtong ba lta ci smos te/ rang za bar mi nus/ 'thung bar mi nus/ gzhan za ba dang 'thung ba sogs gang mthong yang ser sna'i sgo nas/ 'dod chags chu ltar 'khol/ zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ nga rgyal ri ltar slongs/ gti mug mun ltar 'thibs/ phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs/ sbyin pa la bgegs byas pa'i rnam par smin pas/ 'dir yi dwags kyi lus su grub nas sdug bsngal yun ring du myong ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs kyin 'dug /de'i dus su las 'bras kyi sbyin shugs med kyang / sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems can la gzigs nas/ de rnams kyi khrod du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs khar sa pa ṇi dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/phyag g.yon skyabs sbyin dang / g.yas mchod byin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i srin 32

mdzub kyi rtser+ṣanas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs kyin 'dug pa la/ yi dwags cho'ikas ma bsags pa rnams ni/ sangs rgyas la lta ba mi nus par bros 'gro ba 'dug /la/ la ni mig la lag pa bkab nas kha sbub tu ngu zhing 'dug/de'i nang nas mi'i yul du bsdad dus dge ba'i phyogs la dad pa cung zad skye ba rnams ni/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun lag mthil du bzed nas 'thung ba la/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal nas/ i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ i āḥ hrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs pas/ de rnams kyi khar bdud rtsi babs te 'grangs shing tshims nas bkres bskom 2) sdug bsngal las thar ba 'dug go /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas zam pa phar bgrod pa'i zam khar de'i sgo mdun na/ bu mo gzhon nu ma zhig lus bde zhing kha 'bur re ba yod pa cig glu len/ yang bro 'khrab/ yang mchi ma 'don byed krin 'dug pa la/nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med des 'di skad du/ 'di na 'dug pa'i bu mo gzugs legs ma/ /skye sa rigs brgyud ming la ji skad zer/ /glu gar rtse zhing ngu ba'i rgyu mtshan gang / /'di nas yar mar sa phyogs gang du 'gro//zhes zer zhing 'dri ba byed kyin 'dug pa la/ bu mo de'i zhal nas/ a tsa ma nga'i yul ni lho stod kyi phyogs nas yin/ grong gi mi nga la sne'u gdong zer ba yin/ pha'i ming la chos rgyal tshe ring zer/ a ma'i ming la ser chung zer/nga ra'i ming la rdo rje rgyal mo zer ba yin/ lung pa la sog po sleb pa'i dus su/ nga dbang med du sog pos khrid nas phyin pas mi mang po'i dkyil du nad 33

cig phog nas/ nga rang gi pha ma phrad long med par 'dir sleb byung / ngas chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs su phyin pas/ chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/bu mo khyod rigs bzang zhing blo gsal ba nga rgyal med pa gcig 'dug ste/ khyod pha ma dang nor zas la chags pa dang / tshe 'e lhag ma yang dum tsam 'dug pas/ khyod rang gi lung pa'i phur sman mo zhig tu skye ba long shog gsungs byung zer bas/ yang nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med des/ bu mo khyod nor zas la chags pa'i rgyu cis yin/ /zer bas/ bu mo des nga rang gi bar reg dang ske cha rnams bla ma/ la ma phul bar/ lho'i phyogs su khyer nas mig bltas mi mthun pa'i bu mo nasag la btsongs pas/ yid mi dga' zhing gshin rje'i 'jigs snang dang dngangs skrag byung yang / de ma brjed par snying la bcang ste bsdad pas/ de'i chags zhen gyis sman btsun du skye ba long shog zer gsung gi 'dug pas/ nga'i pha ma la 'phrin pa 'di ltar mdzod dang zer nas// rdo rje rgyal mo zer ba'i sman chung nga / /pha ma rgyan cha kun la chags 'dugs pas/ /nga la brtse ba'i drin can pha ma yis/ /nga yi lus cha gang yod bla mar phul/ /bskang bshags tshogs 'khor gtor ma badzo/ tshar thongs/ /yul mi khyim mtshes kun la dge chang drongs/ /de ltar byas na sman btsun skye ba las/ /thar nas mi lus thob pa 'dug go gyis/ /zhes zer nas mchi ma 'don zhing yar song ngo / /34

e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang zam khar de'i sgo'i mdun du lga dang g.yer ma'i dri ma chil le ba byung // der lga dang g.yer ma ras shog bu la sogs pa'i khur tsa chen po ri rab tsam 'khur ba'i rgan mo mig rtsa dmar ba skra phyed skya phyed sngo mdud pa rgyab pa'i sne mo spyi khebs la bskor ba cig /gzhin rje pho nya rnams kyis zhags pas khrid/ rgyab nas mdung gis/ bdas nas/ byung ste/ sa dang khur tsa gnyis kyi bar nas nga la mig 'bur tshugs su blta zhing /bu mo 'di gang nas yin zer gyin 'dug pa la/ nga yi zla grogs kyis bud med des 'di skad ces zer to/ /za dbang med pa'i khur tsa chen po 'khur// ma dun nas khrid cing mtshon chas mjug nas 'ded/ /dpon bzang bka' blon yin nam dbyen bdag ma/ /yang na tshong 'dus chen mo'i gnas chen ma/// sde zhol chen po'i chang tshong gcig yin nam/ /'di ltar yong ba'i rgyu rkyen ji ltar yin/ /khyod kyi gnyen 'khor grogs dang bu tsha dang / /yul phyogs gang yin ming la ji skad zer/ /nga dang mnyam du yod pa'i bu mo 'di// dge bcu kun dga' gling gi bla ma'i sras/ /(myum sring mang du yod pa'i 'bring ma yin/ /dkar nag shi gson bar gyi 'phrin pa byed/ ces zer ba dang / skye dman rgan mo de lag pas brang brdung zhing mig mchi mas gang nas/ a tsa ma/ nga'i skyid sdug de zad nas mi 'dug /khyod kyi gdong la bltas na chos rje kun dga' gling pa'i zhal ras 'dra mo rang 'dug /nga mi yul nas yong dus khong 35

yu/ma gyi lhums su zhugs nga/'i grabs kyang med/ sngar phan chad nas lcags ma khar sgo med kyi nang du sdod dgos/ pa byung / de ring tshes bco lnga yin pas nga lcags mkhar sgo med nas bton te/ dmyal ba yang so sa su byung ba yin/de ring dmyal ba yang sos su yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nga rang mi yul du yod dus nged ma smad gnyis kyis/ rgyal ba khu dbon gyi dus mchod bco lnga mchod pa'i sbyin bdag byas pa'i phan yon gyis yin/ grong gi ming la sog cha 'og ma zer/ nga yi grogs la gnas pho sde pa zer/ dge bcu gzhis ka'i bka' blon yin/ nga rang gi ming la dgos skyid 'dzoms pa zer/ dge bcu gzhis ka'i btsun pa phyogs nas byung ba rnams kyi chas ka nga la 'chol sa byas pa yin/ yang mon la byon pa rnams kyis kyang a ma dgos skyid 'dzoms pa zer zhing / lga dang g.yer ma dang ras dang 'bras dang shog bu la sogs pa mang du byin/ de rnams kyi lan du sha chang la sogs pa mang du drangs kyang /khong rnams kyis la lung mang po'i sar khur tsa rgyab tu 'khur ba de'i dkor lan ma 'byor ba'i rnam smin dang / btsun pa phyogs la theg dus chas ka nga la bcol nas bzhag /phyogs la phyin nas ma 'khor bar shi ba rnams kyi chas ka phran bu yod pa rnams ngas nang na bsdoms byas pa'i rnam par smin pa yin/ gzhan sdig pa ni lo re la g.yag gnyis gnyis tsam las ma bsad/nga la sdug bsngal 'di 'dra yong ba zer nas/ ngu zhing 'dug pas/ gshin rje stag lpags kyi sham thabs byas pa gcig gis tho ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ste /bud me/da de'i mgo la lan gcig rgyab nas 'di skad zer to/ / 3dze

ha ha bud med khyod kyis khram dang g.yo sgyu de tsam byas nas sdig pa de las med zer ba/ khyod mi yul dran pa r+sha/nga du bsdad pa'i dus/ chos sde gcig gi bka' blon byas te/ khyod rang gi dkar nag thams cad khong du bzhag nas/ dpon ngo/ la bskur pa ma btab kyang btab zer nas mi nag med dpon gyi khrims sar khyod kyis bskyal/ zhus sna byed mkhan yang khyod rang gis byas/ 'bul ba'i lhag ma thams cad khyod rang gis bzas/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrugs/ bde ba thams cad bsubs/ spyi nor rnams kyang khyod gnyis kyis 'dus/ mar khu yang skyed zom btsags nas ma blangs sam/spyi bla la zhi ba'i sgo nas slong / ngan pa'i sgo nas brkus nas khyer/ mi mgo mtho ba dang rgyu mtshan yod pa rnams la phrag dog dang zhe sdang byas/ chos byed mkhan rnams la bkur snyi dang zhabs tog mi byed pa'i khar/ 'jig rten ma nus par lkog nyal rgyas pa yin/ las rgyu 'bras kyis chos bshad cing thugs rje chen po'i yang snying yi ge drug pa rgyal khams la bskul nas sems can thams cad sde la 'god pa dang / sdig can 'gyod sem sa skye ba dang /skal ldan las 'phro can rnams mtho ris su bgrod nga/ dang / sngon nas sbyin pa'i las 'bras med pas tshe 'di la yang sbyin pa gtong ba'i 'du shes med pa rnams la sbyin pa thabs kyis len pa'i phyir du / bla ma ma ṇi pa 'gro don la byon dus/ mi dad pa yod nga/ rnams bsten bkur zhabs tog phul nas ma ṇi 'dren par 'gro ba la/ khyod kyis ma ṇi 'dren par ma phyin pa chog /ma ṇi 'dren par 'gro mkhan rnams la/ rang gi las ka mi nus par zog po de'i 37

sar 'gro ba/ 'gugs sngags zas ster ba dang / khyi khrid rgyab yong ba 'dra zer bas ngan kha mang po lab 'dug /bla 'i / ma ṇi pa la/ bkur sti zhabs tog ma byutshong yang / log pa'i skru/ra ba ma zhus pa ga la yod/ khyod la der ma zad sdig pa chen po yod pas sdug bsngal myong dgos pa de yin zer ba la/yang rgan mo de na re/ nga rang mi yul dran pa sgang na yod pa'i dus/dpag bsam sngong gi nam gru gsum der/ bla ma ma ṇi pa gzhan las gzi brjid che ba zhig phebs 'dug /der mi gzhan rnams bla ma ma ṇi pa'i drung du phyin nas log yong tsa na/ ma ṇi pa 'di bas lhag pa mi yong / las rgyu 'bras kyi cho sa rnams nga'i sems la phan pa byung / nga yang chos/ byed zer zhing gtam mang po lab kyi 'dug /nga'i bsam pa la shi ba thams cad kyis lcogs pa la nga gcig pos mi lcogs pa e yin/ 'o na ma ṇi ba kho rang tsho yang 'chi ba la bros pa ni med bsam nas bsdad/ khong rnams kyis 'chi ba thog babs su byung dus bu dang nor zas kyis phan mi thogs par/ rang gcig pur 'gro dgos pa yin zer ba de/ mi rnams kyi lad mo byas pa/rang gi nang tshang rnams kyis/ thos pas/ bu tsha rnams rengs shing kha la ma nyan pa dang gcig //grogs 'di bskyur 'dod che zhing tshig la mi gnas pa dang gnyis/ yul 'di the sdang che zhing chos la mi dad pa dang gsum/ grong pa'i chags sdang 'di la bsam na/ bu la 'bog rgyu dang bu mo la rdzongs 'debs rgyu yang dgos/ nga rang dgos skyid 'dzoms pa shi ba'i dus su dge 38

ba gtang rgyu dgos/ de rnams byung na nga'i bya ba 'thus so bsams nas/nor zas rnams la sgo gang 'dril byas pa yin te/ nga 'di ru sleb tsa na chos dang 'jig rten gnyis rgyab 'gal du song nas/ nga'i bya ba thams cad shi tsa na phan pa'i bya ba til 'bru tsam yang mi 'dug pas 'gyod do/ 'gyod kyang thal nas mi 'dug /nga yi shul la yod pa'i nye 'khor rnams la/ 'phrin pa 'di ltar gsungs dang / zer nas 'di skad du/kye ma kyi hud dgos skyid 'dzoms pa nga / /mi yul dran pa sgang du sdod pa'i skabs/ /mi chos byas pa lha chos ma 'grub pas/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma grub kyang don ma byung / /dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob pa'i dus/ /'jig rten bya ba g.yo 'khrul mkhas gyur kyang / /bar do'i gnas 'dir bslebs pa'i dus tshod na/ /nga yi bya ba mtha' ru thug nas 'dug/chos pa bzang por 'bul ba ma phul bas/ /nor gyis lung pa khengs kyang ci la phan/ /mi yul kha drag zang zing che lags kyang / /gnas 'dir bslebs nas 'gro sa mi 'dug go /bu dang tsha bo rnams la 'phrin pa mdzod//'jig rten bya ba ling gis mi bskyur kyang / /rang gis bsags pa'i sgyu ma'i nor zas rnams/ /phyed tsam a ma'i rjes la thongs shig gyis/ /dge 'dun dkrugs shing dkor zas bzas pa dang / /chos pa bzang por ngan kha btang ba yi/ /rnam par smin pa'i sdug bsngal chen po 'di/ /dag phyir bshags pa gang grub gyis gsungs dang / /zhes zer zhing mo rang bsam blo re btang 39

nas mchi ma 'don pa dang / sdig pa bu thog tu byas kyang byas spro4 drin med du song / bu 'di nor la brnag pas me thog tu shu ba dang thor pa byung ba lta bu pha ma'i don du ni dgra lag tu nor shar ba lta bu'i phangs sems byed kyin 'dug pas/ bu 'dis pha ma'i don du gtong ba mi sring// nga'i bu mo bkra shis lha mo mis lab pa gting khol le ba gcig yod pa de la / mkhar pa dang g.yu ru 'og ma gnyis kyi g.yu phyed ni dpon po'i sku drin las byung / phyed la rin sum cu tham pa sprad nas nyos pa de/ phas ma tshor ba byas nas bu mo bkra shis lha mo la byin/ gzhan yang stod thung dar ljag ma gnyis yod pas gakhog bu mo gzhon pa'i chos rgyags la byin/ dar ljag ma drag pa de dang gdan stag khra mo gcig /lham phag sna ma gcig /zha rtse'i lag bskor gcig rnams/kun dga' gling pa'i a ma bsod nams rgyal mo la 'brel che ba rang med de/dge bcu gzhis ka'i bla ma'i dpon mo yin pa dang / yul mi rnams kyis bre tshad srang du byed kyi 'dug pas/ nged rang ma smad lag sbrel byas nas /bu mo'i sbas nor gyis byas nas bcol ba yin/ gzhan ma nged rang pha ma gnyis gros byas pa'i chas ka dge bcu lung pa'i bu mo dmangs dang dpe 'dra ba las drag pa bu mo la byin pa yin pas/ nga a ma la dgos dus bu mos soms shig /yul pa spyi dmangs dkrugs pa'i sdig pa bshags thabs su/gsung rabs rdor gcod dang / sdig bshags gser gyi spu gri bzhengs shig /dge 'dun rnams kyi dbyen dkrugs byas pa la/ zhabs tog bkur sti phyag dang skor ba la 'bungs shig /btsun pa rnams kyi dkor zas 40

dang chas ngan bsdoms byas pa'i bshags pa la/ rtogs ldan pho mo gang na su byon byung yang / zhabs tog dang gtor rtsam phul la lan chags byang ba'i gtor ma dang / bsngo ba zhus shig rgyal khams 'grim pa'i bla ma ma ṇi pa rnams la zhabs tog ma byas par bskur zhus byas pa'i nyes dmigs chen po rang 'dug pas/ bsgen gnas dang smyung gnas srung ba'i mi rnams la zhabs tog dang bkur sti bgyis la yi ge brgya pa 'bum tsho 'don du chug dang /de rnams byas na a ma'i sdug bsngal 'di las thar dus yong las che bas/'phrin pa 'di lngar gsungs rogs mdzod cig zer bas/gshin rje rnams/ kyi zhal nas khyod la shul na yod pa'i mi rnams kyis sdig pa bshags thabs de rnams byed mkhan yod na/ 'dir lo phyed dang bzhi las sdod mi dgos zer bas/ yang rgan mo sngon gyi las rnams dran pas 'gyod pa chen po skyes te mchi ma dbang med du shor/ lag pa g.yas pas rang gi brang bcum/ lag pa g.yon pas lba ba 'brad cing / a tsa ma nga'i sdug bsngal 'di la gzigs dang / da rung skyid po kham gcig tsam mi yong ba 'dug /mi yul dran pa sgang la nga'i 'phrin ma brjed par gsungs rogs mdzod cig zer nas 'di skad du/ mi chos byas pas lha chos mi 'grub pas//'jig rten bya ba thongs la lha chos gyis/ /ci yang phangs sems ma byed sbyin par thongs/ /chags sdang ma byed kun la ci phan gyis/ /gzhan yang 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /phrag dog nga rgyal gnod sems kun spongs 41

la/ /nga 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong ba ma byed cig /mtho ris thar pa thob par modzod cig gyis/ /zhes zer ba dang / yang gshin rje rnams kyis khrid nas sang nga i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas lho phyogs su bslebs pa dang / sgo chung gcig gi nang nas nga rang gi ming po tshangs pa rgyal mtshan sleb byung ste/nga rang yang sems shin tu skyo ba zhig byung / ngas ming po'i lag pa nas 'jus te mchi ma mang po shar/ a tsa ma a lo khyod da tshun 'di ru sdod dgos pa ci yin/ khyod bla ma'i bu ru skyes nas sdig pa'i las ni bsags pa rang ni med dam byas pas/ kho na re a lce lags ngas nor 'dod kyi sdig pa bsags pa med kyang / nga rang la pha ma dang jo jos mthong chung ba'i stabs kyis/ dgos pa'i chos ni ma bcol/ bla ma'i bu yin kyang chos kyi go rtogs ni med/ dbang rgyu med pa'i phyugs kyi rdzi bo kyang byed du bcug/phyugs rdzi'i zla bo rnams kyi khab da/nga / rtse chung de rang las dgos/ phyugs la khrag rgyab pa la mkhas pa ltar byas/ dge sdig ni ngo ma shes/ brag byi'u dang byi ba rnams bzung nas/ me la gson bsregs byas pa'i rnam par smin pa ni 'di nas phar phyin pa'i sa na bskal pa'i me dpung chen po yin zer ba/me chen po de 'bar ba'i skad tsheg sgra dang 'ur sgra chen pos stong gsum thams cad khengs song bsam pa'i 'jigs skrag 'dug go /de ru gshin rje rnams kyis nga dbang med du khrid nas/ khyod rigs dang gdung rus bzang yang /4'a

khyod rang gi spyod pa ngan pas/ rtswa gtsang bzas/ chu gtsang btungs nas sdod pa'i nam mkha'i bya tshogs kyang 'jigs skrag shes pa'i sems can mang po gson bsregs mang po btang / 'dab chags bya'i phrug gu mang po tshang nas bton te me la bsregs 'dug pas/ de khyod me la sreg cing tho bas brdung ngo zer nas/ nga me dpung de'i nang du bskyur byung / der nga rang gi nye ba rnams kyi ming nas bos kyang nga la rogs dang ra mda' rgyag mkhan ni gcig kyang med/ nga rang lag pa'i a tsha zer ba'i skad ni 'brug stong ldir ba tsam 'dug /de'i khrod na skyes pa gcig gis 'di ni gdung ring bsrel 'dzin pa'i brgyud pa yin zhing / shes bzhin gyi sdig pa mi 'dug pas/gtong rogs mdzod dang zer ba'i sbrang ma'i skad tsam zhig byung bas/ der gzhin rje stag gi mgo can gzhig gis me de phar dkrugs tshur dkrugs byas nas/ lcags kyi skam pas nged sked pa nas bzung ste bton nas pha khar der bskyur byung / yang na tsha dang sdug bsngal bzod glags med pas dran med du brgyal byung / dran pa gsos pa dang / a tsa ma nga de ka yin te/ nga'i grogos phyed zla bo rnams snying rje snyam nas mchi ma mang du shor bas/ gzhin — rje rnasams kyis nga la khyod bla ma'i brgyud pa dang gdung ring bsrel 'dzin mkhan yin na nyams dang rtogs pa 'char rgyu ci yod/ snying gar yi dam bsgom rgyu dang / lam sna 'dren pa'i bla ma/ chos skyong srung ma'i rgyab rten yod dam/ byams dang snying rje rgyud la bsgoms sam/ de rnams gang yang med na gnas 'di las bgrod pa'i skabs med do zer byung / der sngar gyi 43

sbrang ma'i skad tsam 'don mkhan de ni mi nag po ras sngon po gyon pa skra spyi bor bcings pa rna ba la shag ril rgyus pa cig 'dug pas des nga'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ khyod rang gi a lce ya gi na sleb 'dug pas/ yar 'gro zer nas byung bas/ a lce 'dir bslebs 'dug pa/ da rung chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bkod la/ khyod bla ma'i brgyung/ pa yin kyang 'khrul snang ngos ma zin pas da rung sdug bsngal bag tsam myong dgos pa yin/ mi khyod kyi rigs rgyud smras mi dgos/ lus kyi sdig pa dag phyir du phyag dang bskor ba bya/ngag gi sdig pa dag phyir du yi ge drug pa sgrongs/ yid kyi sdig pa dag phyir phyag rgya chen po'i sgom zhig byas na/ lcags ri khor yug gi nang na yod pa'i sems can sdug bsngal can mang po drangs rig 'dzin gyi sa thob pa yin te/de ltar ma byas pas da rung lus ngan gnyis tsam blangs te/ de nas skyes pa pho lus thob pa yod do gsung gi 'dug /ngas a lo gang du 'gro byas pas/chos rgyal gyis gsung nas/ khyod rang lho seṅge rdzong du skye ba lang shag gsungs byung bas/ der 'gro ba yin zer/ 'o na nga yis khyed kyi don du mang ja bzhes tsam bsngo rten phul/ rdo rje gcod pa bzhengs pa dang klog pa byas/ rtogs ldan pho mo rnams la gtor ma 'bum sde gtong du bcug /nga rang gis kyang phyag la sogs pa'i dge ba gang grub byas pa de la 'bras bu ci 'dra byung byas pas/ a lce sha dang lpags byas pa'i lto za rgyu ni ma byung /tshi gu gsum btsugs pa'i zhag bdun la kham bu smin nas za chog pa byung zer/kha nas tshi gu bton rgyu 'dug /da chos rgyal gyi bka' bzhin seng ge rdzong la 44

'gro zer/ de nas nga rang yang sems phreng drags/ ming po'i lag nas bzung ste/ a lo sems brtan po gyis/ yi dam rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba thob/ a rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'thob cig /bla ma'i bu yin pa la rdog sna ma dred par gyis shig byas nas mnyam du phyin pas/ nub phyogs kyi ri rtse nas rbab kyi 'jigs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang rlung dmar chen po gcig langs nas/ nga'i ming po 'dzin dbang med pa rlung dmar des khyer song / nga ni dran med du brgyal/ sdug bsngal mun pa 'thibs pa lta bu byung bas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med de bslebs nas/ khyod kyi ming po 'di rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal che ba gcig yin te/ chos phyag rgya chen po ma bsgoms pas/ bar do'i 'jigs skrag du ma tsam myong dgos pa yin pas/khyod rang sdug bsngal ma byed par longs shig zer ro/ /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas phar phyin pa'i sa na gzhin rje rnams kyis skye dman rgan mo gakhrig zhags pa nag pos bcings/ lus pha bong chen pos mnan/ lce ag ma'i 'og nas drangs te thong bshol btsugs pa'i lcags kyi rtse la me 'bar ba des ril lan mang du gtong zhing / kha la khro chu khol ma blug gin 'dug pas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med des/ a tsa ma rgan mo 'dis bya ba ngan pa ci 'dra zhig byas pa yin zer bas/ gshin rje de'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ rgan mos sdug bsngal mang po myong ba 'di/ /mi yul dran pa sgang la sdod pa'i dus/ /spyir gyi bya ba mang la byas pa chung //45

sgos su smra ba mang la mchu bsdur khas/ /yang sgos rdzun dang tshig rtsub kho na yis/ /grong pa khyim mtshes rnams la chags sdang bslangs/ /dkon mchog mchod dang ngan slong sbyin btang sogs/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu til 'bru tsam yang med/ /da lta 'di rnams bar do'i snang tshul yin/ /da rung chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal mi mthong / /pha gi lcags ri tshen po'i khor yug tu//lus la lcags gzer btab nas sdod dgos yod/ /ces zer ba dang /yang nga'i zla grogs kyi bud med des 'di skad du/ gshin rje rnams kyang gsan mdzod dang / /rgan mo sdug bsngal myong ba 'di/ /bsdams pa glod la bcings pa khrol/ /mi yul dran pa sgang gi mi/ /nye 'khor bu dang bcas pa la/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong lugs dang / /sdig bshags dge ba byed lugs kyi/ /'phrin pa bskur du 'jug rogs mdzod/ /ces zer bas/ gshin rje'i zhal nas/ bud med khyod la bu dang tsha yug nor rdzas rnams yod na/ sdig bshags kyi dge ba byed lugs 'phrin pa skur cig zer bas/ bud med rgan mo des kye ma kyi hud nga rang gis yul la 'phrin pa bskur kyang / nang mi 'grangs tsam zhig ma gtogs/ dge ba bsags nas gtong rgyu ni med/ nga rang la bu gnyis yod/ bu rgan pas 'jig rten byas/ gzhon pas dpon gyi phyag g.yog byas yod/ ming la bkra shis rdo rje zer/ nga rang gi yul ni 'bring pa spe sar nas yin/ bu rgan pa la chung ma nga rang gi tsha mo blangs/ bu la 'dun ma ma bcol bar du/ nga rang rgyas so 46

ngan pa'i stabs kyis/ yar dkon mchog la zhabs tog dang / mar ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong rgyu ma byung / mi ltogs drag lam gyis dpe bakhri/na/da lo bas sang phod drag po yong bsam nas zhe sdang gi dbang du song /de nas khur dang dbang sa thas gcwod rnams mna' ma'i lag tu sprad nas ni/ za dbang dang 'thung dbang med pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba'i skal ba ga la yod/ cis byas kyang mna' ma'i mig sngar mi mdzes pas/ nang nas yo byad 'khur rgyu ni med/ khang pa'i gru gcig tu lto g.yas g.yon nas 'otshol zhing bsdad/ dang po rang gi pha mas byin pa'i gos ljang khra gcig dang /rang gi grogs kyi kha 'chems su khyod la bu 'dis byams po rang e byed mi shes pas/ 'di bu la ma ster bar khyod rang gis bdag nyar gyis zer nas sbar sbug tu g.yu mdzo rab gcig byung ba de nga rang gis sbas nas bzhag kyang / nga gzhi la ma sdod pa'i skabs su/ mna' mas chas ka g.yengs smi pa sa g.yu mthong bas/ g.yu dang gos gnyis mig tu bcug ste/ g.yog mo dang mna' ma gnyis gros byas/ skya pham pa'i dus na ni mna' mas lto ma dze byin phyi nas ni lto ma rnyed par lus stong par 'gyel la khad tsa na/ mna' mas bu la chang byin nas nyal du bcug /mna' ma dang g.yog mo gnyis kyis nga'i kha ltag skor gcus nas rkub 'og tu mnan pas/ bu bdag grongs pa la skad rgyab rgyu med pa'i ngang nas 'dir bslebs byung / da nga'i bu bkra shis rdo rje la 'di ltar gsung rogs mdzod dang / a ma la dge ba ni kha gang 47

yang ma byung / nag tshang gi shing khrod na lha/ma sgro/ga dang skud pa btsongs pa'i rin la nas rdza ma gang dang bal bsku ra gang yod/ de ban 'khong ba rnam sa la phul bas bsngo ba gcig zhus rogs gyis/ nag tshang gi phyi na rgyug khrod dang spang shing gi khrod na/ re ba'i phyi skogs byas nas phad gog gis dril ba gcig yod/ de'i nang na tshwa dang tshod sdor snam snum spen tog gcig dang bcas pa yod/ ra spe'i smin drug gi lag nas/ 'phreng ba'i 'dren 'dzin btsongs pa'i rin la nas khal phyed dang gnyis blang chog pa yod/ spe sar nub pa'i bu khrid lha mo la gos kyi lteb rnam pa gnyis bcol nas yod/ de rnams long las spe sar lung pa'i mi rnams la chang phor ba re ma byung yang drongs la ma ṇi 'dren rogs mdzod gyis shig /de rnams ma lags pa'i nor ni nga la/ med pas/ bus kyang a ma la soms la sdig pa 'di rnams bshags thabs gang drag gyis dang zer zhing / sdug dus bu yis ma phan na//gces par bskyangs pa yi re mug /lha chos ma byas nga re 'gyod/ /'gyod kyang bya thabs mi 'dug go /dran pa sgang gi mi rnams kun/ /nga dang 'dra ba'i sdig can ma/ /rdzun dang tshig lcub ma byed par/ /kun la ci phan mdzod cig gyis/ /zhes zer ro/ /yang gshin rje rnams kyis sngar bzhin du kha la khro chu khol ma blug gin 'dug go /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas phar phyin pa'i sa na gshin rje rnams kyis mi gzhon pa rbad mgo byas pa cig zhags pas bcings nas/ pha bong 48

chen po gcig gi 'og tu ma nan nas/ nang khrol rnams rtsib ma'i bar nas phyir lud yod kyin 'dug /der yang nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des// gshin rje rnams la mi 'dis mi yul bsdad dus ci 'dra byas pa'i rnam/ par smin pa yin/ zhes drinu/ song bas// gshen rje rnams/ kyis 'di skad du/ /mi 'di dran pa sgang du bsdad pa'i dus// /dpon bzang phrag la bskal nas mi / mang la/ /khrel med brdungs rdzob mang du byas pa yi/ /las kyi rnam smin mang du 'bur dgos yod/ ces zer bas/ nga'i zla grogs kye bu mo des 'di skad ces zer to/ /gzhin rje rnams kyang bdag la tshur gson dang / /mi 'di'i dran pa sgang la 'phrin pa zhig /bskur dgos 'dug pas/ cung zad lhod mdzod dang / /skyes pa khyod la sdug bsngal 'di lta bu/ /myong ba'i rgyu mtshan bya ba ci byas pa/ /yul dang gnyen 'khor ming la ji ltar zer/ /rnam smin bden pa'i sdug bsngal bshags pas byang / /mi ༷/la dran pa sgang la phrin bskur mdzod/ /ces zer bas/gzhin rje rnams kyis pha bong gi 'og nas bton byung ste/ na tsha bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal chen po'i ngang nas 'di skad zer grin 'dug /a tsa ma sdig can nga'i skye sa lho stod kyi lung pa zhal ma byi li zer ba de nas yin/ nga rang gi ming la tshe ring dar rgyas zer/ a ma'i ming la lha dbang bu khrid zer/ nga rang phrug gu nas jo bo'i drung gi phyag g.yog byas/tshe ring dar rgyas hor po yod zer ba de rna ba'i rgyan du song ste/ lung pa phu 0sna9

mda' med pa khre(ro med kyi 'phrog bcom mang du byas/ ngas 'osnya shu rtsa lnga nas klu bsdings kyi rta dpon byas nas mi rnams la snyan ka phar btsongs mi rnams bzung nas/ chas ka rnams phrogs/ phyag 'tshal mi rnam sa kyi mgo la brgyab/ yul ba 'i mi rnams la skad btang ba dang / mi re chang dam spi re khyer nas yong / nga yis ma nyan grin chang re byin/ rgan pa rnams kyis 'jam pa'i gtam smras kyang / ngas chang btungs pa'i shed khyer dang / sngar yang dpon po la snyan bcol mang du byas kyang tshe ring dar rgyas hur po yin zer nas bka' bkyon ma gnang ba'i gshis kyis rgan po gnyis bzung nas bkyigs btags btang / de'i nang na kha 'jam pa don khregs pa de bkyigs pas ma chog rdo chen pos mnan nas bzhag /mtshan mo nga rang bud med de dang mnyam du nyal bas/ nam langs tsa na rgan po rdos mnan pa de shi/bkyigs pa'i rgan po de ma shi tsam 'dug /de rnams kyi rnam par smin pa nga rang la 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung ba yin/ da nga'i a ma lha dbang bu khrid la phrin pa 'di ltar gsungs rogs mdzod dang zer nas 'di skad du/kye ma kyi hud sdig pa can gyi mi/ /tshe ring dar rgyas zer ba'i gzhon pa nga / /sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar byed pa la/ /a ma'i zhing dang nor la ma phangs par/ /'tshong la nga yi shul du ci 'gro gis/ /sem sa can 'chi nges shes pa'i tshe srog dang / /nag can dpon gyi khrims sar sleb pa rnams/ /nor rdzas gang dgos phul la blu gyis dang / /gtsug lag khang 50

dang lha khang ma chod rten la/ /spos dang dkar me zhal zas brgya rtsa phul//dge 'dun btsun pa rnams la bsnyen bkur zhing / /dkar po'i zhabs tog mang ja 'gyed byas gyis/ /rnying ma'i bla ma tshad ldan spyan drongs la//tshorags dang gtor ma bskang bshags brgya rtsa thongs/ /dam chos dri med bshags brgyud 'bri klog dang / /phyag 'tshal skor ba la sogs ci sgrub gyis/ /gzhan yang lung pa'i mi la chang tshul dang / /nas rtsam mar gyi stan mo ci sgrub gyis/ /de rnam/sa byas na sdug bsngal chen po las/ /thar tshod 'dug pas myur du gyis gsungs dang / /zhes zer zhing 'dug pas/ yang gzhin rje rnams kyi zhal nas/ /da rung chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs su/las dkar nag dang dge sdig gi shan 'byed byas te/ khyod la sdig pa de las med na nad yangs te/ des chog 'dra ba mi 'dug zer zhing / zhags pa nag pos bcings te sngar bzhin mnan no/ /e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas yang phar phyin pa'i sar rdo them skas chen po gcig gi steng nas/ rtogs ldan sgom thag dang sgom ber bu+on zhing mgo la dom ra btsugs pa gcig gi kha la/ gshin rje rnams kyis lcags kyi gzar bus me thal rgyun du blug gyin 'dug pas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des gzhin rje rnams la 'di skad ces zer to/ /sgom dang ldan pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa la/ /me thal za ba'i sdug bsngal 'di lta bu/ /myong ba'i rgyu rkyen 'bras bu ji ltar yin/ /mi yul bsdad dus bya ba ci byas pa/ zhes zer 51

bas/ gshin rje rnams kyi zhal nas 'di ska/da gsung gi 'dug /mi 'di dran pa sgang la/ sngo da pa'i skabs/ /dam chos/ thos/ la tsam yang mi byed par/chos brdzus skye bo rnam sa kyi 'i /go bskor nas/ /dad pa can gyi nor zas mang po blangs/ /ngag nas ri khrod 'grim pa'i sgom chen la/ /'di phyi don dang sku rim la dmigs pa'i/ /phogs dang gtor phye gnang ba zhu zer nas//blangs te rang gi bu smad rkyang pa gsos/ /chos gzugs byas nas sems bskyed gtor ma sogs/ /yar mchod mar sbyin dge ba ma byas pas//tham/sa cad rang gis bzas pa'i rnam smin la/ /'di ru me thal rgyun du blugs pa yin/ /zhes zer grin 'dug go /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas yang phar phyin pa'i sa na/ a ne gos dmar po dang gzan ma lheb gcig gyon pa zhwa mo lding zhes byas pa gcig/gshin rje rnams kyi khrod na dngangs/ skrag dang 'jigs snang med par sdod 'dug pas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des/ khyod btsun ma'i cha lugs byas nas 'di ru sdod pa ci yin/ skye sa'i yul dang ming la ji skad zer ba yin byar+sha/ pas// btsun ma de'i kha nas// nga skye sa ni dge bcu srog chas nas yin/nga rang gi ming la shes rab dbang mo zer/ gzhon pa'i dus na chos byed pa'i 'dun pa drag pos chos byas pa yin te/ skye dman gyi lus 'di phur rtsal chung ba'i ga sa kyis/ bsgoms/ kyang zhi gnas brtan po tsam ma gtogs/bar do grol ba'i sgom rang gcig ma byung / da lta 'dir sdod dgos pa ni/52

nga rang mi yul dran pa sgang la ji+o/da dus/ yar dkon mchog la ma chod pa dang / mar ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong rgyu ma 'byung ba'i bar du/ nga'i nye 'khor rnams kyis nga la dge ba nang mi gzhan shi ba rnams dang spyi bsdoms su btangari bas/ nga la dbang rgyu cher ma byung / gang thob de yang sngar mi yul du bskor mang po bzas pa'i dkor len ma 'byor ba'i gshis kyis de'i lan du khyer nas ma byung ba dang dge ba bsgug nas sdo da pa yin/ da nga'i nye 'khor rnams la 'phrin pa 'di ltar gsungs rogs mdzod cig zer nas 'di skad du/shes rab dbang mo zer ba'i btsun ma nga / /mi yul sdod dus dge ba ma btang zhing / /dad zas bzas pa'i skor lan ma khyer bas/ /da rung dge ba bsgug nas sdod yod do/ /nye 'khor rnams kyis nga la soms mdzod la//dgon sde gsum la gsol tshogs bsten bkur dang / /yul pa rnams la bza' btung ston mo gcig /cis kyang yod pa gyis zhes gsungs rogs mdzod/ /ces zer gyin 'dug pas/ga'an rje rnams kyi zhal nas/ khyod la bar do dang mya/la ba las bgrod pa'i sgom rang mi 'dug ste sdig pa yang cher mi 'dug /skye/ ba snga ma de lha bris mkhan po za 'dod med pa gcig rgi skye ba yin pa 'dug /ma ṇi yi dam gyi gzungs sngags mang du bgrangs pa'i phan yon gyis/ nged gshin rje rnams kyi 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal gtong mi nus pa de yin/ da lta chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal mi ma thong ba de khyod rang la dmigs pa'i dge rtsa ma/ byung 53

bas lano pa yin no/ /zhes zer te/ a ne de ni der bsgug nas sngar bzhin 'dug ga /e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas yang phar phyin pa'i sa na/ bskal pa me/ chen po yin zer ba'i me dpung chen po nyin lam re'i sa gnas me de'i ngad pas tha'i /sa cad 'ub kyis 'tshig 'gro ba 'dug /me de'i dkyil na tshogs ma bsags pa'i mi mang po der bu+od nas 'dug /rlung chen po langs pa'i dus me rnams phar bskyod pa'i bar nas mi de rnams nag rong rong byed kyin 'dug/yang me de che lugs gcig la/ mi de rnams mig gis mi mthong bar me des stong gsum thams cad mchod song bsam pa 'bar grin 'dug /der ga'an rje dom gyi mgo can gcig gis/ mi gcig lcags kyi skam pas bton nas rgyang ring por bskyur song / mi de ni mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal chen pos lu/sa khre log byed kyin 'dug /da rung des kyang mi chog par mi de'i lus/ la ma da' dang gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha mang po char bzhin 'bab kyin 'dug pas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des gzhin rje rnams la 'di skad du/ /skye/sa pa 'di ni yu/la phyogs gang nas yin/ /grong dang gnyen 'khor mi /nga la ji skad zer/ /sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu rkyen gang las byung //las dang bya ba ngan pa ji ltar byas/ /zhes zer bas/ gshin rje rnams kyi zhal/ nas/ mi 'di khra zhes bya ba'i lung pa na/ grong gi ming la sban tsha zer ba yimyo// /dkar banyo neg bzo g.yo sgyu mang po byas/ /da lta 'di ru skyid po pa4

e 'dug ltos/ /zhes gsung zhing ma/rtsoman cha nam mkha' la 'phyar nas/rgyab grabs byed kyin 'dug /yang nga'i zla grogs/ kyi bud med des mi de la 'di skad du / khyod la 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa/ mi yul du sdod dus sdi ga pa ci 'dra byas/ 'gyod tshang bshags pa byed mkhan gnyen nye 'khor dang / nor rdzas yod na mi yul la 'phrin skur mdzod// ces zer bas /mi des nga'i gdong la bltas nas mchi ma 'don zhing lag pa thal mo sbyar nas/ a tsa ma nga mi yul du yod tsa na/ khyed nga rang gi dpon gyi jo mo yin pas/ dpon g.yog gi dbye ba phye nas phyag 'bul byas pa ma gtogs/dad pa ni med/ khyod la 'di lta bu nus pa yod pa ni ma shes/ da nga'i a rgyan tshe ring la 'di ltar gsungs rogs mdzod cig /ngas nag bzo byas nas mda' dang gri la sogs pa bzos nas btsongs/ dkar bzo byas nas gser dang g.yu mang du sbas/ khyad par nga dmag la phyin pa'i skabs su/mi'i rna ba la g.yu legs po btags pa gcig bros song bas/ ngas g.yu la bltas nas gri rgyab ste bsad pa yin/ de rnams kyi rnam par smin pas nga rang gi lus me dpung chen po'i nang du bskyur/ mtshon cha mang po char bzhin babs nas byung bas/ sdig pa de rnam/sa dag byed du thar pa'i gling gi sgrub mchod kyi sbyin bdag gyis/ ma ṇi khri tshar thongs / yi ge drug pa 'di la phan yon chen por 'dug /nga rang gis mi yul du yod dus/ ma ṇi pa 55

dpal 'byor rgya ma/tsho la nyin gcig gi zhabs tog byas pas 'dir sem sa la bde ba chen po yong gin 'dug /yang bla ma ma ṇi ba mon phyogs nas byon dus/ a ma'i don du rgyal khams la ma ṇi bskul ba yi na zer ba gcig zhag gsum nga rang gi khyim du gdan drangs nas mi rnams la ma ṇi 'dren du shag zer zhing zhabs tog byas/ nga rang gi 'phral 'dogs kyi g.yu spungs de yang khong la phul bas/ de'i phan yon gyi zhag mang po'i bar du sdug bsngal zhi nas phan thogs che bar byung / da rung sdig pa dag byed 'di ltar gyis zhes gsungs rogs mdzod dang zer nas 'di skad du/kye ma kyi hud bdag gi sdug bsngal 'di/ /bu dang nor gyi phyir du bsags pas lan// pha yis sdig pas bsags pa'i nor rdzas rnams//bu yis phangs sems ma byed sbyin pa thongs / /nga yis bsags pa'i sdig pa dag phyir du/ /dam chos na rag dong spyags skang bshags gyis//mchod rten rnams la dkar me zhal zas dang / /na bza' phul la phyag dang bskor ba gyis/ /ri khrod 'grims pa'i rtogs ldan pho mo la/ /phogs dang gtor phye phul la skyabs 'gro zhu/ /dkar lugs dge slong gtsang ma spyan drongs la/ /phag mo'i cho ga sbyin sreg bcas pa gyis/ /gzhan yang phyi nang nor la ma phangs pa/ /dkar po dge ba'i phyogs la ci 'gro gyis/ /'di ru bslebs nas bya thabs mi 'dug pas/ /mi yul sdod dus dge ba ci 'grub gyis/ /de ltar sdig pa bshags thabs grub pa dang / /sdug bsngal 'di 56

las thar nas mi lus thob// gsung gi 'dug go a rgyan tshe ring la /de rnams myur du gyis zhes gsungs rogs mdzod/ /ces zer zhing 'dugago/e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang de nas phar phyin pa'i sar/ shing sngong chen po gcig gi drung na/ a ne rbad mgo byas pa gcig /gzhin rje rnamaso kyis zhags pas bcings/ khog stod lcags kri/ pha bong chen pos mnan zhing kha la dug chu khol ma rgyun du blugs/ khog smad lcags kyi tho bas brdungagi 'dug pas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des gshin rje rnams la/ a ne 'di yul gang nas yin/ 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa'i bya ba ngan pa ci 'dra byas/ zhes dris song bas/gshin rje des 'di ltar zer to/ /'di'i skye sa dge bcu lung pa yin/ /mo rang rtsa dar rlung rgod rgyas pa'i dus/ /pha mas bcol ba'i 'dun pa mi byed par/ /gzhan gyi kha phyir 'brengs nas chos gzugs byas//'jig rten byed pa'i 'dod pa gting nas med/ /'khor ba 'di la skyo ba skyeso zer nas/ /dang po bla ma'i drung du bka' chos nyan/ /bar du sgom dang nyams len cung zad byas/ /tha ma 'bras bu rang la char dus su/ /rangadang rus pa sacig pa'i rtogs ldan la/ /lam gyi phyag rgya gtum mo'i lag len bslabs/ /rtogs pa bral bas ngo tsha mi dgos zer/ /thabs lam tshad ldan lag len mi shes par/ /byang chub sems kyi lam sna 'dren no zer//57

nyon mongs 'dam du bying ba mi shes par/ /mtho ris bgrod pa'i skas kha 'dzugs so zer/ /de dus nyon mongs rtsad chod ma song bas/ /rang dang rus gcig mnyam du khrid nas bsdad/ /rtogs pa ma grol grol rdzun byed pa yis/ dkon mchog yi dam lha rnams khros nas 'dug /bla mas gnang ba'i bka' ni chu la 'pho/ /dar dkar yol ba 'bar ba'i me la bsregs//bsnol byas rang skyes phru gu rang gis bsad/ /mtho ris thar par 'dzegs pa'i skas kha chag /btsun ma khyod rang lakhog pos mi chog par/ /khyod dang 'brel bar thogs tshad dpyal bar ltung / /sems can byams dang snying rjes skyong ba la/ /khyod kyis nyon mongs dug las ma byas sam/ /a ne khyod kyis g.yo sgyu phung gsum byas/ /pha ma nye 'khor thams cad yi chad cug/nye 'khor 'chi dus sngas mgor khyod bos nas/ /kha 'chems bshad kyang khyod kyis khyad du bsad/ /gnyen 'khor nye ring mi rnams mgo bskor nas//zas nor mang po khyod kyis lkog tu sbas// gshin po rnams kyang yid chad sdug bsngal bcol/ /da lta khyod la skyid po e byung ltos/ /bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal ba'i rnam smin la/ /yi dwags ngu 'bod lus su skye ba yi/na//rang gi bu tsha bsad pa'i rnam smin la/ /tho bas brdung zhing khog smad ral gris gtubs/ /tshig ngan dug sbyor btang ba'i rnam smin la// /kha la dug chu khol ma rgyun du blugs/ /gzhan yang khyod kyi sdig pa bsam las 'das//dmyal ba ma gtogs gzhan la btang sa med// ces zer zhing pho tshod che bar byed kyin 'dug pa la/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des/ a ne de la khyod chos 58

pa'i cha lugs byas nasa'adi 'dra'i dngangs skrag dang sdug bsngal myong dgos pa snying re rje/ da sdig pa byas pa bden na bshags pas dag pa bden pas khyod rang gi yul na gnyen 'khor dang nor zas yod na bshags pa byed lugs kyi phrin pa skur dang zer bas/gzhin rje rnams kyi zhal nas/ khyod la phrin pa bskur rgyu yod na lhod pa gakhrig bgyi dang zer zhing bsdams pa rnams glod nas pha bong gi 'og nas bton byung bas/ a ne lag pa thal mo sbyar nas a tsa ma nga 'dra'i chos pa las ngan tshogs ma bsags/ nga la bla mas thugs rjes gzigs shig zer zhing / sngar gyi bag chags kyis bla ma rgyang 'bod ma'i gsol 'debs dum tsam byed kyin 'dug pas/ der gshin rje rnams ngar thogs te/ lag pa g.yon pa nas btsun ma de'i ltag rtsa nas bzung ste/ khyod mtho ris kyi skas kha chag /ye shes kyi dkar khung 'gags/ bla ma'i bka' dang dam las 'gal zhing thugs dkrugs pa'i btsun ma khyod/ da gsol ba 'debs pa en tsamo thal zin zer zhing ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar nas brgyag gin 'dug ga /de nas yari a ne de'i kha nas 'di ltar zer grin 'dug /las 'phro can ma mi yul la byon na/ /nga yi 'phrin pa 'di ltar gsungs rogs mdzod//nga yi skye sa dge bcu sban tsha yin/ /sdod pa'i gnas la bzang 'gro zer ba 59
