yin/ /nu mo thub bstan dpal mo zer ba yod/ /nga rang ming la chos 'brug lha 'dzoms zezari/ /sdig pa 'di byas bsam pa med na yang //gshin rje rnams kyis mang po gsung gin 'dug /rang gi bsam pa 'khor ba dong sprugs shig /byed dgos bsam kyang thog tu ma khel zhing / /chos min bya ba byas pa'i kha btags dang / /da lta'i sdug bsngal 'di la gzigs mdzod dang / /nga yi nu mo thub bstan dpal mo la/ /ming sring gnyis kyis nga la soms mdzod dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gso phyir du//sangs rgyas spyi 'dus bris sku bzhengs shig gyis/ /gsung rab sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum rdo rje gcod pa dang / /sdig bshags gser gyi spu gri bzhengs shig gyis/ /mchod rten tsha tsā thob la sku dkar gsol/ /phyag dang dkar me zhal zas phul cig gyis/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i gzungs mchog da nga / /sbyin sreg brgya rtsa gyis la smon lam thob/ /lam 'phrang bcos shing chu la zam pa tshugs/ /sems can 'chi nges shes pa'i srog bslu gyis/ /de rnams byas pas sdug bsngal 'di las nga thar tsam yong las che ba'i gsungs rogs mdzod/ /gzhan yang nga 'dra chos pa'i rkang 'dren du//'gro ba'i btsun ma ma byed gsung rogs gyis/ /zhes zer grin 'dug go/i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas phar phyin pa'i sa na/ chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang bya ba de ni/ lcags ri khor yug rim pa lngas yongs su bskor ba/de'i phyogs bzhi na rgyal sgo re re yod/ rgyal sgo re la sgo srung gzhin rje brgyad 60

brgyad yod pa/ gshin rje de rnams la la ni stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang mi lngags kyi g.yang gzhi bu+on pa/ la la ni gzig lpags kyi sham thabs dang glang chen gyi ko rlon gyon pa/ la la ni mi lpags kyi sham thabs dang dar nag gi yug gon byas pa/ lag na mdung dang ral gri dang tho ba dang lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mi/ga nyi zla tsam khro tshugs su blta ba/ ral pa kham nag bar snang la gzings pa/ zhal nas hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra sgrog pa 'dug rgyal sgo bzhi yod pa'i byang phyogs kyi rgyal sgo'i mdun na/ rnga bo'i khrims stegs chen po'i steng na mi mang po gan rkyal du 'gyel nas/ lus dum bur gtubs pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo nam mkhar btegs te/ 'khor lo de 'gyir thengs gcig la mar babs nas/ de na yod pa'i mi/ rnams kyi lus dum bu brgya stong du 'gro ba 'dug de'i nang nas sdug bsngal che ba'i mi rnams ni yan lag dum bur gtubs kyang / lag pa thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul du byed kyin 'dug /yang gzhin rje rnams kyis tho ba me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar nas/ /dum bur song ba rnams kyang / slar nas dang sran ma tsam du ma song bar du brdung gin 'dug/de na yod pa'i mi la la'i kha nas a tsa ma 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba 'dug go /mi yul dran pa sgang la theg mi yod na/ nged tsho 'dra ba'i sdig pa'i las ma/ byed gyis dang / zhes zer zhing 'dug pas/ nga yang 'jigs shing skrag nas dran med du brgyal byung bas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des nga yar bslangs nas 'di skad du/ rang rang las kyis sdug bsngal myong ba la//dze1

sangs rgyas dngos su byon kyang bya thabs med/ /sdig pa byas ba'i rnam smin myong ba la// /khyod rang 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal mkhrud cig /ces/ gsungs byung /yang nga'i bsam pa la sdug bsngal ma byed gsungs kyang nga rang mi yul na yod dus chos byed zer ba de kha chos su song / sems rtse gcig tu chos ma byas pas/ 'gyod pa ches bsams nas smre sngags 'di shar ro//a tsa ma 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal ba mthong bzhin du rang yang snying rlung ldang /sems rtse gcig gis dam chos ma byas pas/ /sdug bsngal las sangs dus med pas 'gyod/ ser sna dang chags sems ma spangs pas/ /bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal myong bas 'gyod/ /gnyen tshan gyi 'khri ba ma chod pas//ri khrod du gcig pur ma sdod 'gyod/ /phyag chen gyi sgom rim zhu lags kyang / /sems nyid kyi ngo bo ma mthong bas/ /sgom yun du ma bsrings nga re 'gyod/ /'gyod pas kyang mi phan bsam blo thongs/ /zhes pa'i smre sngags 'don zhing / chos kyi rgyal pos ci 'dra gsung yong bsam ste mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal chen po 'byung / chos phyag chen de yang / sgom pa ma yin gom sa pa yin zer ba bden/ sgom yun thung pas dngangs skrag dang /sdug bsngal 'di rnams la bzod du mi rung ba 'dug pas/ a tsa ma nga mi yul du log chog pa'i dus shig byung na/ rang gi kha ta 'gro ba'i mi rnams la/snying dmar por bton pa lta bu/ las dkar nag gi 'bras bu'i dge sdig dze2

'di rnams/ bshad nas/ nor zas rnam/sa la chags zhen ma byed par sbyin pa phyogs med thongs / 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams/ cad ling gis/ bskyur la/rang gi don yin pas chos phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo la/ lto/sa/ gang la yang chags zhen ma byed par gnyan sa ri khrod 'grims dang / rang gcig pur 'gro ba'i dus 'dug go /rgyun du yi dam snying khar bsgom sa pa dang / rang gi nye 'brel la ma chags par/ /bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba thob dang /gshin rje las mkhan rnams kyi drung du/ /dpon dang nye 'brel rnams kyis mi phan par 'dug pas/ thams cad dam pa'i chos sgrub par gyis zer dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa dang / nga rang yang chos snying thag pa nas byed dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa drag po byung zhing / chos ma byas pa'i mi rnams la 'dir skyid sdug ngo shes ni mi 'dug bsams nas mchi ma mang du shor/ rang gi brang la rang gis sbar rtsir rgyab nas// a tsa ma nga rang mi yul du sdod dus chos zhe thag pa nas ma byas pas/ da bya thabs med/ 'a༄1ོda kunang thal lo byas pas/yang nga'i zla grogs kyi ngu mo des/ 'di ltar gsungs byung /sems can sdug bsngal myong ba la/ /sper gyi sdug bsngal byed mi dgos//'jigs sna/nga dngangs/ skrag mthong gyur kyang / /khyod la nga yi zla grogs yod/ /rnam smin sdig sgrib rgyab tu 'khur/ /gnyen dang nor zas shul du lus/ /rgyab rten bla ma yi dam med/ /gcig pur bar de'i 'phrang ring 63

'dir/ /la/sa mkhan rnams kyis lag nas bzung / /pha 'bod ne / 'bod byas gyur kyang / /phan 'dogs ra zla byed mkhan med/ /de 'dra'i ji/ga pa can gyi mi/ /rnams kyi sdug bsnga/la mthong ba la/ /khyod zaring sdug bsngal ma byed par/ /longs la 'di nas yar ltos dang / /zhes zer nas byung bas/ngas ci yod dam bsam nas yar bltas pas/ lam mang po khra shig ge ba 'dug /lam dang po dkar la 'od che ba zhig 'dug pa de gang gi lam yin byas pas/ de ni rig 'dzin lha'i gnas la 'gro ba'i lam yin zer/de'i 'og na lam dmar po gcig 'dug pa de gang gi lam yin byas pas/de lha ma yin gyi lam yin zer / de'i 'og na lam sngon po gcig 'dug pa de gang gi lam yin byas pas/ de ni 'jig rten mi yul du 'gro ba'i lam yin te/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che gyang logs la sran ma gtor ba chags pa'am/ nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang dkon pas 'gro mkhan nyung ba yin no zer/ yang de'i 'og na lam ljang khu gcig 'dug pa de gang gi lam yin byas pas/ de byol song gi lam yin zer/ yang de'i 'og na ser skya dgrar sngo rol gyi khrod du mi gcig phyin pa'i rjes tsam 'dug pa de gang li lam yin byas nga/sa/ de yi dwags kyi lam yi/ zer/ de'i 'og na lam nag po gcig 'dug pa de gang gi lam yin byas pas/ de ni dpyal ba thar med la 'gro ba'i lam yin pas der ma song ba gcig dgos so/ /zer bas/ nga 'jigs shing skrag ste gang yang zer ma nus par lus so/ /64

i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal pos pho brang gi nang nas/skad kyi nga ro drag po gcig btang byung bas/ lcags ri bar bskor gyi nang nas nga bos nas ci byed zer/ der chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' sgo la/ sa pa tshe las 'das pa gcig 'dug pas/ da lta 'dir khrid shog gsung gi 'dug go zer bas/ brtenan rje las mkhan pho nya'i tshogs rnams/ mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra sgrog cing / sa gzhi bar snang thams cad chod 'gro ba tsam byas nas song bas/ sngar nga rang yong sa'i zam pa ring po de'i sna la/ a ne paṇa zhwa sna ring la lding zhwa byas pa rgyab la gra chung mig mang dang / de'i steng du khrid dpe 'khur ba'i a ne gcig /zam pa tshur ma brgal bar bkra shis kha btags gcig bton te/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang ngos la phyag mjal gyi tshul du phul nas phyag gsum btsal song /de nas gshin rje rnams la lag pas g.yug yug pa dang mnan pa lan gsum byas songo bas/ gzhin rje rnams chu phar ma bgrod par chu tshur ka der lhan rne bsdad sang /a ne btsun ma de ni lam dkar la 'tsher ba 'od dang ldan pa de la 'dzegs nas song / lam gyi bar sked de nas dbu zhwas g.yab g.yug mdzad cing / gsung snyan la ring bas 'di ltar gsung gin 'dug go /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ pa la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing sdig pa'i tshogs kun bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bzhugs//dze5

sem/sa can sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /rang rang so so'i las las grub pa yi/ /dmya/la ba mnar med sdug bsngal myong mkhan rnams/ /nga dang 'brel ba yod tshad yar shog dang / /blo ma rig spongs la yar shag dang / /nga chos dbyings rnam dag zhing du 'gro/ /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /pha ma slob dpon rgyab tu bskrur ba'i mi/ /dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal myong mkhan rnams/ /nga dang chos 'brel thogs tshad yar shag dang / /blo zhe sdang spongs la yar shog dang / /nga ni shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing du 'gro//ma/ gi lha gas ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /rang rang nor la ser sna byas pa'i mi/ /dmyal ba bkres skom sdug bsngal myong mkhan tsho/ /nga dang zas 'brel thogs tshad yar shag dang / /blo phrag dog spongs la yar shog dang //nga ni byang phyogs lcang lo can du 'gro/ /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /rang lus ma thug log g.yem byas pa'i mi/ /pags pa tshal bzhus sdug bsngal myong mkhan tsho/ /nga la lus 'brel/ thogs tshad yar shog dang //blo 'dod chags spongs la yar shog dang / /nga ni nub phyogs bde ba can du 'gro/ /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /srog gcod rku dang 'phung sbyor byas pa'i mi/ /dmyal ba btso bsreg sdug bsngal myong mkhan tsho/ /nga dang ga/tam 'brel thogs tshad yar shag dang / /blo nga rgyal spongs la yar shog dang / /nga ni lho phyogs dpal ldan zhing du 'gro/ /ma gi dmyal khams bco brgyad nang dag na/ /rang nor sbyin par gtong bar ma nus shing //6dze

gzhan gyi nor la hab zas byas pa'i mi/ /bdud 'joms/ ngu 'bod sdu/ga bsngal myong mkhan rnams/ /dge ba'i bsam pa yod tshad yar shog dang //blo gti mug spongs la yar shog dang / /nga ni bka' brgyud bla ma'i tsha mo ste//dam chos nā ro chos drug nyam/sa su blangs/ /'don pa gtsang gi se brag g.ya' lung na/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du song ngo bgyis/ /zhes gsungs byung bas/ ma gi lcags ri'i khor yug gi nang nas dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal myong ba'i mi rnams dang / dmyal ba'i thig gcod dang ngu 'bod dang pags pa tshal bzhus dang / lcags khar sgo med kyi nang na yod pa'i mi rnams dang bcas pa gshin rje rnams kyis bzung yang ma thub par thams cad khong gi rjes nas yar la song ngo / /zangs mo che gzhi ma yin zer ba che chung la g.yu mtsho tsam gcig 'dug pa'i nang nas mi mang po 'tshed kyi 'dug pa yang kha sbub la song nas mi brgya phrag mang po thon song / /zangs de'i mthil du mi brgya tsam 'byar nas sdod 'dug /mthil du 'byar ba rnams kyi nang na mi phran bu ngo shes pa yang 'dug /lho phyogs nas dbu mdzad dpal 'byor zer ba yang 'dug /nga rang gis ngo mi shes kyang gtsang gi phyogs nas mda' dpon 'gog lung ba yin zer ba yang 'dug /gtsang gangs can nas dpon mo chos kyi zer ba yang 'dug /ya 'grog ri bo brag na gnas po as bkras zer ba yang 'dug /lcags rtse gri gu'i gzhol nas gnas chen bsod nams dar rgyas dze7

zer ba yang 'dug /sma/da 'tshong ma bsod nams g.yang can ma zer ba yang 'dug /sa gcig tshong 'dus tshong sna'i lung pa nas btsun pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin zer ba yang 'dug /sa gcig mkho mthing lha khang nas/dkon mchog lhun grub zer ba yang 'dug /gzhan yang mi ngo mi shes pa mang po 'dug /ming bshad pa rnams kyi sdig pa'i bshags thabs dang / nang tshan rnam sa la 'phrin pa mang du bskur byung ste da lan 'dir yi ger ma bkod do/ /zangs kyi mthil du 'byar ba de rnams ma gtogs gzhan thams cad a rne de'i phyi bzhin rig 'dzin gyi sa la 'gro ba yin zer nas song ngo / /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang pho brang de'i nang nas skad kyi nga ro drag po gcig btang byung ste/ las rgyu 'bras la ma rtsis pa dge ba'i 'bras bu med pa rnams mar la khrid shog cig zer bas/ der gzhin rje'i las mkhan mang po bar snang thams cad 'grib 'gro ba tsam byas nas langs song mi de rnams kyi ting nge dzodzan pa dang gshin rje las mkhan thams cad rlung dmar chen ngo/ gcig tu byas te/ mi de rnam sa thams cad yar brdabs mar brdabs la/na 'i /nga po dkrugs song / zas 'brel dang chos 'brel thogs pa'i mi rnams cha gcig tu byas nas yar song / zas 'brel dang chos 'brel gang yang thogs pa'i mi rnams cha gcig byas nas yar song / zas 'brel/ dang chos 'brel gang yang ma thogs pa'i mi cha gnyis tsam mar slog nas khrid byung ste 'i /ra yong ma/khan rnams ni 'di ltar zer gyin 'dug go /dran pa sgang la dze8

theg mkhan yod zer na/ /mi rnams/ kun la 'phrin pa 'di ltar mdzod//yar gyi dkon mchog gsum la zhabs tog dang / /mar ngan slong la sbyi na pa thongs gsungs dang / /chos mdzad rtogs ldan pho mo su/ byon kyang //zhabs tog bkur sti bgyis la 'brel ba thogs/ /las 'phro gang la gang yod mi shes pas/ /phyogs ris med par dge ba ci 'grub gyis/ /yi ge drug pa phan yon rab che bas/ /bya ba thongs las ma ṇi pad+me sgrongs/ /rgyal khams 'grim pa'i bla ma ma ṇi par/ /'bul ba ma ṇi'i bskul ma phul cig gyis/ /nag po sdig pa'i las la ma 'dzems na/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal 'di 'dra myong gin 'dug /chos pa bzang ngo/ra 'brel pa ma thogs par//lan gcig thon kyang slar yang bcug song gyis/ /zhes zer to/ /de rnams ni gshin rje rnams kyis mar khrid nas rang rang gi sdug bsngal myong du bcug song / de'i nang nas bud med dbus pa gos stag phrug dang stod gos ser po la nag po'i khra yod pa gyon pa mu tig gis thod pa bcings pa gcig gshin rje rnams kyis lcags kyus snying kha nas bzung ste byung bas/ bud me da de ni gzhogs/ kyi mi dang sa rdo tham sa cad la baprung zhing lag pa thal mo thab thab byas nas 'di skad zer to/ /mi ru/la dran nga/ sgang la theg zer na/ /nga dang 'dra ba'i bud med ma byed gyis/ /sgo/sa su/ mi/ga ser phrag dog ma/ byed par/ /chos pa rnams la zhabs tog gyis gsung dang / /dge ba gtong la ngan bkag ma byed par/ /yar mchod mar sbyin dge ba gang dze9

grub gyis// /khyad par kha smras/ chi+og rtswab la sogs dang / /yang sgos chos par bskur zhus ma byed gyis/ /nga 'dra'i bud med las ngan tshogasi/ ma bsags// /'di 'dra 'dug go zer ba'i 'phrin mdzod cig /ces zer bas mo khrid mkhan ni gshin rje des ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar nas/ rgyab grabs byed cing 'di skad zer to/ /bud med khyod mi yul dran pa sgang la sdod pa'i dus/ las ngan pa'i sdig pa chen po bsags shing / khyad par bla ma sangs rgyas mi/ lpa/gas gyon pa de lta bu la zhabs tog byed cing mi phal pa la lab lab byas chog pa'i dus su/ khyod skyid du ma tshor / dad pa dang zhabs tog ma byas/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang lda/na pa de la chos med zog ma/khan yin zer zhing gtam ngan du gleng / khyod kyis mi rnams las phung dang g.yo sgru byas nas/pho dkar dang mo nag 'dug zer zhing 'dis skyes pa thams cad kyi mgo bskor/sgos bu mo rnams la ci min sna dgu'i gtam mang du gleng pas/ bu mo rnams kyang blo ngan du song bas/ pha mas bcol ba'i 'dun ma la mi nyan par/bzhag sar mi sdod/ btang sar mi 'gro ba bu mo thams cad kyi 'dun ma rlung la bskur ma khan de chos me da zog po 'di'i las yin mod/ 'di nged rang cho'i lu/nga pa'i phur sdod nas yul 'di'i rlag shing du 'gro ba 'dug zer zhing /mi tham/sa cad gdong du phar la/ba tshung lab byas nas mi khas lung pa khengs pa bcas/ so/ /de'i las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / bla ma mtshan nyid dang lda/na pa de lta/ bu la/ lag ngan gyi brdungs rdzob dang tshig ngan gyi bskur pa btab pa la brten nas/ snying la lcags kyus/ bzung / lus la lcags gzer stong 70

btab kha la khro chu khol ma rgyun du blugs/ sdug bsngal des kyang mi chog par da rung dmyal ba ngu 'bod kyi gnas su 'khrid nas lo drug cu re bdun sdug bsngal myong 'jug rgyu yin zer bas/bud med de'i kha nas 'di skad zer gyin 'dug /kye ma kyi hud las ngan can ma nga / /bla ma sangs rgyas yin par ma shes par/ /dad log bskur zhus byas pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /sdug bsngal dos drag yun ring myong dgos 'dug /nga yi sdong grogs dge ba legs pa la/ /'phrin pa 'di ltar bskur byung gsungs rogs mdzod/ /bla ma'i thugs snang sdig pa sbyong ba la/ /gser gyi mchod rten tsha tsā mang du thob/ /skur pa tshabs chen btab pa'i bshags pa la/ /mdo sde bskal bzang sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum bzhengs/ /bla ma'i phyag rdzas spyad pa'i mthud ma la/ /nor zas gang yod bla ma bzang la phul/ /gzhan yang phyag dang bskore ba la sogs pa/ sdig pa dag thabs gang drag byed rogs bgyis/ /skyid dus 'grogs pa'i grogs kyis ma bsam na/ /sdug bsngal 'di las thar dus mi 'dug go /zhes zer zhing / gshin rje rnams kyis khrid song ngo / /e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ /yang chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang nas/ skad kyi nga ro chen po gcig btang nas snga rim gyis khrid shog cig zer ba byung /der sgo srung gi gshin rje gcig na re/ da khyod rang gnyis chos kyi rgyal po'i 71

drung du shag zer ba'i brda yin pa 'dug zer bas/ de ma thag nga'i snying la mda' phog pa lta bu byung / 'dir bsdad na ni sems can rnams rang rang gi sdug bsngal 'di lta bu myong ba mthong bas/ nga rang yang sems la bde ba skad cig tsam yang ma thob/ da ni chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs su 'gro dgos pa 'dug /rang dbang yod dus chos rnam dag gcig ma byas pas lta ba'i gdeng dang bsgoms pa'i nyams ni med/ gnas dang ri rnams bskor nas dka' ba ni ma spyad/ rten gsum dang dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa phul yod zer rgyu ni med/ rang dbang yod dus zang zing gi sbyin pa ni ma btang / 'on kyang nga rang gis yi dam lha la gsol ba drag tu btab yod pas thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig /ces gsol ba btab nas ngus pas/ nga rang gi zla grogs kyi bu mo des nga'i mchi ma phyis nas yar bslangs te/ khyod kyis zang zing gi sbyin pa btang ba dang sgom brtan po thob pa med kyang / sems la sdig sgrib ma zhugs par/ me long g.ya' dag pa lta bu 'dug cing khyod dang nga gnyis sngon nas las dang smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pas/ nga yis khyod kyi lam sna 'dren no zer nas/ nga'i lag pa nas bzung ste/lcags ri'i rdo skas chen po de la yar khrid byung bas/ lus 'dar ba'i ngang nas ya gi bde yangs chen po der bslebs byung / bde yangs chen po de'i dbus na gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba de ni khri'u shing gi steng na/ gu ru rin po che'i sku/ sku mdog phyag mtshan na bza' rgyan cha lugs thams cad/bris sku la yod pa lta bu mngon sum du mthong / mthong ma thag tu lus ba spu khung

g.yo shing gdung shugs drag pos mchi ma mang du shar/ phyag dang bskor ba byed dgos bsams kyang g.yas g.yon gyi khro bo khro mo rnams la 'jigs skrag nas ma nus/ khro bo khro mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs can dar nag gi na bza' gsol ba/ la la ni mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag gzig gi lpags pa'i sham thabs byas pa/ mi mgo'i do shal dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ mche ba gangs ri tsam gcigs pa/ mig khro tshugs su blta ba/rkan sgra gtog pa 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can rngams shing khro ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug /de rnams kyi nang nas/ sku gzhogs g.yas nas gzhin rje glang gi mgo can gcig gis srid pa las kyi me long 'phyar grin 'dug /de'i 'gram na gshin rje stag gi mgo can mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pas yi ge 'bri zhing 'dug /sku gzhogs g.yon nas gdug pa skrul gyi mgo can bya ra byed kyin 'dug /de'i mdun du bya rog dang phag gi mgo can rtsis dang chu tshod blta gin 'dug /gzhan yang gshin rje las mkhan sprel mgo can dang /dom mgo can la sogs pa rnams ni lcags kyu dang zhags pa ral gri dang tho ba dang be con la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phyar zhing mi rnams shar nub lho byang gang nas su byon bya ra byed cing 'dug /gshin rje'i 'jigs skrag de rnams mthong bas rang dbang med par brgyal nas 'gyel lo/ /73

yang nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des nga yar bslangs nas 'di skad gsungs byung / khyod mgo nas btegs nas 'dzings nas bor/ ya gi spu gri bye thang kha ru ngo sprad pa de ma dran nam/ da lta dbus na bzhugs pa 'di ni phyi ltar gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yin/ nang ltar na gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje yin/de'i g.yas kyi spyan khro tshugs su lta ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa rnams ni/phyi ltar na gshin rje'i pho nya yin/ nang ltar na 'phags pa 'jam dpal khros pa yin pas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan nas brjod de gsol ba btab na 'jigs skrag las grol 'gro/ g.yon phyogs na rtsis lta zhing bya ra byed pa rnams ni phyi ltar na gshin rje'i pho nya yin/ nang ltar na rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa khros pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs sngags brjod na mtho ris kyi gnas su 'dren pas legs par zungs / khyod la sdig sgrib chen po mi 'dug pas sdug bsngal ma byed par yar longs/ phyag dang bskor ba gyis/ gsol ba dang smon lam thob dang gsung byung yang / ngas phyag gcig btsal smon lam rgya chen po 'debs pa ma byung /de nas gdug pa sbul gyi mgo can gyis 'dir sdod zer ba'i brda byas byung bas zur cig tu bsdad pas chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs nas skad kyi nga ro drag po cig lcags ri'i khor yug tu btang song / lcags ri khor yug gi nang nas nga bos nas ci byed zer byung / yang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs nas/ 'jig rten mi yul nas tshe las 'das pa gcig yong gin 74

'dug pas da lta nyid du 'dir khrid shog cig gsungs song bas/ lcags ri khor yug gi nang nas gzhin rje'i las mkhan lag na mdzadzan cha sna tshogs thogs pa mang po hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa byas nas sa gzhi bar snang thabs cad chod 'gro ba tsam byas nas song / ya gi nas mar la skye dman gser ma bzhag sgor tsam byas pa gcig sleb byung bas/ ga'an rje las mkhan rnams mthong ba dang / skye dman de dum cig bros kyang ma thar bar kha log byas nas ma ṇi dbyug rdo rdeb cing / i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zer gyi 'dug/ma ṇi sgra thos pa dang gzhin rje rnams rang sar sdod song / des mo rang gi zla la / lha sa dkar po'i gos kru+on pa/ skra spyi bor bcings nas/ dar nag pos bsdams pa/ lag na dung gi 'phreng ba khyer ba gcig gis/ bud med de'i dpung pa nas bzung ste khrid byung bas/ gshin rje rnams mo la rgyab dbang dang 'dzin dbang med par yangs khrol le song / skye dman de chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mdun du sleb pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas nga'i mdun na yod pa'i bud med khyod kyis/ spyir lho 'dzam bu gling du skyes/ sgos mi lus rin chen thob nas / yar bla ma dkon mchog la zhabs tog byas sam/mar ngan slong la sbyin pa btang ngam/ bar du sems can la snying rje bsgoms sam/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag phyir du phyag dang bskor ba byas sam/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag phyir du yi ge drug pa bgrangs sam/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag phyir du phyag rgya chen po bsgoms sam/ pha ma'i zhabs nas bteg gam/ rgyun du thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab bam/ yul gser gling du phyin nas 75

stong log ma byas sam/ mi lus rin po che thob nas stong log byas sam ma byas da lta nyid du shad cig /ces gsung gin 'dug pas/ mo ni lus 'dar zhing ma chags par 'gyel song /der g.yon phyogs nas lha dkar po de langs nas/ da ni sdug bsngal byas kyang mi phan sha khrag gi lus ni mi yul dran pa sgang du lus/las kyi rnam par smin pa ni/ da ni chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du gtam rnams gsal por shad cig zer bas/ mo ni lus 'dar zhing skad ngu skad du byas nas zhu ba 'di ltar 'bul grin 'dug go /kye ma chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /yul phyogs skye sa dbus kyi phyogs nas yin/ /nga yi ming la bsam gtan skyid pa zer/ /mi yul bsdad dus bya ba 'di ltar byas/ /zhes dang / nga rang chos byed pa'i 'dun pa drag po yod kyang / pha ma gnyis kyis 'jig rten gyi bya bar bcug nas chos byed dbang ma byung /'jig rten la song nas bu tsha gnyis kyang skyes/ der yong skabs lung pa la dmar nad drag po byung ste/ rang yang bsod nams ma bsags par phru gu gnyis gtan grogs dang bcas pa shi/ de rnams kyi rjes su dge ba gang 'gro yang nga rang gi pha ming la sna ma 'gugs par thugs mnyes pa'i stabs kyis/dang po skye sa btub nas log 'gro sa ma byung / 'di ni rigs ngan zhing kha ma 'gro ba yin zer/ pha mi nga rnams kyang mi kha'i 'og tu song bas nga rang mi yul gzhan du 'khyams dgos pa byung / lto lam gyi g.yas g.yon na btsal 7dze

nas bsdad pas dge ba stobs chen ni gtong rgyu ma byung / dkon mchog la zhabs tog dang / ngan slong la sbyin pa dum tsam re btang / gzhan yang bla ma ma ṇi pa rnams la 'bul ba dang zhabs tog byas/ ma ṇi'i bskul ma phul/ma ṇi'i dam bca' yang blangs/ lta ba'i gdeng med kyang gnas rigs rnams la gnas 'brel re byas smon lam re btab/ grogs ldan pho mo rnams la za ma phor pa re la sogs gang byung gi 'brel pa re byas/ bla ma ma ṇi ba rdo la sku dang / ma ṇi rko mkhan spyan phyis dus zhar ba yin zer ba'i spyan ya gcig long ba gcig byung bas/ de la thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas zhus bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas/ gtong mkhan rnams la zhabs tog kyang zhus/ma gi'i tsir tsir 'ur 'ur zer ba de la ma gtong rogs mdzod cig zer nas/mchi ma bsham gyis 'dug /yang g.yon phyogs nas lha dkar po des/ chos kyi rgyal po la phyag gcig btsal nas 'di skad zhus song / kye ma / chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /skye sa rigs khungs mo rang zhus pa bzhin/ /rkang pas 'khyams nas bsags pa'i nor med kyang / /yar mchod mar sbyin dge ba ci grub byas/ /bar du sems can rnams la snying rje bsgoms/ /rtogs ldan pho mo rnams la zhabs tog phul/ /ma ṇi pa la zhabs tog bsnyen bkur nas/ /dam bca' blangs nas yig drug rgyun du bgrangs/ /gnyen gnas smyung gnas srung ba'i mi rnams la/ /bkur sti zhabs tog ma ṇi'i bskul ma 77

sogs/ /dge ba byas pa'i phan yon 'bras bu rnams/ /bsags pa'i rde'u dkar po 'di tsam yod/ /ces zer zhing rde'u dkar po bre gang tsam gcig spungs song / yang g.yas phyogs nas 'dre nag po yin zer ba'i mi nag po ras kyi ang rag gyon zhing lag na ras khug nag po khyer ba gcig langs nas/ nam mkha' la ha lan gsum brgyab nas/ 'di skad zer to//chos kyi rgyal po sku che yang / /mo yi sdig pa bkag mi tshugs/ /mo ngan bsam skyid zer ba khyod/ /gzhan gyi skyes pa sems la bcug /sngon nas bskos pa'i phru gu dang / /grogs la phangs med ma byas sam/ /dkon mchog zhabs 'degs ga ru byas/ /ngan slong sbyin pa ga ru btang / /pha ma dad gus nam byas pa/ /nag po sdig pa bsags pa yi// /rde'u 'di tsam yod do ang / /zhes zer zhing rde'u nag po bre phyed tsam gcig spungs song /de nas spre'u mgo can gyis langs nas lha 'dre gnyis mi 'cham pa byed mi dgos/ nga yi srang 'di ma gsang ba'i srang tshad yin/ /rde'u dkar nag srang la bteg pas chog zer te/ rde'u srang la btegs song / yang spre'u mgo can gyi zhal nas / rde'u dkar po mang zhing lji da yang lci la/ nag po nyung zhing ljid kyang yang bar 'dug pas/ 'di ni mtho ris kyi gnas la gtong bar mdzod cig zer/ yang sku gzhogs g.yas nas gshin rje glang gi mgo can des/ srid pa las kyi me long de chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mdun du 'phyar song bas/ chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis mi yul du dran pa 78

sgang du bosdad pa'i dus/ dkor po dge ba'i+o las byas zer ba yang bden par 'dug ga /yar dkan mchag la zhabs tag kyang byas 'dug /mar ngan slong la sbyin pa yang btang 'dug /rgyun du ma ṇi pad+me yang bgrangs 'dug/bla ma ma ṇi pa rnams la zhabs tog dang 'bul ba yang byas 'dug /rtogs ldan pho mo rnams la rtsam pa sder ma re'i 'brel pa zhus 'dug /gzhan yang zang zing gi dge ba shugs chen ma byas kyang / phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa dge ba'i sna mang du bsags 'dug /khyod la sdig pa med zer ba mi bden par 'dug /khyod bag ma btang ba'i dus su pha su yin 'di yin med pa'i phru gu gcig byung 'dug /phyug po chen po'i bag mar ma tshud dogs nas/khyod kyis med par btang 'dug /rang gi phru gu bsad pa sdig mi che ba e yin/ rkang leb brgya bsad pa bas rang gi phru gu bsad pa sdig pa che ba yin/khyod dmyal ba ma gtogs 'gro sa med kyang / khyod kyis de la 'gyod sems byas nas lus kyi sgo nas phyag dang bskor ba byas/ ngag gi sgo nas yi ge drug pa rgyun du bgrangs / bla ma ma ṇi pa rnams kyi drung du bshags pa'i tshig rkang mang du brjod cing 'gyod sems drag po byas pas/ sdig pa de dag 'dug /gzhan yang yar dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / dge 'dun la zhabs tog zhus 'dug ste/ khyod kyi bsam pa la khong phyug po rnams kyi zhabs tog zhus pa dang / ngas zhabs tog zhus pa la che chung med kyang //khong phyug po rnams gral gyi mgo ru bzhag /dpa' dar dang gnang sbyin bzang po gnang gi 'dug /nga gral gyi smad du gdan med du bzhag /lto dang 79

gnang sbyin yang stong min tsam ma gtogs ma/ byung / zhabs tog che chung la mi/ lta bar kha drag dang bzang po mdog bzang ngan la lta mkhan rkyang pa yin par 'dug bsam/ sems ye 'khun byas 'dug pas rkang rjes babs bsubs su sang nas mi 'dug /gzhan khyod kyis da mi lus thob pa 'dug ste/zhabs tog byas nas sems ye 'khun byas pa'i nyes pas/ da lan bya rgod gcig tu skye ba longs shig /de nas/ mi lus thob pa yod do gsungs song /der skye dman de'i kha nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /las 'phro can ma mi yul byon zer na/ /kun la 'phrin pa 'di ltar gsungs rogs mdzod/ /yar gyi dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang / /mar gyi ngan slong rnams la sbyin pa thongs/ /yi dam spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob/ /snying po yi ge drug pa rgyun du sgrongs/ /ma ṇi pad+me phan yon gzhan las che/ /dge ba bsags pa'i 'bras bu 'dug go gyis/ /dkon mchog rnams la zhabs tog zhu dus su/ /ngas byas 'dug yus ye 'khun ma byed gyis/ /blo phugs chos la gtad na khyim pas kyang / /bar do dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thar song gyis//zhes ze+or nos byol song gi lam la zhugs te bya dgo bo gcig tu skye ba len par sang nga /e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas 'jig rten mi yul na tshe las 'das pa gcig yong gin 'dug pas/ da lta 'dir khrid shog gsung gi 'dug/ gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams sngar ltar byas nas 80

langs song / zam pa chen po'i sna ya gi nas/ skyes pa dar rgan skre/ spyi bor bcings pa/ durdzos dmar po dang sto/da gos dkar po sbo lhug byas pa/gzan dkar po la nag po'i sgom chen byas pa/ lag na 'phreng ba byang ma thogs pa gcig /gshin rje rnams kyis 'dzin ma thub par khong rang gi g.yon phyogs nas lha dkar po phyag g.yon shel gyi 'phreng ba dang g.yas ras kyi khug ma rnams pa des dpung pa nas/ bzung ste/ gshin rje rnams kyi khrod du yangs khrol gyis khrid byung / skyes pa de ni lus 'dar zhing mchi ma 'don pa dang / lag pa g.yas g.yon res mos mchi ma phyis nas/ 6ṭoṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes zer i 'dug /de nas chos kyi rgyal pos mi de la sngar bzhin 'dri ba zhib par mdzad song bas/ mi des chos kyi rgyal po la phyag gsum btsal nas 'di skad zhu gin 'dug /kye ma kyi hud chos kyi rgyal po lags// bad/ga gi yul/ ni btsan gro gtam gzhol nas/ /rigs ni jo bo ming la dpal 'byor zer //mi yul bsdad dus bya ba 'di ltar byas/ /zhes dang / nga rang chung ngu nas 'chi ba la 'jigs nas blo chos su rung ba tsam ma gtogs/ 'di na brtsi grangs 'di lta bu yod pa ni ma shes/ nged spun gsum yod pas nga gzhon shos yin/ rgan pa mkhar chu'i btsun pa/ gtso ri pa yang yun ring du byas//nga rang gi bsam pa la spun 'bring po la thab khur gtad nas nga rang chos byed bsam pa yin te/ spun 'bring pos bsam pa zas su ma bzas par nang gi 81

nor zas rnams/ khur skye dman logs su btsal nas/ pha mas gros btab kyang ma thebs/ de dus pha ma dang nye 'khor rnams kyis nga la khyod kyis chos byas pas mi yong / pha gzhis 'dzin dgos zer nas zhu ba nan ltar byas byung bas/ nga rang gi bsam pa la 'jig rten gyi bya ba 'di la skyo ba skyes kyang pha ma yi chad bcug na mi yong bsam nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba byed dgos byung lags/ nga rang gi khang pa de g.yar dgun ston dpyid med par rgya lam phog pa'i gdong zhig na yod pas/ rtogs ldan pho mo gang na su phebs kyang thugs dam bzang ba dang bzhugs long yod pa rnams la lo phogs phul/ de 'og la zla phogs dang bcu phogs zhag bdun re la sogs pa gang dgyes re phul/gzhan ma rnams la gang 'byor gyi zas 'brel re bzhag /nga rang 'jig rten byas nas 'dir ma sleb bar du khyim sdig rnams kyang spangs/ bla ma dang dpon slob rnams kyi drung du rang nor phul nas sdig sgrib bsags pa dag phyir du bshags pa yang byas/ yi ge brgya pa zhag re la gang 'thon re 'dren pa'i dam bca' yang phul/ yang rgyal khams 'grim pa'i bla ma ma ṇi pa gcig phebs byung bas/ nga rang gis ma ṇi'i gzhi gzung nas yul pa rnams la ma ṇi 'dren par shog zer skad btang / ma ṇi 'dren mkhan rnams la/ mtshan mo phye ma/ra phor pa re dang / nyin bar rtsam pa sder ma re dang chang phor re byin/ma ṇi grangs 'dzin pa la ni ma ṇi 'dren pa dang mi 'dren pa cha phyed las mi 'dug pas grangs gsog pa ni ma byung / zhag bdun btsugs// ma ṇi thon tsa na/ nga rang gi gos skya phrug gcig yod pa des mgo byas pa'i 'bul ba 82

bdun mtshan gcig phul/ bla ma la dbu zhwa gcig kyang phul/ rgyal khams la ma ṇi'i bskul ma ma dzad rogs mdzod byas nas kha btags cis kyang phul/nga rang gis zhag re la ma ṇi khri tshar re bgrangs pa'i dam bca' yang phul/lha sa bsam yas gnyis la drel rgyab gnyis kyi mchod me 'bul du btang /mkhar chu'i ri logs la yang lan mang du btang / nga rang gis gnyen gnas dang smyung gnas kyang bsrungs/ nor rnams la snying po mi 'dug bsams nas yul pa rnams la ston mo yang btang / dkon mchog gi zhabs tog ni thabs gzhan la dpag pa'i gang drag byas/ rgyun du rgyal po mdo lnga dang yi ge drug pa kha ton byas/ lta ba'i gdeng dang bsgoms pa'i nyams med kyang / bla ma ma ṇi pa las thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas zhus nas rgyun du thugs rje chen po bsgoms lags pas/ ma gi tsi tsi 'ur 'ur zer ba de la mi gtong rogs mdzod cig/ ces zer ba na/ g.yon phyogs nas lha dkar po de langs nas/ chos kyi rgyal po la phyag btsal te 'di skad zhu gin 'dug /chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mi 'di'i skye bo byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /'jig rten khyim thab byas kyang chos la mos//dkar po dge ba'i phyogs la lhag pa dang / /nag po sdig nga/'i phyogs la shin tu 'dzem/ /dkon mchog gsum la zhabs tog bkur bsti byas/ /ngan slong rnams la sbyin pa phyogs med btang / /ngag nas yi ge drug pa rgyun du 83

sgrongs/ /bas/ma/ pa dge zhing chos/ la/ dkar ba yin/ /phan yon bas/gas pa'i rje'u 'di tsam yod/ /ma/tho ris thar pa'i gnas la gtong bar mdzod //ces zer nas rde'u dkar po bre gsum tsam/ gcig spungs song / ya/nga g.yas phyogs nas 'dre nag ngo/ de la/ngas nas 'di skad zer to/ /chos kyi rgyal po gsan mdzod cig /mi ngan dpal 'byor zer ba 'di/ /blo ngan bsam/ ngan khong du bcug /tsher ma ngar g.yogs ma byas sam/ /phyi ru zhabs tog byed do skad/ /rtogs ldan pho mo'i chang re bas/ /dkon mchog zhabs 'degs ga ru byas/ /ngan slong sbyin pa nam btang ba/ /chos pa pho mo'i nor zas rnams/ /khyod kyis/ ngan bsdoms ma byas sam/ /gnyen dang yul mi tham sa cad la/ /zhe sdang mtho dogs ma byas sam/ /khyod kyis dge ba byas pa ni/ /zhe sdang kha drag ngos nas byas/ /khyod kyis thab sdig spangs zer nas/ /rtswa gtsang chu gtsang 'thung pa yi/ /ri dwags mang po khyod kyis bsad/ /rang gi pha ma yid chad bcug /bya ba ngan pa khyod kyis byas//dmyal ba min pa 'gro sa med// sdi ga pa byas pa'i 'bras bu la/ /nag po'i rje+o'u 'di tsam yod/ /ces zer nas rde'u nag po bre phyed tsam gcig spungs sang /der chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas / las dkar nag gi rde'u srang la theg cig gsung gi 'dug pas/ spre 'u'i ma go can gyis langs nas rde'u sra/nga la༈ btegs song bas sprel mgro'i zhal nas/ rde'u nag po yangs shing dkar 84

po lci bar 'dug pas 'di ni mtho ris kyi gnas la gtong bar 'i /dz+rod cig/ces zer bas / yang chos kyi dzol ngo/'i g.yas phyogs nas rak+shi glang gi ma go can des sri/da pa las kyi me long de chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mdun du 'phyar song bas/ chos kyis rgyal pos me long la gzigs pa dang / zhal 'dzum pa gcig mdzad nas 'di skad gsung gin 'dug /mi lus rin po che thob nas stong log min tsam byas 'dug /khyod rang zer ba ltar dge ba byas zer ba bden par 'dug /sdig pa ma byas zer ba mi bden par 'dug /khyod gzhon pa'i dus na byis pa zla grogs rnams dang bstun nas ri bong dang sreg pa bco lnga bcu drug tsam bsad 'dug /khyod rang 'jig rten gzhi gdings pa'i dus g.yag bzhi dang ra lug 'dres pa bcu gsum bsad 'dug /gzhan khyod kyis dge ba'i las thob che bar byas pa dang bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas bsrungs pa rnams 'dir gsal 'dug /dkon mchog la zhabs tog yang byas 'dug /ngan slong la sbyin pa yang btang 'dug /rgyun du thugs rje chen po la gsol ba yang btab 'dug /ma ṇi'i bzlas pa bsnyen sgrub kyang byas 'dug /lhag par du tshad ldan gyi jo bo rin po che la dkar me dang zhal zas phul/ smon lam yang go ma log pa btab 'dug /pha ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub cing zhabs nas btegs pa dang / dge ba gang grub byas 'dug pas/g.yag dang lug dang ri bong na mas bsad pa'i sdig pa dag 'dug /gzhan yang lus kyi sgrib pa dag phyir du phyag dang bskor ba yang byas 'dug /ngag gi sgrib pa dag phyir du yi ge drug pa yang bgrangs 'dug /yid kyi sgrib pa 85

dag phyir du chos phyag rgya chen po'i sgom gcig byas na khyod rig 'dzin gyi sa thob pa 'dug ste/ da lan 'di nas gtsang gung sa stod kyi phyogs na btsan skyabs zer ba yod do/ de'i bu ru skye ba len par song zhig /sngar sbyin pa btang ba'i 'bras bu longs spyod kyang che bar yong ngo / der dge ba stobs chi ba gyis shig /mi lo drug cu re bdun song ba dang tshe'i dus byed par 'dug pas 'dir shog cig rig 'dzin gyi sa thob pa byed do/ /ces gsungs nas spyan sgor le ba gcig mdzad nas bzhugs song /mi de ni ki ki zer zhing mthe bong gnam la ker nas mi'i lam ser skya de la bzhugs te song / lam gyi bar rked ya gi nas 'di skad zer grin 'dug /dran pa sgang la byon mkhan yod zer na/ /mi rnams kun la 'phrin pa 'di ltar mdzod// lho brag lung nas btsan gro gtam zhol gyi/ /nga dpal 'byor gyis 'phrin pa bskur byung gyis/ nor yod pa sbyin par thongs shig gyis/ /yar dkon mchog la zhabs tog zhus shig gyis/ /mar ngan slong la sbyin pa thong zhig gyis/ /rgyun du ma ṇi pad+me sgrongs shig gyis/ /thugs rje phrin las 'dug go gyis/ /ngan song sgo mo bgegs kyi gyis/ /nga dpal 'byor gyis mi lus thob par gyis/ /rting ma rig 'dzin gyi sa la 'gro yong gyis/ zhes zer nas/ gtsang gung sa stod du mi lus len par song ngo //i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ gshin rje rnams kyis btsun pa rgan po gcig khrid byung / mi de la chos kyi rgyal pos sngar bzhin 86

'dri ba mdzad song bas/ mi des lus 'dar zhing lag pa thal mo sbyar nas tshul 'di ltar zhu ba 'angul gyin 'dug go /chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /yul phyogs lho brag man chad lung pa nas/ /nga yi ming la ngag dbang grags pa zer/ /rigs rgyud thug sa gu ru'i brgyud pa yin/ /lta ba gdeng dang sgom pa'i nyams med kyang / /slob shes yon tan bla ma'i zhabs nas bteg /rab byung byas nas sdig pa'i las rnams spangs/ /rgyun du badz+ra gu ru ma yengs sgrong / /snying rje drag pos sems can srog kyang bslus/ /gzhan ma sbyin pa gtong rgyu tsher med kyang / /dkon mchog thugs rje gzigs la ma gi yi/ /tsir tsir 'ur 'ur zer ba de la mi gtong 'tshal/ /zhes zhus pa dang /mi de'i g.yon phyogs nas/ /lha dkar po de bzhengs nas 'di skad du/ /chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mi 'di'i rigs rgyud ma nor gu ru'i rgyud/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub cing yon tan bslabs//rgyun du chos skyong bskang gso bzlas pa byas/ /nor zas med pas sbyin pa ma btang yang / /mi sems dkrugs pa'i mi nor blangs pa med/ /snying rje drag pos sems kyis ma bzod nas/ /ling pa drug gi lag nas ri dwags bslus/ /nyams chung mi rnams lung stong jag pa yi/ /'jigs pa yod sar skyabs dang skyel ma byas/ /dge bskul dang blangs tshogs dang bsngo rten phul/ /ngan slong rnams la sgo phye 'brel pa byas/ /gzhan yang badz+ra gu ru 87

bgrangs pa sogs/ /dge ba bsags pa'i sde'u 'di tsam yod/ /ces zer nas/ rde'u dkar po bre phyed tsam zhig spungs song /yang g.yas phyogs nas 'dre nag po kho langs nas/ 'di skad zer to/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du zhu rgyu yod/ /mi ngan ngag dbang grags pa zer ba 'di/ /dad zas gshin zas dkor ni mang du bzas/ /dkor sbyong byas so snyam yang nyin skar tsam/ /khyod kyi dkor lan tsam gcig nam btang ba/ /sems can ri dwags srog bslu byed do zer/ /ra dang lug rnams khyod kyis gsod du bcug /bla ma'i thugs ni khyod kyis ma dkrugs sam//dam tshig nyams pas dkon mchog bka' chad byung / /rgyu 'bras ma 'dzem dkor la khyod kyis 'bags/ /bden tshig ma blta bka' rnams log par bltas/ /bya ba ngan pa byas pa'i rde'u yin/ /zhes zer zhing n+de'u nag po bre gang tsam gcig spungs song / /yang spre 'u'i mgo can gyi langs nas sngar bzhin rde'u dkar nag btegs song / spre'u'i mgo can na re/ rde'u dkar nag gnyis las nag po mang zhing lci ba 'dug pas chos spyilo sar pos gzigs shig /ces zer to/ /yang rak+shi glang gi mgo can gyi srid pa las kyi me long de chos kyis rgyal po'i drung du 'phyar song bas/ chos kyi rgyal pos me long la gzigs nas 'di skad gsung gin 'dug /ngas las kyi me long la bltas pas//88

lha dang 'dre gnyis kyi gtam de yang phyed bden phyed mi bden par 'dug/dge ba byas sdig pa ma byas zer ba mi bden par 'dug /la/ra khyod kyis dgos med kyi bud med yang bsten/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs dkrugs/gnyen 'khor rnams kyis zhib par lab kyang ma nyan par sems dkrugs/lhag par khyod kyis bskang rgyun pa byas nas dam tshig ma bsrung / 'bag btsog mang du byas pas dko/na mchog thugs rje khrel nas 'dir yong ba'i rkyen ni des len pa yin no/ /khyod kyi bya ba ngan pa ni/ dben tshig la ma bltas par bka' rnams log par klog pas rdo rje ngamyal ba'i gnas su gtong dgos pa 'dug go /dkor sbyong ma byas shing dkor lan ma khyer ba'i rnam par smin pas/ yi dwags ngu 'bod kyis gnas su gtong dgos pa 'dug go /khyod rigs brgyud gu ru'i brgyud pa dang yin pa gcig /sems can 'chi nges shes pa'i srog bslus pa dang gnyis/ bya btang ri khrod kyi slom chen rnams la jag pa'i 'jigs pa yod sar skyabs dang skyel ma byas pa dang gsum/ de'i 'bras bus khyod dmyal ba nas zhag bdun las thar ba yod do/ /de nas yi dwags ngu 'bod kyi gnas su zhag gsum bsdad nas de'i rting du mi lus/ dbul po gcig thob pa 'dug go /ces gsungs song bas/mi de ni rang gi lag pa brang la rgyab cing 'di skad ces zer to//las 'phro can ma mi yul la byon na/ /spyir gyi mi rnams kun la 'phrin pa mdzod/ /sgos su man chad lung par 'di skad gsungs/ /sku gsung thugs 89

kyi dam tshig ma thub par/ /ngag dbang grags pa dmyal bar lus song gyis//gnyen tshan rnams kyis nga la soms mdzod la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gso ba'i phyir/ /gsung rab sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum bzhengs shig gyis/ /lha mgon mchod pa tshogs gtor snyan dar phul/ /bskang gsol bshags pa brgya rtsa gtong rogs gyis/ /gzhan yang nga yi rjes su 'gro nges kyi/ /dge ba gang sgrub zhes gsung rogs mdzod/ /ces zer nas/gzhin rje rnams kyis ske la thag pa btags nas khrid song ngo / /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang gshin rje rnams kyis bla ma'i cha lugs byas pa gcig khrid byung ste/ chos kyi rgyal pos sngar bzhin dri ba mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ mi de'i lus 'dar zhing mchi ma 'don pa dang / sngar byas kyi las rnams thams cad rang gi sems la sa ler dran/ chos ma byas pa'i 'gyod pa chen po skyes nas zhu ba 'di ltar 'bul gyin 'dug go /kye ma kyi hud chos kyi rgyal po lags/ /skye sa gtsang gi nyin ro zur khang nas/ /nga yi ming la phun tshogs zer ba yin/ /mi yul bsdad dus bya ba 'di ltar byas/ /zhes dang lung pa de'i gson chog dang gshin chog gtong mkhan gyi brgyud pa yin te/ pha yang snga mo nas grongs pas/ nang don gyi sgom khrid sogs chos kyi lag len ltar+ṣa blang long med pa'i ngang nas/ gson gshin gyi cho ga rnams 'jug dgoso pa byung / rjes su dbang lung sgom khrid rnams zhus nas/ rting ma'i don gcig sgrub rtsis yin rung long med pa'i ngang nas 90

'dir sleb byung bas 'gyod pa chen po yod/ 'gyod pa can/ nga la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol/ zhes zer zhing mchi ma mang du 'don gyi 'dug go /der g.yon phyogs na yod pa'i lha dkar po de bzhengs nas/ chos kyi rgyal po la phyag gsum btsal nas 'di skad ces zhus/ song / kye ma chos kyi tshu(5 po dgongs su gsol/ /mi 'di a rgyan gu rus byin brlabs pas//sgom sgrub byed long med kyang mtho ris thob/ /sems can sdug bsngal sel ba'i brgyud pa yin/ /kho rang dkar po dge ba'i phyogs la dad/ /nag po sdig pa'i phyogs la shin tu 'dzem/ /mtho kha mi 'grim ngan slong brtse bas bskyangs/ /ling pa'i lag nas ri dwags srog bslus byas/ /khyad par sdig spyod dpon gyi khrims sa ru/ /sleb pa'i mi gsum nor gyis bslus nas btang / /gzhan yang kha phan tshig phan la sogs pa/ /dge ba bsags pa'i rde'u 'di tsam yod/ /zer nas rde'u dkar po bre gang tsam cig spungs song / yang g.yas phyogs nas 'dre nag po kho langs nas/ 'di skad ces zer to/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du zhu rgyu yod/ /chos kyi rgyal po sku che yang / /kho yi sdig pa bkag mi tshugs/ /mi ngan phun tshogs zer ba 'di//brgyud pa bzang la re gtad nas/ /sems kyi ngo bo ma rtogs par/ /yon bdag rnams la dbang bskur te/ /la na zas thal ba ma 'gams sam//tshe 'das bar dor 'khyam du bcug /khyod kyi tshig gam blo la bzung //dkor gyi nor zas snying la bcug /yon bdag rnams kyi rna ba ru/ /rol mo 91

sgra ldir bcol ldi ra byas/ /rang gi zas nor thob pa dang / /tshe 'das mkha' spyod gnas su song / /dge bskor gtong dgos med do zer//gzhan gyi dge ba'i kha bkag byas/ /tshe 'das ngan song gnas la bskyur//rang gi dge sdig mi shes par/ /gzhan gyi chos la tha snyad btags/ /tshul /khrims sdom pa mi bsrung bar/ /ser mo'i gzugs kyis mi mgo bskor//gzhan yang nor zas blangs pa sogs/ /rde'u nag po 'di tsam yod/ /zhes zer nas rde'u nag po bre do tsam zhig spungs song / de nas spre 'u'i mgo can gyis rde'u dkar nag srang la bteg song / /spre'u mgo can na re/ n+de'u dkar nag gnyis las nas/ po mang zhing lci bar 'dug /dkar po nyung zhing yang bar 'dug pas chos kyi rgyal pos mkhyen no/ /zhes zer bas/yang rakra glang mgo can gyis srid pa las kyi me long de chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun du 'phyar song bas/ chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ nga yis srid pa las kyi me long las bltas pas/ rgyu 'bras bag phye bas kyang zhib/khyod rnying ma'i lugs kyi bla ma'i brgyud pa ru 'dug cing / brgyud pa'i sa rgyab sa dang rdo rgyab rdo yin rung / thabs shes ya ma 'bral ba cig dgos/lar khyod lung pa de'i bla ma dpon du byas nas dad zas kyi thal ba sa'i rdul las mang ba yang 'gams 'dug /mi rnams 'thab pa'i bar gcod pa'i skabs su / /bden pa med pa'i lag nas lkog brngan blangs te/ bden pa yod pa'i mi rnams rgyab tu bskyur nas mi'i snying la lcags bcug pa'i las kyi 92

rnam par smin par yang 'khur dgos 'dug /rang gi lto skal khur nas g.yog byed cing rang la blo gtad pa'i mi rnams shi ba'i skabs su dge ba gzhan du ma btang bar/ khyod rang gis rnga sgra ldir dang bcom ldir byed cing cho ga yan lag ma tshang ba re btang bas/ tshe 'das ngan song du lhung ba'i sdig pa yang mang po yod do/ /gzhan yang lus ngag gi sgo na/sa sdig pa mang po bsags 'dug pas/ dmyal ba mang du myong dgos pa 'dug ste/ da khyod kyi brgyud pa yangs pa dang gcig /sems can 'chi nges shes pa'i srog bslus pa dang gnyis/ mi nag can khrims sa ru bcug pa nor gyis bslus pa gsum po des/ dmyal ba gzhan rnams kyi sdug bsngal las thar ro rang sems nyid kyi don ma rtogs par dad zas gshin zas kyi thal ba 'gams 'dug pa de'i rnam par smin pa la/ 'di nas byang gi phyogs na ri nag po gnam du mchongs pa 'dra ba'i 'gram na khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba yod/ de'i nang du sems can chung chung gis chen po za ba'i sdug bsngal yod pa de ru zhag po bcu gsum sdod dgos pa yod do/ /sems can chung chung gis chen po za ba'i rkyen ni/ tshe 'das rnams ma drongs par zas nor mang po zos pa'i rnam smin yin no/ /khyod tshe tshad ma rdzogs par 'dir yong dgos pa'i rkyen ni/khyod rang gi lha mo'i mchod pa chag cing 'bag btsog byung ba'i nyes pas/khyod rang gi 'og rtas mthe bong la so btab/ de las gnyan shor nas snying nad bzung ste 'dir sleb pa yin/ da rung dkor len ma 'gror ba'i rnam smin la/ 'di nas shar lho'i phyogs na yi dwags ngu 'bod kyi gnas zhes bya ba 93

rang la za rgyu dang dbang rgyu med pa'i khur chen po ri rab tsam 'khur dgos pa kha la me 'bar ba'i sdug bsngal yod/ der zhag gsum sdod cig /zhag gsum las sdod mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ khyod rang gi pha ras dkar po dong 'dre+os pa'i a khu rdo rje grags pa zer bo des/ mi rnams bosagaso nas stan ma ma btang yang / bsam pa bzang pas gtar ma dang dkan mchag la mchod pa ma chag par phul/ yid ting nge 'dzin dang ma 'bral ba'i ngang nas sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgoms pa'i phan yon gyis zhag gsum nas yi dwags ngu 'bod kyi sdug bsngal las thar ro/ /de nas sngon gyi las 'phro yod pas/ dbus kyi gzhung gi phyogs su nang pa brgyud dang longs spyod cher med pa chos la dkar ba dang dad pa che ba/ ming la bstan 'dzin don grub ces bya ba dang / me tog gos dkar zhes bya ba yod/ de gnyis kyi bu ru skyes/ ming la bsod nams tshe dbang bya bar yong ba 'dug /rnying ma'i brgyud 'dzin gcig dang mjal nas lung dang man ngag thams cad zhus la sngar las lhag pa'i 'gro don gyis shig /ces gsungs song bas/bla ma de gzhin rje gcig gis thag pa btags nas khrid 'gro 3nga bla ma de'i kha nas 'di skad zer zhing 'dug go /kye ma kyi hud 'di 'dra a tsa ma//dran pa sgang la 'gro ba'i mi yod na/ /spyir gyi 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams dang / /khyad par dbus gtsang phyogs su 'phrin pa mdzod/ /yang sgos nying ro khang chung zur khang du/ /'phrin pa 'di ltar bskur byung gsung rogs 94

mdzod/ /nga yi dad zas gzhin zas bzas pa yi/ /rnam smin khur po mang po 'khur dgos 'dug /rang gi sems nyid ngo bo ma rtogs par/ /gzhan gyi yar 'dren lam sna ma byed gyis/ /nga la de nas dge ba btang ba rnams//gzhan ma rnams kyis khyer nas ma byung ngo / /dad zas ga'an zas dge ba ma lags pa'i/ /rang nor dbang yod spyod la sbyin pa thongs/ /nga yis yar 'dren byas pa'i tshe 'das rnams/ /yi ger bkod la nor zas rnams dang bcas/ /bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pa'i zhabs drung du/ /bsngo ba smon lam rgyas 'debs zhus rogs mdzod/ /de bzhin bla ma gang nas su byon la/ /bsngo rten ma ṇi'i zong bskur phul gsungs dang / /nga yi don du gnyer dang nye 'khor gyis/ /rten gsum rnams la phyag dang bskor ba mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya cher rol pa dang / /gser las grub pa'i mchod rten bzhengs mdzod cig /gzhan yang yar mchod mar sbyin dge ba'i las/ /tshogs dang gtor ma bskang bshags ci 'grub mdzod/ /de ltar byas na khrag gi rgyatsho mtsho las/ /thar ba 'dug go zer ba'i 'phrin mdzod cig /ces zer zhing byang gi phyogs su khrid song ngo /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang bla ma sku sha dkar po la snga long gi sked rags bcings pa/ zhal ras sngo hrom me ba yosnad pa zhig /badz+ra gu ru'i sgra di ri ri byas nas/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs su byon byung bas/g.yas g.yon gyi gshin rje rgyob sod kyi sgra sgrog pa rnams re zhig sim mer 95

song / de nas/ chos kyi rgyal pos mi de la sngar bzhin 'dri ba mdzad song bas/mi des/ 'di skad zhu bin 'dug go /chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du zhu ba la/ /sa phyogs ya 'brog sbang gi yul/ gling nas/ /rigs brgyud ma nyams a rgyan brgyud pa 'dzin/ /nga yi ming la mdo sngags bstan 'dzin zer/ /gu ru'i bka' bzhin dam chos nyams su blangs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam/ tshig ma nyams bsrungs/ /'gro ba sems can sdug bsngal sel ba dang / /'brel ba thogs tshad 'dren du yong ba yin/ /zhes zer bas/ chos kyi rgyal pos/'o na las kyi me long de 'phyar dang gsungs/ der rak+shi glang mgo can gyis srid pa las kyi me long de chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun du 'phyar song ba/ chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod a rgyan gyi brgyud 'dzin pa gter du sbas pa 'don nus pa gcig yin 'dug pas/ lha dang 'dre gnyis kyi n+de'u dkar nag bsher mi dgos pa 'dug go /khyod kyis sdo/ ru la gsol ba btab pa dang smon lam mang du btab pa des/ da rung khyod rang gi 'gro dun mi yul ya 'brog sgang du yod pa 'dug /ma gi darmyu/la khams bco brgyad nas/ khyod rang la zas 'brel dang chos 'brel yod pa'i mi rnams yar drongs la/ lho brag gi lung par mi lus len nga/ra song zhig /ces gsungs so/ /de ma thag rol mo'i sgra dang 'od chen po byung ste/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro mang po bsu/ bar bslebs byung / /bla ma des/ lcags ri kha nas 'di skad gsung gin 'dug /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang shed na//9phu

dmyal ba tsha grang thig nag sdud 'joms dang / /yang sos la sogs sdug bsngal myong mkhan rnams/ /dge ba'i bsam pa yod tshad yar shog dang //rnam smin las dang sdug bsngal myong ba'i mi/ /nga la zas 'brel chos 'brel thogs tshad rnams/ /nga ni mdo sngags bstan 'dzin zhes bya yin/ /nga la 'brel ba thogs tshad yar shag dang / /ces gsungs song bas/ de ma thag tu dmyal khams bco brgyad kyi nang nas/ skye dman mgo la lhub dkyus dkris pa mang po dang / mi gzhon pa rbad mgo can la sogs pa pho mo ma nga po nga'i bla ma'i gsung byung zer zhing khong gi rjes la yar langs song /lcags ri chen po de'i phyi na a ne 'gram pa la sme ba yod pa gcig gi lus la lcags gzer stong btab/ lce ag ma'i 'og nas 'then te thong gshol me 'bar bas me+od kyin 'dug /der gshin rje rnams na re/ /khyod la sgom pa'i nyams dang rtogs pa 'char rgyu yod na 'char ran/ yi dam gyi lha yod na'ang 'grub ran/ skra bcad ming spos kyi bla ma yod na'ang sgom ran 'dug go /lar skra bcad ming spos kyi bla rma rgyab tu bskyur nas 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pas bsam blo re thongs dang / bla ma 'di lta bu'i chos sgor zhugs nas/ dad pa ma byas kyang / da lta bla ma'i na bza' la bzung nas yong ste zer yang / mo rang bla ma la dad pa log pa'i gnong bis/ mgo btegs pa tsam/ yang mi 'dug /der bla ma byon nas/ bu khrid lha mo/ zer ba khyod/ ngas skra bcad ming spos/ dbang bskur chos bshad pa rnams 97

ma dran nam/ khyod kyi bla ma nga yin mod yar shog gsungs shing / mo'i dpung pa nas bzung ste yar bslangs song bas/ bla ma'i zhal ras la yud tsam zhig bltas nas slar yang kha sbub tu 'gyel song /der ngas gshin rje rnams la bla ma 'di lta bus dpung pa nas bzung ste yar drangs kyang mi 'drongs pa ci yin byas pas/ gshin rje de na re/bud med 'di mi yul dran pa sgang la yod pa'i dus su/ dkor sbyong kha 'don skyabs 'gro sogs gang yang mi byed par/ sgom pa'i gral byas nas dgon pa'i dkor bzas/ yul mi rnams kyi sde byas nas grong pa'i skyid sdug gi dkor zas rnams kyang bzas/ rang skra bcad ming spos kyi bla ma la dad pa dang mos gus mi byed pa'i khar/ mi rnams kyi mdun du bla ma'i mtshang sna dgu nas brjod de bskur pa mang du btab/ bla ma'i gzungs ma byas nas byin rlabs su mi shes par/ mig ser dang nga rgyal byas pas nyes pas yar mi 'drongs pa yin no zer/ yang bla ma de'i zhal nas/ nga'i bka' dang dam las 'gal zhing /gdams ngag khyad du bsad nas rjes med du btang song / 'on kyang las kyi 'brel pa yod pas yar shog dang / gsungs nas khrid song / dpag tshad cig tsam phyin pa'i sa na/ rlung dmar chen po gcig gis khyer song / yang ngas bla ma de lta bu yis dpung pa nas bzung ste yar 'then kyang mi thub par 98

rlung dmar gyis khyer 'gro ba de ci yin byas pas/ gzhin rje de'i zhal nas/thabs dang shes rab ya ma 'bral ba thugs rje dang mos gus 'bral med du dgos pa la/ bla ma'i thugs rje ma gtogs mo rang gi mos gus dang dam tshig skad cig tsam yang mi 'dug pas/ yar mi 'drongs pa de yin/ 'on kyang bla ma'i thugs rjes dmyal ba las thar te byol song gi gnas su skye ba 'dug go zhes zer/ bla ma de ni dad can gyi mi mang po khrid nas lam ser skya de la bzhugs te byon song ngo/ /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du/ bud me da ser mo gser skong btsugs pa/ gser gyi a long dang sbrags pa gcig khrid byung / der chos kyi rgyal pos bud med de la sngar bzhin 'dri ba mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ bud med de ni mchi ma 'don zhing zhu ba 'di ltar 'bul gyi 'dug go /chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ nga ni spyir na dbus kyi phyogs nas yin/ /yang sgos chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa nas//nga yi ming la a ma lha lha zer/ /tshe stod tshong dpon gcig gi chung ma byas//nga la nor dang longs spyod che bar yod/ /las kyi sdig sgrib dag kyang che bar bsags/ /de nas rang gi grogs dang shi 'bral byung / /da rung grogs kyi gdung sems ma chod pas/ /rang las na so gzhon pa'i grogs gcig btsal/ /khyim mtshes grong pa'i phyogs 'dzin la bltas nas/ /zhe sdang dbang gis 'chi ba dran ma tshugs/ /nam zhig dpal gyi bsam yas bskor 99

phyin pas/ /bla ma ma ṇi pa yang phebs nas byung / /de yis rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / /gling sa chos skyid rnam thar la sogs pa'i//bar do'i snang tshul mang po gsungs byung bas/ /de nas tshun la bya ba 'di ltar byas/ zhes/ dang / der nga'i snying la mda' phog pa lta bu byung ste 'chi ba snying nas/ dran/ sngar bsags pa'i nor dge bar ma btang ba dang / zhe sdang dang phrag dog byas pa rnams la 'gyod pa drag po skyes nas/ nor yod pa thams cad dkon mchog la zhabs tog dang / ngan slong la sbyin pa btang /khyad par tshad ldan gyi jo bo rin po che la gser chab sbran/ nga rang gi kha phor bsres pa'i grogs 'di bstun par byung na sngar bzhin grogs lugs byed/ma mthun kyang de la chags zhen med bsam pa byas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bya ba'i phyir du/ bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas la sogs pa mang du bsrungs/ phyag dang bskor ba byas/ yi ge drug pa 'bungs nas bgrangs/dbang khrid chos gsum gnang ba'i bla ma rnams sa phyogs gang nas phebs byung yang / zhabs tog dang bkur sti gang 'byor phul nas/ dbang khrid gdams ngag mang du zhus/ phra dog dang g.yo sgyu nga rgyal rnams spangs te/bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas/ ma gi'i tsir tsir 'ur 'ur zer ba de la mi gtong rogs mdzod cig zer bas/ de nas g.yon phyogs na lha dkar po des bzhengs nas 'di skad du/ chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /nga yi bud med lha lha zer ba 'di/ /sdig la 'dzem zhing chos la dkar ba yin/ /dge ba bsags pa'i rde'u 'di tsam yod/ /ces zer zhing /100

n+de'u dkar po bre do tsam gcig spungs song / yang g.yas phyogs na 'dre nag po kho langs nas 'di skad zer to/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du zhu rgyu yod//mo ngan lha lha zer ba khyod/ /bsam ngan rang 'dod khong du bcug /lha la gsol mchod byed pa yang / /rang 'dod ma grub dogs nas byas/ /mi mgo bskor bas smon lam btab/ /ma ṇi bgrang zer 'chal gtam byed//bsnyen gnas smyung gnas bsrungs pa rnams/ /snyan grags 'dod phyir ma lags pa/ /'chi ba bsam nas bsrungs pa med/ /khyod kyis bya ba thams cad ni/ sdig pa'i las su byas pa mang / /mi nor bzas pa'i nyes pa sogs/ /nag po bsags pa 'di tsam yod/ /ces zer nas rde'u nag po bre phyed tsam zhig spungs song /yang spre 'u'i ma/go can na re/ rde'u dkar nag gi ljid ngas rgya ma la bteg pa chog zer zhing rgya ma la btegs song ste/ spre'u mgo can na re/rde'u dkar nag gnyis las nag po nyung zhing yang la/ dkar po mang zhing lci bar 'dug pas/ 'di ni mtho ris kyi gnas su gtong bar mdzod cig/ces zer bas/ yang rak+shi glang mgo can gyis srid pa las kyi me long de chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun du 'phyar sang bas/ chos kyi rgyal pos me long la gzigs nas zhal 'dzum pa gcig mdzad nas 'di skad gsung gin 'dug/sdig pa byed mkhan mang ste bshags pa byed nga/'i mi re nyung / mi lus thob ste sdig pa byas pa la 'gyod sems byed mkhan khyod las mi 'dug /mi la la 101

gzhon pa'i dus su chos byas kyang sting ma sdig pa'i las kyi rnam smin khur dgos pa 'ba' zhig yong dgos 'dug /ngas las kyis me long la bltas pas/ khyod kyis bya ba byas 'dug /yar mchod mar sbyin gyi dge ba yang btang 'dug /khyod rang gi gtsug g.yu la btags pa'i gser gyi a long de yang jo bo rin po che la gser chab tu sbran 'dug /las rgyu 'bras kyi chos rnams thos pa tsam gyis nges shes skyes nas/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag pos bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas kyang mang du bsrungs/ phyag dang bskor ba yang mang du byas 'dug /khyod tshe stod la sdig pa mang po byas 'dug ste/ de las 'gyod sems skyes nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bshags pa byas pa des skad cig dran rdzogs kyi chos yin pas/ khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag 'dug /lar sdig sbyong dang bshags pa byas rting / sems la brtan pa thob pa'i sgom zhig byas na rig 'odzin gyi sa thob pa 'dug ste/ de ma byas pas da lan mi lus len par song zhig /khyod 'jig rten khyim pa yin yang / bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas bsrungs dus sdom pa gtsang mar bsrungs pa'i phan yon gyis/ phan yul glang thang zhes bya ba'i yul du skye ba pho lus blangs te/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig dang mjal nas/ dge slong dgra bcom pa gcig yong ba yod do/ /ces gsungs so/nga bas/ bud med de dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong mi dgos par mthe bong gnam la ker nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /las 'phro can ma mi yul byon zer na/ /spyir gyi 'dzam bu gling la 'phrin pa mdzod/ /sgos su 132

chos 'khor lha sar 'di skad gsungs/ /ma cig a ma lha lha zer ba nga //tshe stod tshong sogs 'jig rten bya ba byas/ /tshe smad 'chi khar phan pa'i chos shig byas/ /chos las byas pa'i phan yon cher 'dug pas/ /dam pa'i lha chos gang nus mdzod cig gyis/ /bsags pa'i nor rdzas sbyin pa thongs shig gyis/ /dad gus mos pas phyag dang bskor ba gyis/ /mtshan ldan jo bor mos gus bskyed cig gyis/ thugs rje'i lam sna 'dren bgyis 'dug go gyis/ /khyim pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i phan yon gyis/ da ni phan yul glang thang zhes bya ru/ /mi lus gtsang mar len par song ngo gyis/ /dge slog dgra bcom thob pa 'dug go gyis/ /zhes zer nas/ lam ser skya de la zhugs na mi lus len par song ngo /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang chos kyi rgyal lo drung du/ bud med dar rgan song ba lag dung kha chag pa/ mu tig gi thod gyon pa gcig khrid byung / der chos kyi rgyal pos sngar bzhin 'dri ba zhib par mdzad song bas/bud med des chos kyi rgya la po la zhu ba 'di ltar phul grin 'dug go /kye ma kyi hud chos kyi rgyal po lags/ /las ngan tshogs ma bsags pa'i sdig can ma/ /nga yi yul phyogs gtsang rong gnyis kyi mtshams/ /yang sgos rin spungs byams chen phyogs nas yin/ /skyes pa'i yul ni mkhar cig lung ring zer/ /chos byas dge ba 'di btang zhu rgyu med/ /las ngan sdig pa bsags pa'i nyes dmigs yod/ /nga yi skyid sdug chos kyi rgyal pos 103

mkhyen/ /zhes zer zhing lag pa g.yas g.yon re mos byas nas brdung gin 'dug /g.yon phyogs na lha dkar po des bzhengs nas 'di skad zhus song /chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du zhu ba la/ /nga yi bud med bsam gto zer ba 'di//yar mchod mar sbyin dge ba ma btang yang / /khram dang g.yo sgyus gzhan nor blangs pa med/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad pa med/ /bla ma gong ma'i thugs kyang dkrugs pa med/ yes bzhin sdig dang sgrib pa ga la yod/ /mi la brnab sems gnod sems byas pa med/ /rgyun/ du sgrol ma nyid la gsol ba btab/ /bsam pa bzang po byas pa'i rde'u 'di yin//zhes zer zhing rde'u dkar po bre gang tsam gcig spungs song /yang g.yas phyogs nas 'dre nag po kho langs nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /chos kyi rgyal po gsan mdzod cig /mo ngan bsam gtan zer ba 'dis/ dge dang sdig pa mi shes zer/ /sgo phye tsam yang ma btang ngo //nag po sdig pa zhor la bsags/ /dngos sdig rang gi sems can bsad//bsam pa ngan pas chas rnams sbas/ /'dod pas bre log srang lag btsugs/ /nag po sdig pa bsags pa yi/ /rde'u nag po 'di tsam yod//ces zer zhing n+de'u nag po bre gang tsam zhig spungs song / rde'u dkar nag gnyis spre'u'i mgo can gyis rgya ma la btegs nas/ spre'u'i mgo can na re/rde'u dkar nag gnyis la yang ljid mi 'dug pas/ chos kyi rgyal pos gzigs shig zer/ der chos kyi rgyal pos srid pa las kyi me long la 104

gzigs nas 'di skad gsung gin 'dug /dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/dbang po tshang bar skyes kyang tha mal du lus pa 'ga' zhig yong gin 'dug/nyes ltu nga dri ma'i tshogs rnams bdag gis byang zhing / bza' btung sdig sgrib dang ma 'dres mi srid pas/ khyod la yang dngos sdig dum pa gcig 'dug ste/ khyod kyis sgrol ma la gsol ba btab 'dug pas sgrib pa phal cher dag 'dug /rde'u mang nyung yang ljid med pa yang de yin/ da rung sdig pa gzhan ma bsags pa'i rnam smin la zhag gsum dmyal ba myong dgos pa 'dug /de las thar nas ri mtho sa gtsang ma'i gnas gcig tu 'dab chags bya'i skye ba len pa 'dug go/ ces gsungs song bas/gzhin rje rnams kyis bud med de thag pas btags nas khrid 'gro zhing 'dug pas/ bud med des 'di skad ces zer to/ /dran pa sgang la theg mkhan yod zer na/ /spyir gyi dbus gtsang phyogs kyi mi rnams dang //khyad par rin spungs byams chen lung ring la// nga yi 'phrin pa 'di ltar gsungs rogs mdzod/ /a/ pa sa/ skyong 'brug rgyas sngon la lanyegs/ /nga yi sha nas mched pa'i ming sring tsho/ /a ma sdug dus bu yis ma bas/ma na//'di na gzhan la re sa mi 'dug go /a/ ma dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung 'dug pas/ /yar mchod mar sbyin yig drug mang du sgrongs/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me spor/ /mtho ris bgrod rnga/'i skas kha tshugs gsungs dang / /zhes zer nas mar la khrid song ngo //105

i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs nas skad kyi nga ro drag po gcig gis tshe las 'das pa gcig /yong gi 'dug pas da lta nyid du khrid shog zer bas/ /gshin rje'i las mkhan mang po thon song /zam pa ring po ya gi sna nas mar la/ ma ṇi pa dbu la dom ra sgor mo gsol zhing ma ṇi'i 'khor lo bsnams pa gcig /e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ zhes pa'i sgra dbyangs di ri ri byas nas chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du phebs byung bas/chos kyi rgyal po yang khri'i steng nas bzhengs te/ zhal 'dzum gcig mdzad nas khyod 'dir byon pa yang ngo mtshar che/ 'jig rten gyi khams su 'gro ba sems can gyi don ji lta bu mdzad/ ces gsung gin 'dug pas/bla ma ma ṇi pa des chos kyi rgyal po la phyag btsal nas 'di skad ces zhus song / kye ma / chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol//bsod nams bsags pas dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /smon lam 'brel bas dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ /bsam blo btang bas 'chi ba mi rtag dran/ /nga rang gcig po thar ba ma lags te/ /sems can thams cad drongs par byas bsam ste/ /lus kyi sgo nas sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrungs/ /ngag gi sgo nas rgyal khams thams cad la/ /yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor//rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mang du bshad/ /bdag gi gre ba bde ba ma lags te/ /sems bskyed bzang pos bya ba 'di ltar byas/ zhes dang /der ngas mi rnams la/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar 10dze

pa'i phan yon rnams bshad pas/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po skyes nas phyin chad mi bgyid par dag pa la bkod nas blo chos su 'gyur ba yang byas/ yon bdag rnams kyi lag nas 'phral gyi bza' btung phran bu ni zas/ gzhan 'bul ba byung ba rnams ni dge ba'i phyogs su btang ba ma gtogs/ rang gi lto gos kyi dbang dang / chud zos su 'gro ba ma byas/ngas yi ge drug pa 'di mkha' mnyam kyi sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs nas/ ri mthon po'i rtse nas skad kyi nga ro chen pos ma ṇi pad dbyangs 'then no/ /de bzhin du chu chen po'i 'gram du yang bskul lo//rlung chen po'i dus su yang bskul lo/ /de ltar sems bskyed bzang po'i sgo nas ma ṇi'i pad dbyangs 'then pa yin no/ /chos kyi rgyal po yang las dge sdig gi brtsi grangs dang / rgyu 'bras bag phye bas zhib pa 'dug zer ba thos pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas nyes byas 'dug na bdag rang gi steng du thongs shig /gzhan sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ bdag gi smon 'a༈ma thams cad 'grub par nus na/ drin che ba'i pha mas thog drangs zas 'brel dang chos 'brel thogs pa'i sems can thams cad mtho ris kyi lam la 'dren nus par 'gyur cig /ces zhus song / chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ las kyi me long la blta mi dgos pa zhig yin 'dug ste/ gzhan rnams yid ches pa'i phyir ltos shig gsungs/ der rak+shi glang mgo can gyis 107

srid pa las kyi me long de chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mdun du 'phyar song bas/chos kyi rgyal pos me long la legs par gzigs nas zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas 'di skad gsung gin 'dug /lar bla ma ma ṇi pa rnams la'ang yar bshad kyi dge sdig gnyis su yod kyin 'dug ste/ khyed la lus kyi sgo nas sdig pa dang bskor ma khris/ ngag gi sgo nas rdzun dang tshig lcub ma byas/yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems dang gnod sems ma byas pa 'dug /lar mi 'dun pa can bdun la ma ṇi bskul nus pa de thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa yin te/de rnams kyang chos gzab sar bdud gzab zer ba bzhin/ nor la 'dod pa skyes nas ma ṇi lto gos kyi don du bskul ba 'ba' zhig yod/ de rnams ni thugs rje chen po'i bka' dang 'gal ba yin/ da khyod rang gi ming la 'phrin las 'brug rgyas zer ba yang 'dug /bsod nams rin chen zer ba'ang yin par 'dug /lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas dge rtsa sgrub cing sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni thugs rje chen po'i thugs sras yin no/ /de nas khyod 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa yin pas/ ma gi'i dmyal khams bco brgyad nang yod pa'i rang rang gi las kyi rnam par smin pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba rnams/ khyod kyis yar drongs la mtho ris gnas su byon cig /gzhan yang tshogs ma bsags/ las 'brel dang chos 'brel gang yang med pa rnams la khyod kyis smon lam rgya chen po 'debs pa dang / ya gi pho brang gi rtse la gzigs mo mdzad par 'byon cig /ces gsungs song /108

der gshin rje dom gyi mgo can gcig gis sna khrid nas pho brang gi rtse mor byon song / de'i dus/ rol mo sgra dang 'od chen po gcig byung /nga'i bsam pa la ci yin nam snyam bltas pas/ bar snang thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang ba'i khrod nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos dar lam 'dren te/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs su bslebs byung / de'i nang nas khro bo'i cha lugs can rnams kyi gar stabs dang bcas pa'i glu dbyangs 'di ltar 'bul grin 'dug go /'das dang ma 'das gnyis kyi mtshams shig nas/ /blo yi ma rig gti mug kun sel te/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar nag las kyi dge sdig shan 'byed nas/ /sdig pa can rnams dmyal bar tshar gcod cing / /las can mtho ris gnas su skyel mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzam gling mi yi skyid sdug sngon las yin/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /legs dang nyes kyi dbye ba 'byed mdzad pa'i/ /byams mgon thugs rje chen po bdag la dgongs/ /sangs rgyas ye nas mi yul 'gro ba 'dren/ /thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal/ /bla ma bsod nams rin chen ga na bzhugs//mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su gshegs pa 'tshal/ /zhes zer zhing gar stabs dang sbrags nas byas song / chos kyi rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsung gi 'dug /'phags pa'i thugs sras bsod nams rin chen de/ /skal ldan las can rnams kyis zhabs nas btegs/ /'dzam bu'i gling du sems 109

can 'gro don byas/ /bzang ngan mi 'byed thams cad lam sna 'dren/ /skal med log lta can rnams dmyal bar ltung / /nga yi thugs sras bsod nams rin chen gyis/ /'gro ba sems can kun gyi lam sna drongs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis mtha' nas brten/ /las ngan gdug rtswab rlung gis mi bskyod par//'khor bcas sangs rgyas yul du gshegs gyur cig /ces gsungs shing dgongs pa la bzhugs song ngo / /ma ṇi pa de ni pho brang gyi rtse nas ma ṇi'i 'khor lo bskor zhing 'di skad gsung gi 'dug /ma gi dpyal khams bco brgyad nang dag gi /mi rnams kun gyis nga ngo ma shes na/ /nga ma ṇi pa 'phrin las 'brug rgyas yin/ /nga la 'brel pa yod tshad yar shag cig/las ngan mi dge bcu po rgyab tu bskyur/ /spyi bor bla ma thugs rje chen po sgoms/ /rgyun du yi ge drug pa ma yengs sgrongs/ /nga la zas 'brel thogs tshad yar shag cig /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /rgyu 'bras las kyi chos rnams ma go bar/ /zhe sdang nga rgyal dbang du song ba rnams/ /ngan sems phrag dog spongs la yar shog cig /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /rang gzung 'dzin gyi lta ba ma phyogs pa'i/ /blo ton mongs kyi dbang du song ba rnams/ /nga la chos 'brel thogs tshad yar shog dang / /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /rang rang las kyi rnam smin 'khur ba rnams/ /'phral ltar snang gi re dogs ma byed par/ /sems 'khri ba chod la yar shog cig /'phrin las 'brug rgyas zer ba'i ma ṇi pa//110

nga ni mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'gro/ /nga yi skad la nyon la yar shog cig/blo zhen chags spongs la yar shag cig /ces gsungs na/sa/ /lam dkar la 'tsher ba de las byon song bas/ ma rgi lcags ri khor yug gi nang nas/ khong la zas 'brel dang chos 'brel thogs pa'i mi rnams ni/ khong gi gsung byung zer zhing thams cad khong gi rjes la yar langs song / khong la 'brel pa ma thogs pa rnams ni/ dmyal ba'i gnas su sdug bsngal myong zhing 'gyod pa ltas mi bzod pa 'dug go /yang ma ṇi pa des ya gi 'ja' dang 'od kyi khrod nas 'di ltar gsungs ni 'dug /e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ bar mi yul la byon pa'i mi yod na//'dzam bu gling gi mi la 'phrin pa mdzod/ /khyad par gtsang gi mgon ngo/ jo mtsho ru/ /nga yi sring mo dkar gsal la 'di skad gsungs/ /a jo thar pa'i lam la song ngo gyis/ /rang gi drin can pha mas thogs drangs pa'i//kha lag zas kyi 'brel pa thogs tshad rnams/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam la drangs song gyis/ /yi dam 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la/ /rang sgis gsol ba snying nas 'debs nus na/ /thugs rje'i nus mthu bsam/ gyis/ mi khyab pas/ /ngan song gsum gyi sgo mo bgegs kyi gyis/ /rgyal khams 'grim pa'i bla ma ma ṇi pa/ /gzhan ma rnams kyang nga bzhin mdzod cig gyis//zhe sdang nga rgyal phra doge rnams spongs la/ /sem/sa can kun la ci phan mdzod cig gyis/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can tham/sa cad kyi/ /sdig sgri/ba 111

byang zhing sdug bsngal sel bsam pas/ /thugs rje chen po yang snying yig drug 'di// sems can rnams kyi don du bskul cig gyis/ /rang gi nor 'dod dbang du ma gtong bar/ /thams cad thar pa'i lam la drongs shig gyis/ /sprang po 'phrin las 'brug rgyas zer ba nga / /lus skyes 'bras dang sgo lo mi legs shing / /ngag gre 'gyur ba bde ba med lags kyang / /rgyal khams kun la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /sems can mang po thar pa'i lam la bkod// thams cad nga bzhin gyis la shag gsungs shig /ces gsungs shing da lan bskor cig bde ba can du 'gro/ slar yang mi lus blangs te 'gro ba'i don byed do zer nas byon song ngo / /e ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ yang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs su/ mi skya min ser min la skra phying pa log ge ba yod pa/ ske la rakra'i phreng ba bcug pa/ lag tu spa 'khar dang rgyab tu zhal thang khur ba zhig khrid byung /de la chos kyi rgyal pos sngar bzhin 'dri ba mdzad song bas/ mi des chos kyi rgyal po la phyag btsal nas 'di skad zhu gin 'dug /kye ma kyi hud chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs/ /nga yi skye sa gtsang gi phyogs nas yin/ /nga yi ming la gu ru tshe ring zer/ /mi yul sdod dus bya ba 'di lta ra byas//zhes dang / nga yi pha'i ming la hūṃ nag me 'bar zer te/ mi thams cad nga'i pha'i gdong la bltas na lus rtse gum me ba byed pa'i mthu dang nus pa yod kyang /nga rang gi bsam pa la tshe 'di 'jig rten gyi bya ba mkhas kyang snying po mi 'dug 113

bsam nas/ rang gi nang nor ca rnying gis thogs drangs pa'i nor 'od can rnams las gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi sku 'dra bzhengs/ nga rang gi skye dman de rgyan cha mang zhing / kha la shin tu nyan pa gcig yod pas/ nged rang gnyis gros mthun par/ bsags pa'i nor dang lus kyi rgyan gos gang la yang snying po mi 'dug /rang nying/ 'chi ba'i skabs su thams cad bcam gyis bzhag nas 'gro dgos par 'dug pas dge ba re byed par drag zer zhing / nor dang lus kyi rgyan cha rnams btsongs nas yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes ba cu dang / rten de rnams la mchod pa phul/ der rnying ma'i bla ma gcig gdan drangs nas bkra shis rab gnas mdzad/ nga rang gis badz+ra gu ru'i lung zhus/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa ma chag par byed pa'i dam bca' phul/ rgyun du gu ru nyid la gsol ba btab/ lto gos gtam gsum gang byung gis chog pa byas pas/ rang gi gnyen tshan dang grong pa khyim tshang rnams kyi kha nas / pha bzang de lta bu la bu rkang 'dren mi khyu nas bud pa/ 'jig rten pa'i lugs kyang med/ chos pa yin zer na chos pa'i lugs kyang med pa 'di 'dra yong ba ang byer zhing thams cad kyis kha ngan lab pa gcig byung / yin na'ang nga 'chi ba la 'jigs nas sdig pa'i las la 'dzem/ yar dkon mchogo la mchod pa dang /mar ngan slong la sbyin pa btang nas/ gang yod dge ba'i phyogs la 'bungs yod pas ma gi tsir tsir 'ur 'ur zer ba de la mi gtong rogs mdzod cig/ces zer bas/113

yang lha dkar po des bzhengs nas 'di skad ces zhus so/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du zhu ba la/ /nga yi sngags pa gu ru tshe ring 'dis//dkar po dge ba'i las ni mang du bsags/ /nag po sdig pa'i las rnams rgyab tu bskyur/ /lto gos gtam gsum kun las gyong khur nas/ /mi gral bud kyang 'gyod pa med par byas/ /ser snas bsags pa'i nor zas thams cad ni/ /rgyu na du gu ru nyid kyi mchod par phul/ /lus kyi r+sho nas phyag dang mchod pa byas/ //ngag gis badz+ra gu ru ma yengs bgrangs/ /gu ru nyid kyang ma yengs 'bral med rgyun du bsgoms/ /de yi 'bras bu'i rde'u 'di tsam yin/ /zhes zer zhing n+de'u dkar po phung so chen po zhig spungs song /g.yas phyogs na/sa 'dre nag po des langs nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /mi ngan gu ru tshe ring zer ba 'dis/ /ngan sngags mthu yis bskor ni mang du bzas/ /dge ba byas pa til 'bru tsam yang med/ /sdig pa bsags pa'i rde'u 'di tsam yod/ /ces zer zhing rde'u nag po thor tsam gcig las 'don rgyu mi 'dug /der chos/ kyi rgyal pos me long la gzigs te 'dzum pa gcig mdzad nas 'di skad gsung gi 'dug /mi yul dran pa sgang nas tshogs bsags pa re re bzhin 'dug /nga yis srid pa las kyi me long la bltas pas/ dge ba'i phyogs su khyod rang gis zer ba ltar bden pa 'dug go /rde'u nag po 110mo

dum tsam 'dug pa 'di khyod rang gzhon nu'i skabs su/ phas dkon mchog dpang btsugs kyis bden pa ma bdar bar rang gi dkar nag phran bu dang /mi'i brngan pa la bltas nas mthu dang ngan sngags byas pa'i za ma/ bzas pa de'i rnam smin yin no/ /gzhan khyod kyis gu ru nyid la gsol ba btab/ lus kyi sgo nas phyag dang bskor ba byas/ ngag gi sgo nas skyabs 'gro dang bzlas brjod yid ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar byas pa'i phan yon gyis/ sdig sgrib yod pa rnams dag 'dug go /khyod rang gi pha de dmyal ba'i gnas na lhung 'dug pas/ rang gi lus sems bskyed pa'i pha ma la blta bar song zhig gsung ngo / /der mi de gshin rje dom gyi mgo can gcig gis khrid song bas/ma gi dpyal ba'i gnas hoṃ khung 'dra ba gcig gi nang na lo'i pha de gan rkyal du gyel ba'i snying khar lcags kyi phur bu me 'bar ba gcig btab/ kha la khro chu khol ma blugs/ g.yas g.yon nas gzhan rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis mtshon cha khyer nas rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra sgrog pa 'dug /de'i dus na skyabs mgon byed pa'i bla ma dang yi dam ni me/da/ sdug bsngal gyi gong bur tshud nas skad 'dzer 'dzer ngus kyang ra mda' byed mkhan ni med/ de'i dus su khro'i pha'i skad ngo shes te/ ming nas ngu 'bod byed cing nga'i pha hūṃ nag me 'bar la 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa ci yin zer bas/ pha na re/nga brgyud pa ma nyams hūṃ nag me 'bar brgyud sngon nas gu ru'i bka' bzhin 115

bsgrubs pa yis/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo ma btul na/ /sngags pa rang la bka' chad yong ngo gsungs/ /dam nyams dgra bo thams cad tshar bcad pas/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal 'di ltar myong dgos byung / /nga la bu tsha yod pa'i dgos pa la/ /'di las thar pa'i nus pa zhig e thon ltos//zhes zer ba la/der gshin rje'i las mkhan gcig khros te/ yar langs nas 'di skad ces zer to/ /khyod mi yul dran pa sgang la sdod pa'i dus/ bya ba ngan pa byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ brjod kyis mi langs/ khyad par dkon mchog dpang btsugs kyi mthu dang nus pa ma byas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra mi sgrol bar/ khyod rang gi dkar nag la bltas pas/ ngan sngags sbyor rdzas kyi mthu gtad mang du byas pa'i rnam smin yin zhing / da rung yun ring du sdod dgos pa yod do/ /ces zer bas/yang bu de'i kha nas / 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i mthu dang nus pa ni med/ 'on kyang ngas dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs la re nas/ chos kyi rgyal po la zhu ba gcig phul na thar ba gcig e yong ngam zhes zer te yar log nas chos kyi rgyal po la ngu 'bod kyis zhu ba 'di ltar 'bul grin 'dug /chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol//bdag gi pha ni hūṃ nag me 'bar brgyud/ /bka' ni ma log dam nyams sgrol 11dze

bar bsngags/ /yid ni ma yengs yi dam baṣ+pes pa byas/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi mthu nus la brten nas/ /dam nyams bsgral la rnam smin 'di yong ba/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi nus mthu chung lags sam/ /yi dam lha yis sngags pa bslus lags sam/ /'on kyang bdag gis mi yul bsngad dus su/ /mi gral bud kyang tshe 'di blos btang ste/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i mthu dang nus pa yis/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'di las gtong rogs mdzod/ /ces zhus song bas/chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi pha hūṃ nag me 'bar zer ba de/dgos pa'i yi dam ni ma 'grub/ mi dgos pa'i sdug 'dre 'grub/ dkon mchog dpang btsugs ma byas pas ngan sngags sbyor rdzas kyis/ mi nag yod dang nag med mang po bsad nas dpyal bar btang 'dug pa de'i rnam par smin pas kho rang sdug bsngal yun ring la dos drag pa myong ba 'di ltar yin no//dkon mchog khyad du bsad pa'i sngags pa de/ /mtho ris lam la 'gro ba'i skas kha chag /sangs rgyas zhing khams lta ba'i dkar khung 'gag /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me shi/ /thugs rjes rgyun du gzigs pa'i yi dam yal/ /srung skyob byed pa'i mkha' 'gro dam can khros/ /rang gis las byas rang gi lus thog smin/ /dkon mchog khrel bas 'di nas thar ba dka'/ /'on kyang pha yis bu la brtse gdung byas pa dang / bus kyang bsam pa skad cig tsam yang ma log par byas nas/ dkon mchog la gsol ba 117

btab nga/'i ma/thu la/ brten nas/ zhag bcu sa/nyis song ba dang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba yod do/ /da rung las kyi dbang gis gtsang phyogs/ kyi lung pa ri nang zhes pa'i phur klu btsan gcig tu skye ba len pa 'dug go /ces gsung gi 'dug pas/ bu gu ru tshe ring gi kha nas / nga'i pha 'di'i sdug bsnga/la las thar dus mi 'dug zer bas / de ma thag rol mo'i sgra dang 'od zer chen po zhig byung / der su zhig yong gi yod dam bsams nas bltas pas// bar snang thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang ba'i khrod nas /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma nga po rgyan du mas brgyan cing mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa khyer nas chos rgyal gyi drung du 'bul zhing 'dug /de'i dus na khong rnams kyi thugs rjes bar do'i sems can rnams la bde ba dpag tu med pa thob bo// /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro de rnams kyi nang nas blo ldan mchog sred kyis gar stabs dang bcas pas/ chos kri tswa75 po la glu dgrangs 'di ltar 'bul gyi 'dug go /chos kyi rgyal po bdag la snyan gson 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba gar gyi ma chod pa 'bul/ /sngon nas bsod nams mang du bsags pa yi//gu ru'i spyi/ba thabs bzlas pa rgyun du byas/ /bsnyen pa khyol nas u rgyan dngos dang mjal/ /man ngag lung bstan thob pa'i las 'phro can//sngags pa gu ru tshe ring ga na bzhugs/ /da lta rig 'dzin sa la gtong bar zhu/ /zhes zhus song bas/ chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di ltar gsung gi 118
