'dug go /gu ru blo ldan mchog sred tshur gsan dang / /bsod nams bsags pas dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /smon la/ma dbang gis gu ru nyid dang mjal/ /tshe 'di 'jig rten bya ba ling gis bskyur/ /log pa'i bsam pa skad cig ma byas shing / /longs spyod thams cad gu ru nyid la phul//skal bar ldan pa'i gu ru tshe ring 'di/ /dkar nag shan 'byed mtho ris gnas su byon/ /dag pa'i zhing thob ngan song ldog pas mnan/ /rang la las 'brel yod pa'i 'khor ba rnams/ /drangs nas rig 'dzin gnas su byon pa dang / 'o/ gro ba'i don rnams 'obad med 'grub par shog /ces gsungs nas dgangs pa la bzhugs sang /der dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i phyag gis dar thag gu ru tshe ring gi lag tu gtad nas/ thams cad yar byon song / lam gyi bar sked ya gi nas kha log byas nas 'di skad zer grin 'dug/ go /ma gi lcags ri khor yug nang zhig na/ /gu ru nyid la gsol ba btab pa'i mi/ /nga la 'brel ba thogs tshad yar shog dang / /rang tsho dag pa mkha' spyod zhing du 'gro/ /zhes zer bas ma gi dpyal khams nas mi mang po thon te/ nged tsho gu ru'i tshes bcu mchod pas mnyam du byed mkhan yin zer nas/ khong gi rjes la yar song /yang gu ru tshe ring gis 'di skad zer gyi 'dug go /bar mi yul la byon mkhan yod zer na/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi la 'phrin pa mdzod/ /sgos su gtsang gi phyogs su 'di skad gsungs/ /gu ru tshe ring thar pa thob nas 119

song / khri/la du yod pa'i gnyen dang nye 'khor rnams/ /nor la ser snas gsog 'jog ma byed par/ /ci yod dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'phul/ /'bras bu rang gi thog tu smin pa 'dug /smra ba spongs la badz+ra gu ru sgrongs/ /'khor 'bangs spongs la dkon mchog dang du long / /gnyen 'khor yul mi khyim mtshes ma mnyes kyang / /gu ru tshe ring rang mgo thon song gyis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma 'dug go gyis/ /chos mthun rnams la gsol ba thob cig gyis/ /nga yi chung ma bsod nams lha sgron ma//nged rang gnyis la 'bral ba med do gyis/ /sngar lugs bzhin du dam tshig ma 'gyur na/ /lo ngo drug dang zla gcig song ba'i dus/ /dngangs skrag mi dgos nga rang bsu ru 'ongs/ /de ltar gsung gi 'dug go gsung mdzod cig /ces zer zhing gu ru blo ldan mchog sred kyis sna drangs/ gu ru seṅge sgro sgrogo gis rgyab nas bskyor te/ mi mang po khrid nas rig 'dzin gyi sa la sang nga /i ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ de nas chu pha gi nas skad kyi nga ro lhang nge ba gcig byung / der bltas pas paṇa zhwa sna ring dang / thang shams khyil le ba yod pa gcig gis/ da ni khyod rang yang / ri nyi shar klungs la babs/las rgyu 'bras kyi shan 'byed ni go /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal ni mjal/gshin rje las mkhan rnams kyis 'jigs skrag gtong ba ni mthong / las dge sdig gis shan 'byed dang chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' rnams yid la bzung 120

la yar shog cig /sgyu lus khang stong de ring nas ma thos gtsang gi gnas la bskyel grabs su 'dug go /zer nas rlung shugs de'i ngang nas yal song bas/ nga'i zla grogs kyi bu mo des chos kyi rgyal po la 'di skad ces zhus song / kye ma chos kyi rgyal po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /nga yi bu mo dbang 'dzin zer ba 'di/ /sngon gyi bag chags dam pa'i chos su sad//las 'phro sad pas gu ru nyid dang mjal/ /tshe tshad ma rdzogs rkyen gyis bem rig bral/ /khri ba ma chod bar do'i sdug bsngal byung / /smon lam dbang gis chos rgyal drung du bslebs/ /rnam smin bden pa gshin rje'i 'jigs skrag mthong / /da ni 'di ru mi yi zhag bdun song / /tshe 'das khang stong phung po brdal bar thug /'dzam gling mi la 'phrin pa skyel gtong ngam//dal 'byor mi lus bskyar ma len du gtong / /yar gyi rig 'dzin sa la gtong lags sam/ /gar mchi chos kyi rgyal pos gsung du gsol//zhes gsol ba btab pas/chos kyi rgyal pos / nga la/ spyan che ba gcig gzigs nas dar gcig dgongs pa la bzhugs song / de nas spyan hrig ge ba srid pa las kyi me long la gzigs nas 'di ltar gsungs byung / 'o khyod ming ma nor ba 'phrin las dbang 'dzin/ rus ma nor ba sum pa'i rus/ gzugs ma nor ba smug po'i mdog /sems ma bcos pa gnyug ma/ lo ma nor ba 'brug lo/ zla ba ma nor ba 'brug gi zla ba/ nyi ma ma nor ba spre 'u'i nyi ma/ dus 121

tshod ma nor ba snga dro'i dus/ su 'dir bslebs nas/ las dkar nag gi brtsi grangs zhib par bltas sam/ gshin rje'i pho nya'i 'jigs skrag kyang mthong ngam/ dge sdig spang blang dang 'phrin bskur ba rnams go 'am/ chos kyi rgyal po nga yin pa ngo shes sam/ sngon gling sa chos kyi log pa de ming dang rus nor nas log pa yin/ ngar rtse mdo'i bud med bsam gtan zer ba de dang / khams nas bon po'i rigs rgyud kyi bud med g.yung drung dbang mo zer ba de dang / khyed rang gsum ming rus ma nor ba log pa yin no//ngar rtse mdo'i bud med log pa'i rkyen ni tshong khe spogs dang 'jig rten gyi las la yengs nas/ chos dang bsam pa bzang po ma byas na sangs mi rgya/dge ba'ang sdig pa dang ma 'dres pa gyis zer ba bskur yod/ khams bon gyi bud med log pa'i rkyen ni/ bon gyi chos la sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos sgor zhugs nas/ phyag chen gyi ngo bo lta dgos pa'i ched du log pa yin/ da khyod rang yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi 9ro dge bskul dang gshin gson gnyis kyi bar du 'phrin pa gyis shig /de ltar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan khyod kyis mi rabs gong ma gcig gis rdo rje'i phag mo zhal mjal/ dbang lung man ngag thams cad thob pas/ mi rgyud bdun yan chad du mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba/ sems can gyi don nus pas thar pa'i lam ston srid pa'i lung la 'thebs pa yin/ nga khyod rang gi shes rgyud kyi bya ba byas tshul ni/ tshe snga ma rgya gar du glang po che mngon shes can gcig tu skye ba blangs 'dug /de nas skye ba blangs pa'i mthar/ lho brag mkho ltare2

mthing gi phyogs su bud med cig gi skye ba blangs/ chung ngu'i dus nas pha mas khrid de/ lha khang rnam snang lha tshogs kyi drung du phyag dang bskor ba byas/dkar me dang zhal zas phul/ smon lam rgya chen po btab/ de nas a rgyan gyi brgyud 'dzin gter ston snang rtse ba phebs/ der khong la nor gyi 'bul ba dang / zhabs tog gis mnyes par byas nas thugs rjes 'dzin par zhus/gter ston gyis dam rdzas myong grol dang gu ru'i byang sems dkar dmar dang bcas pa'i dam rdzas mang du gnang / yun ring po'i bar du smon lam mdzad/tshe phyi ma byang chub kyi lam ston nus par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyi blo ma rig pa'i mun pa spangs te/ dge ba la bskul nus par gyur cig/phyi ma mkha' spyod kyi gnas su bdag gzhan thams cad sangs rgyas par gyur cig /ces gsungs nas smon lam yang dag pa mdzad 'dug pa'i nus pa la brten nas/ de'i rting ma rigs bzang zhing blo gsal bar skyes nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa sde brgyud yin pa/ sems/ can thams cad byams dang snying rjes skyong ba/ zhal nas yi ge drug pa dang ma bral ba/ thugs gsal stong yengs med kyi ngang nas yi dam lha dang mi 'bral ba de lta bu'i gzungs ma khyod kyis byas 'dug /de nas sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu dang dge ba'i phan yon la brten nas/ mi yul du rang gi phung po la log ste/'gro don rgya chen po 'grub pa yod do/ /de yang 'gro don gyi thog ma gtsang rgya rtse'i phyogs na yod pa 'dug pas/ 'di rnams ma brjed par se/mas la bzung zhig gsungs nas/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs gnang ngo ///123

spyir gyis lho rgyal 'dzam bu gling du skyes/ /sgos su mi lus rin chen dam pyothob/ /dbang po tshang zhing rang dbang yod pa'i dus/ /bsam blo chos kyi phyogs su thongs shig gyis/ /'khrul pa'i snang bas dmyal ba ma bsgrub par/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo la ltos gyis/ /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rdzub ma byed par/ /sems can kun la phan pa sgrubs shig gyis/ /srog gcod rku dang log g.yem ma byed par/ /dkar po dge ba'i las la 'bungs shig gyis/ /sbyin pa gtong dang tshul khrims bsrung ba sogs//pha rol phyin drug lam la zhugs shig gyis/ /drin can pha ma yid chad bcug pa na/ /dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal myong ngo gyis/ /bsam ngan dug gi sbyor ba byas pa na/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i gnas su gtong ngo gyis//bsags pa'i nor rdzas ser snas bcings pa na/ /yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal myong ngo gyis/ /snyoms chung mi la khyad bsad byas pa na//dmyal ba ngu 'bod gnas su gtong ngo gyis/ /ngan sems khong nas gting nag byas pa na/ /lcags gzer btab pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo gyis//dam pa'i chos la khyad bsad byas pa na/ /mchod rten rigs gsum 'og tu gnon no gyis/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i sdom pa ma bsrung yang / /gzhan gyi bud med bdag bzung ma rkus gyis/ /bud med rnams kyis smad 'chal byas pa na/ /bha gar khro chu tsha mo blugs so gyis/ /chu nang nya dang srog chags bsad pas ni/ /thal tshan dkyil du sdug bsngal myong ngo gyis//bdag med ri dwags bsad pa'i ling pa la/ /nyin rer 'chi thengs grangs ltare4

med yod do gyis/ /don med bsnyad btags nag med mi bsad na//lcags kyi pha bong 'og tu mnan no gyis/ /rang las skyes pa'i bu tsha bsad pa na/ /thar med dmyal ba'i gnas su gtong ngo gyis/ /gzhan gyi nor rdzas ma byin blangs pa na/ /yi dwags ngu 'bod sdug bsngal myong ngo gyis/ /bre log srang log g.yo sgru byas pa na/ /dum bur gtubs nas bre la 'jal lo gyis//rang gi phyi nang sgro dogs ma chod par/ /gzhan gyi mgo la dbang bskur ma byed gyis/ /tshe 'das ma drongs shi zas bzas pa na/ /sems can chung ngus chen po za 'o gyis/ /rgyud don man ngag khong du ma chud par/ /'dod pas mi srog 'tsho las ma byed gyis/ /nad dmig ma bltas gtar sreg byas pa na/ /rnag khrag nang du sdug bsngal myong ngo gyis/ /rang la blo gtad mi rnams 'phung bcug na/ /rang snying bton nas kha ru 'jug go gyis/ /yi dam ma sgrub mthu gtad ngan sngags mkhan/ /thar med dpyal ba'i gnas su gtong ngo gyis/ /nyams rtogs ma skyes chos brgyad kha bshad mkhan// dmyal ba mun nag nang du 'jug go gyis/ /dkon mchog gsum la bskur pa btab pa dang / /lce la me+od me+o dum bur gtubs po gyis/ /chos mdzad gong ma rtogs ldan pho mo dang / /rgyal khams 'grims pa'i ma ṇi skul mkhan la/ /dad log ngan kha bskur pa 'debs pa'i mi/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du 'jug go gyis// /bla ma slob dpon rgyab tu bskyur ba'i mi//dam chos po ti 'og tu gnon no gyis/ /khrims 'gal mna' zos gzhan srog bcad pa na/ /mtshon cha 'khor los dum bur gtubs po gyis/ /tshig ltare5

lcub phra mas gzhan sems dkrugs pa na/ /thig btab sog les phye mar bcad do gyis/ /rku 'phrog gcod ban+deg brdungs rdzob byas pa na/ /brag ris btsir ba'i sdug bsngal gtong ngo gyis/ /bsags pa'i nor gyis bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam sna 'dren no gyis/ /spos dang me tog dkar me zhal/ zas phul/ /ma rig 'thums pa'i mun pa sel lo gyis/ /lus kyi sgo nas phyag dang bskor ba gyis/ /ngag gi sgo nas yi dam snying po sgrongs/ /yid kyi sgo nas ma yengs ting 'dzin sgoms/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong de ltar yin no gyis/ /nga chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs 'dug gyis/ /las dge sdig dkar nag gnyis po la/ khon 'byed lugs zhib par 'dug go gyis/ /las dkar po dge la 'bungs pa'i mi/ /yar mtho ris gnas la gtong ngo gyis/ /las nag po sdig pa bsags pa'i mi//mar dpyal ba'i gnas su gtong ngo gyis/ /khyod 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams kyis/ /spyir shākya thub pa'i bka' bzhin gyis/ /sgos nga yi 'phrin pa dang du longs/ /nga phyi ltar na chos kyi rgyal po yin/ /nang ltar na thugs rje chen po yin/ /de yi snying po ma ṇi pad me sgrongs/ /nga phyi ltar na chos kyi rgyal po yin/ /nang ltar na mtsho skyes rdo rje yin/ /de yi snying po badz+ra gu ru sgrongs//nga phyi ltar na chos kyi rgyal po yin/ /nang ltar na ston pa shākya thub pa yin//khong ston pas gsungs bzhin nyams su longs/ /dus rgyun du dge ba blo stobs skyed/ /'phral sdig pa phra zhing phra bar spongs/ /pha bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu sgoms/ /ma sems can kun la phan cher thogs/ /yid 'bral r+sha96

med yi dam sgoms shig gyis/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la/ /'phrin pa 'di ltar zhib tu gyis/ /sdig can dmyal bar lhung 'dug gyis/ /sdig bshags skyel ma thongs shig gyis/ /sdig pa'i las la 'gyod sems dang //phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' longs/ /ci yod dge ba'i phyogs su spungs//mtho ris thob pa'i las gyis shig /ces dang / gzhan yang rigs bzang zhing blo gsal yang / sngon gyi sbyin 'bras med pa'i skye bo 'byor med rnams la/ dge ba'i bskul ma dang / chos kyi 'brel pas them pa yar 'dzeg tu yin pas/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos rnams nye ring med par shod la/ zas kyi 'brel pa re thabs kyis longs shig /de yang bza' btung thams cad kyi phud nas bla ma dkon mchog mchod/ lhag ma sems can rnams la bsngos/rang gis dbang ba yang tshogs kyi 'khor lor shes par gyis la/ ye shes kyi lha tshims par bsam nas zos/ de ltar zas 'brel dang chos 'brel btags pas/ phyi ma 'byor pa che 'i/nga chos dang mthun pa'i phan yon yod do/ /khyad par mi dad pa can gyis phul ba'i nor zas dngos po che chung gang byung yang / dge ba la ci 'gyur gyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang / de dag gi drung du dkar me dang / zhal zas spyan gzigs snyan dar la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor ba phul la/ mkha' mnyam sems can rnams kyi don du smon lam go ma log par rgya cher thob cig /bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa 'bul zhing smon lam 'debs nus na/tshe gcig lus gcig la chogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis dag nas 127

mngon dga'i zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams rang gzhan gnyis ka'i thad du bden par shad cig /rdzun dang tshig rtsub spongs la snang ba 'khrid mkhas su/ yin nga/'i ngang gis shod cig /gzhan yang gshin rje'i pho nya'i ngad pa me bas tsha ba 'dug/ go gyis/ dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal che'o gyis//bar do'i gnas ni lam thag ring ngo gyis/ /sdig can mi rnams 'gyod sems skyed cig gyis/ /skal ldan kun kyang yi ge drug pa sgrongs/ /skal med sdig can dmyal bar lhung dus su/ /skyabs med mgon med smre sngags ngu 'bod byed/ /de dus phyis zin da lta dbang yod dus/ /rgyu 'bras 'dzoms shing dam pa'i lha chos gyis/ /de skad 'dzam gling mi la 'phrin pa gyis/ /de ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi la 'phrin pa byas shing 'gro don grub pa na/ skyebo 'di+o'i rtingo ma rgyo gar du paṇ+ḍi ta gcig tu skye ba blangs nas chos kyi 'khar la bskar ba yad da/ /yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi la 'phrin ma 'khyol zhing bden par ma brjod na/ lo bzhi cu zhe dgu'i nang tshe'i dus byas te/ yul lho stod kyi tsher sgo zhes bya ba gcig tu/ da rung bud med kyi skye ba blangs nas ming la bsod nams chos sgron zhes bya bar yong bar 'dug /des kyang gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong dgos par yod pas/ lo bcu gsum lon pa'i dus su bem rig bral nas/ smon lam gyi dbang gis gshin rje rnams kyinu/ mi zin par 'dir 'ongs te/ pha dang bu phrad pa bzhin/ las dkar nag gi slob ston pa las ltare8

rgyas par nyan cing mi yul du log nas 'gro/ de yang sngon gyi la/sa 'phro dang smon lam la brten nas 'di ltar yong ba yod do/ /gzugs mdzes dri zhim tshangs/ pa'i dbyangs ltar snyan/ /khrom/ tshogs lha mi thams cad kha lo bsgyur/ /sdig can brjod thabs med nga/'i ma/chi ma shor/ /bdud rigs sangs rgyas bstan pa smad pa'i mi/ /gshan ris/sa bdud mo 'ga' zhig ngan sems byed/ /srog la rbad cing sku la brnyas pa byung / /de dus bden pa bdar ba'i bzlog pa gyis/ /dkon mchog dbyengs nas bzhugs pas bar chad sel/ /gzhan yang khyod kyi 'gro don bsam mi khyab/ /pha ma nye 'khor nor la chags sems spongs/ /nga yi bka' bzhin nyan nas khams kyi yul/ /skal ldan las can thar pa'i lam la 'khod/ /gdul bya'i thog ma khams kyi phu nas byed/ /sems can 'gro don la stod phyogs su yod/ /la las lha yin la las bdud yin zer//bzang ngan sna tshogs lab pa'i dus tshod na/ /dpal chen sga los byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /brag ri chen po gnam du mchongs 'dra yod/ /de ru phag mo'i bsten sgrub zla bdun gyis/ /yi dam dngos/ su mjal nas bar chad sel/ /mi rnams chos la mos gus skye ba'i rkyen/ /khyod la sngon 'brel yo/da pa'i mi gcig yin/ /skye sa gtsang phyogs sdod sa lho yi phyogs//chos kyi nyams len de wi ko ṭar byas/ /tshe tshad khyod kyis skye ba gnyis tsa'i / thub/ /de gnyis bla mar bkur zhing rgyu 'bras dang / /'das log lo rgyus ltotsho

chos/ rnams rim bshad nga/sa/ /mi rnams thams cad rim gyis chos la 'khor/ /de nas dbus gtsang phyogs su 'gro don skyong / /chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung gsung 'phrin dang / /tshe 'das rnams/ kyis 'phrin pa legs bskur bas/ /kha lag chos kyi 'brel tshad bde la 'khod/ /zhal mjal gsung thos ngan song r+sho mo khegs/ /dad pa can rnams mngon dga'i zhing du 'gro/ /de dus dmyal ba dong nas sprugs 'gyur bas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang dgongs pa lan gcig dgyes/ /de nas khyod kyi tshe 'di bya ba thongs//sdod sems spongs la rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims/ /las 'brel yod pa'i mi rnams lam sna 'dren/ skal med log lta can tsho'i blor mi shang //khyod kyi skye ba phyi ma'i dus tshod na/ /chos rgyal bka' lung tshe 'das 'phrin pa rnams/ /mi rnams kun la rim par bshad gyur kyang / /skal med log lta can gyi mi rnams ni/ /bden par ma zin log pa'i gtam du smra/ /bcol chung rnams kyang de yi kha phyir 'breng / /log lta can rnams dad pa skye ba'i phyir/ /mo lo sum cu so lnga lon pa'i dus/ /mi dmangs 'dzoms pa'i dbus su tshe'i dus byed/ /dbang po'i sgo 'gags mig bu gdong la bsdus//dkar mdzes mdangs yal dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad/ /lus kyi drod bsdus zhag bdun sa rdo bzhin/ /dad can bud med rnams ni lta zhing ngu/ /skyes pa rnams kyang phangs nas snying rlung 'phyo/ /las can rnams ni phyag dang bskor ba byed/ /sdig can rnams ni blo la the tshom skyes/ /bdud rigs rnams ni da rung mi bden zer/ /nges 'drongs bden tshig med pa'i lcebs pa yin//130

da lan log nas bden par cha 'jog zer/ /rgyal 'jug byed cing rgyan chas dpang du 'dzugs/ /zhag bdun song nas chos rgyal drung 'khor te/ /sngar gyi gtam la de dus rgyas par khyer/ /tshe 'das nor la sbas sring byas pa rnams/ /mngon sum lta ba'i nges shes 'drongs pa byung / /dad can rnams ni yid smon gsol ba 'debs/ /dad med rnams kyang dam pa'i chos la tshud/ /chos rgyal drung na lan gsum 'khor ba'i sting / /'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams chos la bsgrur/ /'brel tshad rting ma mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren//de rnams chos rgyal ma 'ongs lung bstan yin/ /da ni snying rus bskyed la smon lam thob/ /sgyu ma lus kyi khang stong 'jig grabs 'dug /snang tshul ma brjed sems la bcags par gyis/ /bka' 'phrin mi brjed nga rang byin gyis rlobs/ /smon lam thob la rang gi yul la log /gzhan yul log pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /chos rgyal ga/sung 'phrin rin chen gser las dkon/ /gshin rje'i pho nya'i 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal dang / /dge sdig brtsi grangs 'dzam gling mi la shad/ /dkar po dge ba'i las la brtson par gyis/ /mo lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu ma song tshun/ /de bar sems can 'gro don gang che gyis/ /zhe dgu'i steng nas 'di ru yong ba 'dug /phyir 'then 'dod na mi 'khrugs stong tshar bzhengs/ /gnas ri bzang sar phyag mchod bskor ba dang / /zla ba bdun du tshe yi sgrub pa gyis/ /phyir 'then mi lo gsum du bshol ba 'dug /da ni ri klungs nyi dros dus la bslebs/ /smon lam thob la rang yul sems par gyis/ /zhes gsungs nas chos kyi rgyal po lta 131

gdengs kyi ngang la/ bzhugs song / de'i dus su tshe las 'das pa 'ga' zhig gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis lcags kyus snying nas bzung ste khrid 'gro zhing 'dug pas/ mi de rnams kyis nga la 'di ltar zer gyin 'dug go/las 'phro can ma mi yul la byon na/ /'phrin pa 'di ltar gsungs rog mdzod cig /rang rang gi rjes la dge ba bskyar ma re yang gtong rogs gyis/ dkon mchog la zhabs tog kyang gang drag zhu rogs gyis/ khyad par bar do dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba la/ yi ge drug pa 'di las phan yon che ba mi 'dug pas/ ma ṇi khri tshar gtong ba dang / ma ṇi bskul ma bskul ba dang / ma ṇi rdo la brkos te 'dzugs pa dang / dar la bris te 'phyar ba dang / ma ṇi'i 'khor lo 'dzugs pa la sogs pa mdor na dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad 'bungs thon cig zer ba'i 'phrin pa gsung rogs mdzod cig zer grin 'dug go /de nas nga rang gi bsam pa la da yul du log 'gro bsam pa'i snang ba gcig shar byung bas/ khra phu na bslebs 'dug /der rang gi sgo na khyi ga pa'i ro/ mig ko dong du 'drus pa kha sbub chil le ba gcig 'dug pas/'jigs pa dang skrug bro ba'i snang bas dum tsam zhig phar bros phyin pas/slar bsam blo zhig btang bas bgoms te phyin pas chog bsam/ khyi ro de la bgoms nas yong bas de ma/ thag tu rang gi sems/ rang gi lus la zhugs nas dran pa gtor nas sa rub pa lta bu nag thum me ba gcig byung /132

de nas en gcig nas dran pa cung zad rnyed kyang / lus la gzungs med pas sgul ma shes/ dran pa rim gyis gsal nas cung zad bsgul ba dang /nga rang gi sngas mgo na rgyun bzhugs pa yod pa des phaṭa gsu/ma rgyab byung bas/nga dmyal khams kyi sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag rnams ma brjed wal le yod pa des spar te 'phar song bas/ nga'i gdong la btang ba'i yol ba de ni ling pa gcig byung bas/ rgyun bzhugs pa'i bsam pa la/ 'og 'gro rgyal po thub pa'i stabs kyis ro langs yin narma bsam/ yol ba bsal nas nga'i mgo la lag pas cab cab lan mang du byas byung / de nas nga'i phag tu lag pa gtad byung bas/ ngas kyang ma shi zer zhing lag pas 'dzin dgos bsam kyang / lus la zungs med pas 'dzin ma shes/ lce'i smra ba ma byung /rgyun du bzhugs pas drod yod med bltas pas/ snying khar drod cung zad 'dug pa dang / nang mi rnams kyis ming nas 'bod cing / sras mo log byung 'dir shog cig zer grin 'dug pas/ a ma lags phebs nas/ a ma'i bu mo log pa yin nam zer zhing mchi ma 'don pa dang / slog pa'i sne mo btsems pa rnams 'grol grin 'dug /snge pa bgres pas byon sa sdod sa spo/chang dang bu ram/ sbrang tsi sbyar bas bskal ldan sbyin gsungs nas/bskol ldan byin kyang / zhag bdun gyi bar du lu/sa sems bral ba'i lce dang mid pa bskams nas 'thung ma shes/ thur mas cung zad re blud pas sang nyin nas rim par zungs kyi shed rnyed/ nye 'khor gyi mi rnams zhal bsangs pa dang /ri ——ri sras mo log byung zer te dga' bar gyur to/ /der yig mkhan 133

gnyis bos te/ dbus gtsang dang lho brag gi lo rgyus rnams bsdebs cig dang / sog yul dang mon phyogs kyi lo rgyus rnams rim gcig byas narngo ku bris/ rang nyid chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung 'phrin 'gyur bar rgyal khams la 'gro rtsis yin kyang / chos rje drung gi yum gyi zhal nas/ mo rig/sa ngan drags nas/ dbus gtsang phyogs kyi mi'i dbugs sdud par/ lus bzheg nas phyin te log pa yin zer zhing lab pas/ mi gzhan rnams kyang de'i kha phyir 'brengs nas/ de 'dra bdud mo rang yin pa 'dug zer nas/ /dad pa mi byed pa'i khar gtam ngan gyis khengs par gyur to/ /der sde pa bgres pa'i bka' bkod la/ tsā ri bskor ba'i snyan grags med par/ dgon g.yag brkus pa'i mi kha'i dbe bzhin/ yong bar 'dug pas/ da lan re zhig song la sdod gsung pa la brten nas gsang nas bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas dus re zhig na/ khram mkhar du/ dpon slob rje drung rin po che phebs nas bka' chos gnang gyi 'dug pas/ ngas kyang zla ba gcig gi bar bka' chos nyan par song / der sems ngo sprod pas 'dri ba rnams rim par phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas bka' chos zhu yun de la rtogs pa de lta bu'i skye ba dga' mo yin par 'dug gsungs byung / der rang gi g.yog mo zhig yod pa des/ khong sems ngo spre+od pa sla ba lo/sa yong / khong ga'an yul nas log pa yin zer ba zhus song / der bla mas nga la chang gar ma ka pā la gsum bstud nas gnang byung ba'i rjes su/ dpon slob rin po che'i 134

bka' bkod la/ ngas kyang dang po gshin yul la lan gsum 'gro myong /ngas phyin pa dang sras mos phyin pa gnyis gcig mi gcig blta bas sras mos lo rgyus gcig gsungs zer byung / der ngas lo rgyus rnams rim par zhus pas/ chos zhu ba rnams kyang gcig sleb gnyis sleb rim pas 'dzoms/dpon slob rin po ts+tsha yang spyan chab bsil zhing gsan gyis 'dug /de'i nyin bka' chos kyi chos mthun rnams bzhag nas/ ngas dmyal ba'i lo rgyus dang gzhin po rnams kyis 'phrin bskur ba rnams de'i nyin 'khyongs par zhus pas/dpon slob rin po che yang thugs yid ches nas/ sras mo khyod la 'di lta bu'i ngo shes 'drongs par 'dug pa la/ da 'di ru sdod nas phangs par 'dug pas/ da khyod rang rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims te 'gro don mdzod cig /ngas 'og rta gcig dang dre'u gcig /phyag g.yog gnyis zhal ta ma cig rnams sbrags nas gtong bas rgyal khams la song zhig gsungs nas khong rang gi mgul sgom de nga la gnang ste/ khyod rang la stod phyogs la phyin na 'gro don yang che ba dang / bu slob kyang nga bas mang ba yong ngo 'dug gsungs kyang / rang nyid chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs su bslebs dus/g.yas g.yon gyi khro bo khro mo rnams la 'jigs nas rtab rtob kyi ngang la/rang gcig po sangs rgyas pa'i smor+ha lam btab pa ma gtogs/ sems can thams cad kyi 'gro don nus par gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam 'debs ma nus pa'i gshis kyis/ rang gi a ma la chags nas 'gro don rgya cher ma byung ba yin no// //de ltar karma dbang 'dzin gyis bar do'i gzigs 135

snang dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung / tshe 'das rnams kyis 'phrin pa bskur yod tshad bkod na/ rje btsun rin po che mi la ras pa'iX rnam thar masdo/ra 'bum sbrags ma tsam yong ba 'dug ste/ da lan zhig lags lha dbang bu khrid kyis bar do'i gzigs snang dang / tshe 'das rnams kyi 'phrin pa ma/dor bsdus pa gcig zin bris rim pa gsum tsam byung ba de dang bstun/khrid kha mang nyung bsdebs/ tshig zur gyi bcad mtshams dang bshad lugs kyis/ stod smad 'dug pa 'di cung zad bde bar byas pa 'di nyid/ dpal ldan 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam thar rgyal ba'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten cing gsung gi bdud rtsi mang du thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa khrag 'thung rdo rje 'am ming gzhan shī la dh+wa dzas/ 'brug spung thang bde chen gyi shags ldebs su bgyis pas dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //lnge/ na mo gu ru/ thos bsam sgom pa'i lus rtsal rab rdzogs shing //'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i g.yu ral kun nas mdzes/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sder mo mchog tu rno/ /mi yi seṅge bla ma rgyal gyur cig /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis 'gro la rjes chags nas//mir brdzus 'das log kame dbang 'dzin gyi/ /rnam thar thar 'dod rnams kyi gsos su bsgrubs/ /'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar sregs za yis//srid rtsa ma rig tsher klung kun bzas pas/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon bzang legs bdo zhing / /don gnyis dpal 'bar 'khor ba stong gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang ke em kri par skrun la/sa sde'i sbyi na bdag dad gtong gi blo dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi 13dze
